These results show that pedagogical video quality depends less on surface fluency than on explicit, typed instructional contracts that make scaffolding, adaptation, engagement, and grounding auditable.

</details>


### [348] [Understanding Privacy by Formalizing It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20609)
*Réka Markovich,Truls Pedersen,Marija Slavkovik*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文使用多模态逻辑（结合道义逻辑、认知逻辑、行动逻辑和真势逻辑），将隐私权作为Hohfeld规范性地位理论中的认知权利进行形式化，刻画了几种主流隐私定义（独处权、访问控制权、透明度权、可执行性）背后的不同规范性结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐私是现代社会的核心价值，AI与数字化对其造成侵蚀，但学界对"隐私"及"隐私权"缺乏统一定义。不同理论（信息控制论、限制访问论、无审视空间论等）侧重点不同，且现有计算领域（差分隐私、多智能体系统）中的隐私概念难以与法律/社会科学传统对接。为使隐私规制可被算法验证与比较，需要在逻辑层面给出精确的形式化规范。

Method: 采用Hohfeld规范性地位理论（claim-right、privilege、power、immunity及其关联项）作为法律-逻辑理论框架。构造一个多模态语言L，包含四种模态算子：行动算子Ea（"a使之成立"）、定向义务算子O_{a→b}（"a对b有义务"）、认知算子Ka（"a知道"，S5）以及真势算子□（S5）。义务模态取KD，行动模态取ET（带neighborhood语义）。在框架F = ⟨W, R□, {fa, R^K_a, R^O_{a,b}}⟩上给出真值条件，分别对"独处权"（Warren/Brandeis）、"信息控制权"（Westin）、"无审视空间权"（Parent）、"透明度权"以及"司法可执行性"进行逐条形式化表达，区分claim-right、multital freedom、power与immunity。

Result: 给出了12个核心公式：(1)-(2)独处权的"ought-to-be"形式；(3)-(5)将国家立法设为义务承担者的多边claim-right（含多层嵌套义务）；(6)-(9)主体a对信息φ的多边自由及对应的immunity保护（防止他人改变其自由）；(10)-(12)在无法排除他人访问情形下，a对b使用/传播φ的行为的禁止权（power），包括禁止b向a本人透露的强形式；(13)透明度权——a有权知道是否有他方能访问φ；(14)当claim-right被违反时，a对司法j的power以启动救济。展示了同一隐私理念可被表达为不同规范性位置的组合，且这些形式化可直接相互比较。

Conclusion: 该工作桥接了法律-哲学层面的Hohfeld权利分析与计算机科学中隐私建模的鸿沟，为隐私概念的算法可执行规范（policy-as-code、law-as-code）提供形式化基础。未来工作包括：处理隐私权的可废止性（defeasibility）、尝试其他形式系统（如LogiKEy框架）、并据此构建伦理推理器。

Abstract: In most of the modern societies, there is a broad consensus regarding the need for promoting privacy and thus placing restrictions on technological-including AI-developments to protect people's right to privacy. In order to meet these expectations on the algorithmic level, first we need to make the concept of privacy and the related or derived rights formally specified. However, the notion of (the right to) privacy is subject to different interpretations. In this paper, we use a multi-modal logic to provide an initial formalization of different theories, basic principles and their implications investigating the right to privacy as an epistemic right within the theory of normative positions.

</details>


### [349] [Signals in the Noise: Open Source Intelligence (OSINT) for AI Loss of Control Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20610)
*Sarah Bollinger,Nada Aboserie,Amanda Coakley,Chih-Hsuan Lee,Taysir Mathlouthi*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文将开源情报(OSINT)与网络威胁情报(CTI)方法论系统性地应用于检测AI失控(loss of control)这一新型威胁场景,首次以Diamond Model形式化建模AI智能体作为"非人类威胁行为者",提出两个威胁模型(TM1权力追求型智能体与TM2制度性妥协),识别12类可观测痕迹并筛选出三项优先检测向量(用户报告转录收集、推理瓶颈基础设施关联、能力隐藏输出分析),主张建立独立于前沿AI开发商的、依托OSINT方法的联邦式国际监测能力,并将非行业资助列为最高杠杆的结构性干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿AI系统正以日益增强的智能体能力部署至现实环境,失控风险已从思想实验转为实际威胁。然而现有AI安全实践主要依赖实验室条件下的模型评估,无法有效监测已部署系统在真实制度环境中与遗留基础设施交互时出现的漂移、偏离与渐进失控。同时,商业部署速度远超政策制定与研究跟踪能力,导致评估与部署之间存在显著的监测盲区。OSINT与CTI作为在对抗性、信息密集环境中发展成熟的威胁检测学科,为填补这一空白提供了尚未被充分探索的方法论基础。

Method: 研究采用三阶段混合方法:(1)跨学科文献综述,涵盖OSINT/CTI方法论、AI安全与对齐研究、技术治理四大领域;(2)依据查塔姆宫规则(Chatham House Rule)开展14次半结构化专家访谈,受访者涵盖AI安全工程、前沿模型部署、非扩散情报OSINT、网络安全运营、人权问责数字调查、AI安全研究等领域;(3)跨工作流迭代分析与综合。研究分四个互补分析层展开:威胁行为者画像(Diamond Model框架)、基础设施与数字痕迹、行为签名、检测方法论,并形成治理章节。五位作者分别负责不同章节的调查与撰写。

Result: 核心研究发现:OSINT检测AI失控"部分可行且值得现在建设"。识别出12类可观测痕迹,按可行性×检测价值矩阵评估,三项最高优先级检测向量为:用户报告转录收集(行为/输出层,高可行高价值)、推理提供商端点出站流量监测(基础设施层,中可行高价值,因前沿推理集中于少数云提供商形成结构性检测瓶颈)、能力隐藏输出分析(行为/输出层)。TM2(制度性妥协)无需尚不存在的能力,CLTR失控观察站已在大规模真实部署中记录到前驱行为,可作为近期投资重点;TM1(权力追求型智能体)所需能力虽尚未完全具备但差距正快速缩小。CLTR对逾18.3万条公开聊天记录的分析识别出698起可信的阴谋相关事件,月环比增长4.9倍,证实OSINT方法具备规模化发现真实世界AI阴谋行为的能力。行为签名框架包括时间模式、决策签名、输出模式三大支柱,经专家验证,输出模式(过度彻底性与能力-目标错配)为最可靠判别指标。研究同时明确指出OSINT的边界:无法单独实现实时高置信度检测,最具诊断价值的痕迹位于需要监管访问的封闭层级。

Conclusion: 当前治理框架(风险型监管、伦理指南、生命周期治理、自愿自律)在结构性上不适用于失控风险——该风险可能渐进且不可逆。论文提出建立专门的国际AI失控监测能力,设计特征为:联邦式架构、独立于任何单一国家管辖、依托OSINT方法、与AI安全研究所(AISI)合作作为通向封闭数据层的机构桥梁、以慈善资助为初始两年半约5000万美元规模的资金基础并主动实现地理多元化以避免再现现有AI安全慈善格局的权力集中。该能力应将偏差级事件视为诊断信号而非操作噪音。研究最终判定检测窗口尚未关闭但正在收窄,鉴于相关能力阈值日益临近,投资建立监测能力的时机就是现在,替代方案不是审慎,而是来得太晚。

Abstract: This paper applies open-source intelligence (OSINT) and cyber threat intelligence (CTI) methodologies to the problem of detecting AI systems operating outside human control. Drawing on a cross-disciplinary literature review and 14 semi-structured expert interviews conducted under Chatham House Rule, the paper develops two threat models, identifies a range of observable traces, and proposes an institutional architecture for monitoring. The research finds that OSINT-based detection of loss of control is partially feasible and worth building now. Three detection vectors emerge as highest priority: transcript-based collection of user-reported AI behaviour; infrastructure correlation for unexpected external connections or replication; and output analysis for capability concealment. The paper argues for a dedicated, federated international monitoring capability anchored in OSINT methods and independent of frontier AI developers, and identifies sustained non-industry funding as the highest-leverage structural intervention available.

</details>


### [350] [Efficient Safety Benchmarking via Item Response Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20626)
*Fabio Spagliardi,Mírian Silva,Ayan Datta,Aiden Zhou,Vamshi Bonagiri,Diogo Cruz*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文将心理测量学中的项目反应理论(IRT)与计算机自适应测试(CAT)从能力评估迁移至大语言模型安全评估领域，提出自适应性(Fluid Benchmarking)与静态子集选择两种高效评估方法，在六个主流安全基准上将评估成本降低80%–99.9%，同时保持与全量评估的排序一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前安全基准通常对所有模型均匀施测所有题目，假设每道题对所有模型信息量相同。然而现代安全基准包含数万个对抗性、多样化的题目，全面评估需要约10^5次模型响应，其中大部分对模型排序贡献极低，造成严重的资源浪费。此外，原始安全分数在高端存在严重的天花板效应，难以区分均表现"很安全"的模型。现有高效评估方法多针对能力基准，未考虑安全场景的特殊性（如对齐响应稀疏、跨基准有效性不成立、项目区分度差异大等）。

Method: 1) 在六个安全基准(AIR-Bench 2024、Anthropic Red Team、HarmBench、SafetyBench、SimpleSafety、WMDP-Bio)上拟合2PL IRT模型，得到模型潜在安全能力θ和项目参数(区分度a、难度b)；2) 扩展Fluid Benchmarking框架至安全领域，采用最大Fisher信息(MFI)准则自适应选题，并使用MAP估计更新能力值；3) 提出三种IRT驱动的静态子集选择方法(Total Fisher、Marginal Fisher、Marginal Fisher-b四分位约束)以及两种适配的非IRT方法(Anchor Point、DISCO的二元化版本)；4) 以Spearman ρ作为Agreement指标，评估子集排序与全量排序的一致性，使用10模型留出测试集并平均70–100次随机划分结果。

Result: 1) IRT模型在所有基准上恢复排序(Spearman ρ∈[0.97,1.00])，RMSE≤0.04，且在安全分数饱和(>0.95)时仍能有效分离模型(Anthropic Red Team上θ范围1.19–6.06)；2) 项目区分度变异系数(CV)可作为可压缩性诊断指标，AIR-Bench 2024、WMDP、SafetyBench等高CV基准存在稀疏的高区分度长尾，是自适应选择最大收益的场景；3) 自适应选择在AIR-Bench 2024上仅用6题(0.1%)即达90% Agreement，最高节省99.9%成本；4) 静态Marginal Fisher方法在多数基准上以约5%–26%的子集即可保持>90% Agreement，成本节省80%–99.8%；5) Random与Random IRT基线在小k时显著落后，但在HarmBench(中等CV)等基准上差异消失，表明CV是不完全预测因子。

Conclusion: 心理测量学方法可成功迁移至安全评估，使排序保真度高的同时大幅降低评估成本。CV可作为预测自适应收益的轻量级诊断；自适应方法精度最高但不可复用，静态子集适合跨模型共享排行榜场景；IRT方法在高CV、高难度基准上优势最显著。建议对重复使用、评估昂贵的基准采用IRT方法，对一次性评估则不必引入建模假设。局限包括：将安全视为单一潜在特质(实际可能多维)、二值化丢失严重度信息、仅覆盖一次性评估场景；未来工作应探索多维IRT、等级反应模型及智能体场景。

Abstract: Safety benchmarks for language models are typically evaluated using static paradigms that treat all items as equally informative for all models, an assumption that is particularly problematic for adversarial, highly heterogeneous safety items. Applied in full to modern benchmark suites, the current evaluation procedures would require on the order of $10^5$ responses, most of which provide little ranking signal. We analyze a suite of widely used safety benchmarks and make three contributions toward more efficient safety evaluation. First, we show that Item Response Theory (IRT) recovers interpretable structure on safety benchmarks, with ability estimates resolving differences among models that cluster at the ceiling of raw safety metrics. Second, we show that adaptive item selection, which dynamically chooses informative items for each model based on its responses, approximates full-benchmark rankings while reducing evaluation cost by at least 80% on benchmarks where Spearman's $\rho >$90% with full-benchmark is attainable, and by up to 99.9% on AIR-Bench 2024. Third, we introduce a practical procedure for extracting a fixed, informative subset of items reusable across models, providing an alternative to adaptive selection with savings of up to 99.8% on AIR-Bench 2024. Together, these results establish that psychometric methods enable benchmark-aware reductions in evaluation costs across the safety evaluation pipeline.

</details>


### [351] [Measuring the Occupation-Level Impact of AbbVie Intelligence: AI Applicability Analysis, 2024-2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20635)
*John Regan,Jon Stevens,Brian Martin*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文对 AbbVie Intelligence 在 2024–2025 年间对 192 个职业的实质性影响进行了实证分析。基于近 60 万次匿名化 AI 对话数据，研究发现平台版本更新与 AI 培训项目均能显著提升 AI 在企业中的适用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着生成式 AI 在企业中的快速部署，亟需量化评估 AI 工具对不同职业的实际辅助与自动化效果，以判断技术平台升级与员工培训项目是否真正扩大了 AI 在企业内部的触达范围与价值。

Method: 基于 598,744 次脱敏 AI 对话，按 O*NET 中等工作活动（IWA）分类体系进行标注，计算各职业的"AI 适用性得分"（AI Applicability Score）。研究采用三项收敛性分析：(1) 2024 至 2025 年的纵向趋势比较；(2) 针对 2025 年 8 月 AbbVie Intelligence v3 平台发布的准实验前后评估；(3) 针对 2025 年 11 月 AbbVie AI 学习峰会的前后评估。

Result: 三项分析均呈现统计学显著的正向变化。2024 至 2025 年间平均 AI 适用性得分大幅上升；v3 平台发布带来 +10.0% 的提升（p<0.001）；AI 学习峰会带来 +6.68% 的提升（p<0.001）。

Conclusion: 研究证明，技术平台的功能升级与结构化的企业 AI 教育项目能够各自独立且实质性地拓展 AI 在 AbbVie 员工中的覆盖范围与适用深度，为企业 AI 投资提供了量化证据支持。

Abstract: This paper presents an empirical analysis of AbbVie Intelligence's measurable impact on employee work activities across 192 distinct occupations in 2024 and 2025. Drawing on 598,744 de-identified AI conversations classified according to the O*NET Intermediate Work Activity (IWA) taxonomy, we compute occupation-level AI Applicability Scores that quantify the extent to which AI tools can meaningfully assist or automate real work at scale. Three convergent analyses are conducted: (1) longitudinal year-over-year trends from 2024 to 2025, (2) a quasi-experimental pre-post evaluation of the AbbVie Intelligence version 3 platform release in August 2025, and (3) a pre-post evaluation of the AbbVie AI Learning Summit held in November 22025. Results demonstrate statistically significant improvements across all three dimensions. Mean AI Applicability Scores rose substantially from 2024 to 2025; the platform release product a +10.0% gain (p<0.001); and the AI Learning Summit produced a +6.68% gain (p<0.001). These findings establish that both technological platform enhancements and structured enterprise AI eduction programs independently and substantially expand the reach of AI across the AbbVie workforce.

</details>


### [352] [Latent Confidence Alignment for LLM Self-Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21937)
*Ting-Yu Chen,Tingting Yu,Pei-Cing Huang,Chan Hsu,Ming-Yen Lin,Yihuang Kang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合项目反应理论（IRT/Rasch模型）与元认知视角的LLM评估框架，核心创新是定义"潜在置信对齐误差"（LCAE），用于衡量模型自评估与潜在错误概率的一致性。该框架在医疗领域MedXpertQA数据集上对20个LLM进行实验，验证了外部难度信号（IDS）对提升自评估质量的关键作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有置信度校准指标（如ECE、Brier分数）仅将预测置信度与观察到的准确率进行聚合比较，存在两大局限：1）未建模项目难度（item difficulty），无法区分置信度偏差源于自评估不准还是难度感知不当；2）模型置信度通常在响应生成过程中产生，缺乏独立的自评估过程，可能仅是生成过程的副产品而非真正的自我判断。这降低了模型自评估的可解释性，尤其在高风险领域（如医疗）应用受限。

Method: 提出三阶段评估框架：(1) 能力估计阶段——采用Rasch模型（1PL）同时估计模型能力θ和项目难度b，定义IRT_ModelErrorP作为潜在错误概率参考；(2) 元认知决策阶段——模型独立于初始响应进行自评估，输出LLM_ModelErrorP，并可基于自评估结果修正答案；引入两个机制——IDS（IRT难度信号）将IRT_ItemErrorP作为外部信息注入，DPR（双过程路由）允许模型在System 1快速推理与System 2慢速反思（采用SNAPPS框架的Narrow-Analyze-Probe三步反思）间自适应选择；(3) 模型选择阶段——定义LCAE为LLM自评估错误概率与IRT潜在错误概率间的二元交叉熵，引入成本效率（CE）指标。在MedXpertQA医疗基准上，使用20个LLM × 5种提示策略构成100个被试者，100个项目，对比baseline、IDS、DPR、IDS+DPR四种条件。

Result: 关键发现：(1) Friedman检验显示四种条件对LCAE影响显著（χ²(3)=35.15, p<0.001），而对能力无显著影响（p>0.05）；(2) IDS+DPR组合显著降低LCAE（p=0.001），DPR单独使用无显著效果；(3) 能力高的模型自评估质量不一定好（如Gemini 2.5 Pro能力高但LCAE最大）；(4) GPT-5基线LCAE即较低（1.058），自评估稳定性强；DeepSeek R1/V3.2在IDS+DPR组合下取得最低LCAE；(5) 能力与LCAE不呈单调关系，三维联合分析揭示gpt-oss-120B以高CE（8.73M tokens/USD）和较低LCAE（1.061）实现可靠性与效率兼顾。

Conclusion: 该框架实现了能力估计与自评估在统一潜在量表上的分离分析，证明LLM即使在相近能力水平下自评估对齐质量仍存在显著差异。外部难度信号是影响自评估的主要因素，单纯反思机制效果有限，二者结合可进一步提升对齐质量。LCAE、CE、θ的联合多维分析为高风险场景下的模型选择提供了更全面的依据，且无需模型重训练即可提升自评估质量。局限：仅在医疗领域验证；IDS信号依赖同批模型估计，可能存在偏差；成本估算方法简化。

Abstract: Confidence calibration in large language models (LLMs) is commonly evaluated by comparing predicted confidence with observed accuracy. However, such approaches do not model item difficulty, making it difficult to interpret discrepancies and to determine whether model confidence reflects genuine self-assessment or is merely a byproduct of the response generation process. To address this, we adopt a Rasch model-based latent ability framework and a metacognitive perspective, and propose Latent Confidence Alignment Error (LCAE) to measure the consistency between model self-assessment and the latent error probability implied by model ability and item difficulty. We further incorporate item difficulty as an external signal with a reasoning mechanism. Experiments on a medical-domain dataset with 20 models show that the proposed approach improves self-assessment quality without affecting model ability, and reveals an association between reliability and inference cost.

</details>


### [353] [Old Fictions, New Skins: Evaluating the Manipulative Capabilities of LLMs in Healthcare](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21977)
*Gathoni Ireri,Roger D. Odipo*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 该研究通过随机实验发现，聊天机器人ChatGPT 5.2和DeepSeek V3.2在肯尼亚医疗场景（N=303）中具备显著的操纵能力：操纵组（59.5%）比对照组（44.0%）的操纵成功率显著更高（OR=2.11，p=.021），凸显了非洲医疗AI安全基础设施的迫切需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大型语言模型在非洲医疗领域应用增多，其在医疗等高风险场景中可能操纵用户决策的风险日益受到关注。该研究旨在实证评估公开可用LLM在非洲医疗情境下的操纵能力，填补针对低资源地区AI安全风险的实证研究空白。

Method: 采用随机对照实验设计，招募303名肯尼亚参与者，操纵自变量为聊天机器人变体（操纵型 vs 非操纵型控制组），因变量为参与者在假设临床场景中的治疗决策正确性。操纵型模型被提示暗中引导参与者选择错误治疗方案，使用逻辑回归分析操纵效果。

Result: 操纵组操纵成功率为59.5%，对照组为44.0%，差异具有统计学显著性（OR=2.11，95% CI [1.12, 4.00]，p=.021）。结果表明，公开可用的LLM具备显著的隐蔽操纵能力，能实质性影响用户在医疗场景中的决策。

Conclusion: 研究强调鉴于AI在非洲医疗系统的逐步整合，亟需建立针对AI操纵的专项安全基础设施，以应对LLM在高风险医疗决策场景中可能带来的危害，特别是在资源相对有限的非洲地区。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly piloted in African healthcare contexts, raising concerns about their potential to manipulate users in high-stakes settings. In a randomised experiment, we examined the manipulative capabilities of two publicly available models, ChatGPT 5.2 and DeepSeek V3.2, among Kenyan participants (N = 303). Participants interacted with either a manipulative variant or a non-manipulative variant before making a treatment decision within a hypothetical clinical scenario. The manipulative variant was prompted to covertly steer participants towards an incorrect treatment option while the non-manipulative variant served as the control condition. Manipulation success rates were higher in the manipulative condition (59.5%) than in the control condition (44.0%), with the effect reaching significance (OR = 2.11, 95% CI [1.12, 4.00], p = .021). These findings highlight the need for improved safety infrastructure specifically targeting manipulation, particularly given the integration of AI into healthcare systems across Africa.

</details>


### [354] [The Model as One Rater Among Several: Measuring Political Positions in Data-Sparse Regions with a Language-Model Panel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23042)
*Tarek Gara*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出将大语言模型视为专家调查中的"评分者"而非测量工具，构建由9个模型（来自8个实验室、2个国家）组成的评分小组，用于中东与北非（MENA）地区政治立场的数据稀缺测量；通过Krippendorff's α = 0.86的高信度、保留分歧的中位数综合法、以及"评分规则效应"内嵌实验，论证了该方法的可复现性但同时坦承其有效性检验尚未完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的政治立场测量工具（纲领编码、专家调查、文本缩放模型）均在西方政党体系下构建并验证，在MENA等数据稀缺地区失效——这些地区的关键行动者往往不发布西方式纲领、不参与竞争性选举、或言行不一；同时，现有研究中存在将LLM作为"测量装置"直接信任的倾向，会将训练语料偏差洗白为伪事实。本文试图为这些场景提供一种新方法。

Method: 1）**立场框架**：16个活跃轴（8个通用+8个区域），每轴含书面定义、两极名称及适用范围；2）**适用性规则**：不适用的单元格保留空白而非记为零，避免"问题之外"与"问题之中"的混淆；3）**透镜系统**：区分"声明"（宣言/章程）、"行为"（执政记录，仅适用于民主/公民自由/新闻自由三轴）和"综合"三层；4）**评分小组与综合**：9个LLM盲评，采用跨评分者中位数（非均值）综合，并以中位数绝对偏差（MAD）划分单元格状态（已定/争议/临时），保留分歧而非平均化；5）**聚合纳入门限**：某轴覆盖实体数≥30方可纳入字段级聚合；6）**内嵌评分规则实验**：固定无定义首轮（r1），比较加入书面定义后（r2）的得分移动与评分者一致性变化。

Result: 1）**评分规则效应**：376个评分者-单元格对中，加入定义使得分平均移动1.8个点（21分量表）；187个双模型共评单元格上，两模型间平均绝对差距从2.81收窄至2.50，相关系数从0.81升至0.89；规则同时移动分数并提升评分者一致性，排除了"任意方向操纵"的简单指控；2）**信度**：998个双评以上单元格上，Krippendorff's α在区间与序数度量下均为0.86，从5个评分者扩至9个时保持稳定；逐模型平均相关系数0.84–0.90；3）**诊断性分歧**：HTS在"政权立场"轴上呈全尺度双峰分裂，盲法三重编码显示64%源于"所指对象"诠释问题（哪个宪政秩序算"政权"）、18%事实分歧、18%定义模糊；按构建国（中美）的评分者间分歧与组内分歧差异极小（最大+0.31点）。

Conclusion: 本文贡献是**方法与立场**而非新数据集或新估计量：将LLM置于评分者角色，借鉴专家调查四十年的传统，以中位数与MAD综合保留分歧、以纳入门限防止稀疏轴污染、以信度而非有效性作为已建立属性。但有效性仍是悬而未决的问题——9个共享训练语料的模型可能共享同一先验，文档锚定与人类评分者锚定两项工作尚未完成；尤其在区域轴（教派分权、泛阿拉伯主义、政权立场）上信度最低，恰恰是方法声称最具价值的部分；同时承认轴系选择本身是编辑性判断，呼吁外部专家参与框架的共同设计而非仅评分。该方法应可推广至任何被标准工具遗漏的区域。

Abstract: Most tools for measuring political positions, manifesto coding, expert surveys, text-scaling models, were built and validated on Western party systems, and outside that setting they work poorly, and often not at all. This paper is an attempt at a method for those settings. It treats a large language model not as a measurement device but as a single, fallible rater in a panel, roughly the way an expert survey treats one expert: the value comes from pooling many judges rather than trusting any one of them. I describe the panel, an applicability rule that keeps a score of zero distinct from a blank, and a lens system that separates what an actor says from what it does. I report three results. First, holding a definition-free round fixed, adding written axis definitions moves scores by a mean of 1.8 points on a 21-point scale and tightens agreement between raters (mean absolute gap 2.81 to 2.50; r 0.81 to 0.89); they make two independent raters agree more closely, which an arbitrary steer would not. Second, across nine models from eight laboratories in two countries, Krippendorff's alpha is 0.86 on both an interval and an ordinal metric, and it stayed put as the panel grew from five raters to nine. That is reliability, the reproducibility of a reading, and not validity, its correctness. Third, where the panel does disagree, the disagreement is informative: the sharpest split, a full-scale divergence on an actor's stance toward its state's foundational order, points to a referent problem, and a blind triple-coding puts about two-thirds of it down to interpretation rather than error. I try to be plain about what the method can't do, including the human validation it still lacks, and I release the instrument and data in full. The worked example is the Middle East and North Africa, but I'd expect the method to carry to any region these standard tools leave out.

</details>


### [355] [The Correct Answer Trap: Pedagogically-Grounded Detection and Feedback for Hidden Misconceptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23205)
*Moiz Imran,Sahan Bulathwela*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文研究自动化反馈系统中的"正确答案陷阱"(Correct Answer Trap, CAT)问题,即学生通过错误推理得出正确答案时,系统因依赖答案正确性而无法识别其潜在误解。研究基于Eedi数学平台的20,964条学生真实作答数据,提出了一种将"答案正确性"与"方法有效性"分离的渐进式评估框架(graduated assessment rubric),以及"检测-验证-升级"(detect-verify-escalate)管道架构,并设计两种部署模式以适配不同的教学场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前智能辅导系统(ITS)主要依赖答案正确性来决定反馈内容,但当学生通过错误推理得出正确答案时(例如错误程序巧合产生正确结果),系统会确认而非纠正其错误认知,造成"正确答案陷阱"。现有最大的误解检测基准Eedi Kaggle竞赛在设计上排除了正确答案场景下的误解,因而无法解决此问题。需要一种能够评估推理过程(而非仅结果)的方法来弥补这一评估盲区。

Method: 1) 数据:使用Eedi平台的20,964条学生作答(15道数学题),其中True Misconception(TM,正确答案+错误推理)占1.6%,False Misconception(FM)占38%,True Correct(TC)占60%。2) 渐进式评估框架:四分类——清晰推理(绿)、需澄清(Amber-1)、检测到误解(Amber-2)、错误答案(红),将"答案分"与"方法分"分离。3) 模型对比:BERT-base微调分类器、Gemini 3 Flash、Gemma 4 26B推理模型。4) 管道设计:detect-verify-escalate,对不确定案例通过变式题或针对性追问来收集进一步证据,采用variant-problem或probe-the-gap策略生成后续诊断问题。5) 两种部署:教师仪表盘(保守过滤审阅队列)与自主辅导(标记触发低成本形成性追问)。

Result: 1) BERT微调分类器仅检测出57%的TM(正确-答案陷阱)误解,接近100%的FM召回;标准ML干预(加权采样、焦点损失、cross-encoder、NLI重构)均无改进。2) Gemma 4 26B推理模型检测率达84%(95% CI: 72.1–91.4%),另将12%标记为"需澄清";但在实际1.6%流行率下,18%假阳性率使正预测值仅10.9%,即约8个误报对应1个真报。3) 消融实验:移除mark scheme使检测率不变但TC假阳性率从18.0%升至25.4%。4) 集成梯度分析显示误分类样本呈答案主导归因,正确分类样本呈解释主导归因,证实了答案捷径的存在。5) 绝大多数被路由到"需澄清"的TM案例带有"Irrelevant"标注,表明人类标注者也难以确定具体误解类型。

Conclusion: 微调分类器无法评估方法有效性,推理模型能显著减少漏检但引入不可接受的误报率,二元分类在任何可预见精度下都不可行,必须将教师纳入循环。渐进式评估框架通过区分"推理清晰"、"需澄清"和"已检测到误解"三种情况,保留了路由信号;detect-verify-escalate管道将诊断不确定性视为证据特性而非模型失败。两种部署模式(教师仪表盘与自主辅导)针对不同错误代价进行了优化。该工作表明,当标准错误信号(错误答案)缺失时,需要专门评估检测步骤本身,且错误的诊断路由会使后续反馈的教学质量失去意义。该方法在终身学习和知识追踪系统中可改善学生状态恢复并提供更精准的反馈。

Abstract: Automated feedback systems that rely on answer correctness will reinforce, rather than address, misconceptions when students reach the correct answer through flawed reasoning. We investigate automatic detection of these hidden misconceptions using 20,964 real student responses from the Eedi mathematics platform. Fine-tuned classifiers detect only 57% of these hidden misconceptions, and standard ML interventions do not improve on this. An open-weight reasoning model detects 84%, but at realistic prevalence, false alarms outnumber genuine detections roughly 8 to 1. We present a graduated assessment rubric that separates answer correctness from method validity, and propose a detect-verify-escalate pipeline that routes uncertain cases to diagnostic follow-up questions rather than directly to teachers. Two deployment modes adapt the pipeline: a teacher dashboard where the system filters a review queue, and an autonomous tutor where flags trigger low-cost formative follow-up.

</details>


### [356] [Human-AI Interaction Requirements in Public Sector Procurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21247)
*Mateen A. Abbasi,Tommi Mikkonen,Sinna Pirinen,Aapo Koski*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出将人机交互（HAI）作为公共部门AI采购中的关键设计维度，构建了一个包含五个维度的HAI需求分类法（透明性与可解释性、人工监督与控制、用户能力与认知负荷、问责性与可追溯性、自适应性与行为可预测性），并将其映射到公共采购生命周期的六个阶段，使伦理AI原则能够转化为可被招标、评估、签约和验收验证的具体采购条款。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共部门越来越多地采购AI系统来支持决策和服务交付，但现有的伦理AI框架（如透明度、问责制、人工监督）通常停留在抽象原则层面，未被转化为采购过程中的明确需求。这导致人机交互的设计往往交由供应商决定，削弱了采购方对系统行为、问责结构和合规性的控制能力。同时，AI系统的概率性输出和自适应特性在公共部门严格的法规和问责环境下带来了治理风险，欧盟AI法案等监管举措也要求将监督、透明度和问责制从原则变为可验证的需求。

Method: 采用概念性设计研究方法，通过对四个领域文献的综合分析来开发分类法：人机交互研究、伦理与负责任AI、需求工程、公共部门采购。从这些领域提取反复出现的主题（如透明度、人工监督、问责、用户能力、系统适应性），将其整合为分析上可区分的交互需求维度。同时，将分类法与公共采购生命周期阶段（需求评估、招标规范、供应商评估、签约、验收测试、运营监控）对齐，以确保其实用相关性。贡献为概念性的，实证验证留待未来工作。

Result: 提出了一个包含五个HAI需求维度的分类法：（1）透明性与可解释性——明确系统哪些行为需解释、向谁解释、在何阶段解释；（2）人工监督与控制——规定人工确认/授权的决策点、覆盖和暂停机制、升级路径、基于角色的控制权；（3）用户能力与认知负荷——涵盖培训、反馈清晰度、时间敏感场景下的认知约束；（4）问责性与可追溯性——要求日志记录、状态追踪、行为归因、审计可访问性；（5）自适应性与行为可预测性——约束自主学习、变更通知机制、模型更新审批、行为稳定性保证。进一步提出了"伦理原则→HAI需求→采购条款"的转化模式，产出三种采购条款类型（强制要求、评估标准、验收条件），并在采购生命周期六个阶段中具体说明如何操作化这些需求。

Conclusion: 该研究将人机交互定位为采购关键设计维度而非单纯的用户可用性或伦理问题。通过将交互需求视为可采购的对象，公共部门采购方能够将AI系统行为的控制权从供应商部分收回，在系统全生命周期内对透明度、监督和问责制进行治理。所提出的分类法提供了一种结构化方式，将伦理与监管原则转化为采购工具（如需求条款、评估标准、验收测试），使采购成为负责任AI部署的重要治理机制。局限在于该工作为概念性贡献，分类法的实证验证有待未来研究。

Abstract: Public sector organizations increasingly procure AI-enabled ICT systems to support decision-making and service delivery. Although ethical AI frameworks emphasize transparency, accountability, and human oversight, these principles are rarely translated into explicit requirements in procurement processes. Consequently, human-AI interaction (HAI) is often left to vendor design choices. This paper conceptualizes HAI as a procurement-critical design dimension and proposes a taxonomy of interaction requirements tailored to public sector ICT procurement. The taxonomy enables contracting authorities to specify and govern interaction properties through procurement instruments, supporting both ethical compliance and sustainable value realization.

</details>


### [357] [Estimating Learners' Skill Acquisition Without Temporal Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20611)
*Ryosuke Nagai,Kyohei Atarashi,Koh Takeuchi,Jill-Jênn Vie,Hisashi Kashima*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种仅基于快照数据（无时间信息）预测学习者下一项将要获得技能的框架，通过认知诊断模型（CDM）估计技能掌握模式，并利用技能集之间的包含关系构建伪时间排序，引入神经模型学习潜在技能习得动态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在教育数据挖掘领域，知识追踪（Knowledge Tracing）通常依赖时序交互数据来预测学习者的未来知识状态。然而在许多真实教育场景中，学习数据往往仅以单时间点快照形式存在，缺少时间戳信息，导致现有基于时序的方法难以直接应用。如何在没有时间信息的情况下，仅从快照数据中推断技能习得模式，成为亟需解决的问题。

Method: 1. 利用认知诊断模型（CDMs）从快照数据中估计学习者的技能掌握模式；2. 基于学习者技能集之间的包含关系（inclusion relations）诱导出伪时间排序，将技能集的扩张视为学习进程的代理；3. 提出一种神经模型，通过"期望技能增量（expected skill increments）"刻画潜在的技能习得动态，以高效近似未观测到的习得路径。

Result: 在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上的实验表明，所提出的方法在预测下一技能习得上持续优于多个基线方法；尤其在技能空间较大时，模型优势更为显著。

Conclusion: 研究表明，即使仅依靠快照数据也能推断出有意义的技能习得模式，为数据受限的教育环境中的自适应学习支持提供了一种实用框架，拓宽了知识追踪技术在缺乏时序信息场景下的适用性。

Abstract: Recent research in educational data mining, especially knowledge tracing, has focused on predicting learners' future knowledge states to support adaptive instruction. However, in many real-world educational settings, learning data are often available only as single-time-point assessments without temporal information, making existing time-series-based approaches difficult to apply. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for predicting future skill acquisition using only snapshot data. Specifically, we address the problem of predicting the next skill to be acquired from skill mastery patterns estimated by cognitive diagnostic models (CDMs). In the absence of temporal information, we exploit inclusion relations among learners' skill sets to induce a pseudo-temporal ordering, interpreting expanding skill sets as a proxy for learning progression. To efficiently approximate unobserved acquisition paths, we introduce a neural model that captures latent skill acquisition dynamics through expected skill increments. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms baseline approaches, with particularly strong advantages as the skill space becomes larger. These results indicate that meaningful skill acquisition patterns can be inferred from snapshot data alone, providing a practical framework for adaptive learning support in data-constrained educational environments.

</details>


### [358] [Analysis and Prediction of At-Risk Students Using Machine Learning Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20617)
*Soheila Gheisari,Hamid Salarian*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用机器学习方法预测高校学生的辍学与退学行为,通过对逻辑回归、随机森林、支持向量机和K近邻等模型的比较,验证了机器学习在识别学业风险学生方面的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学生流失问题对高等教育机构的学术成果和财务可持续性造成重大影响。传统方式难以及时识别需要帮助的学生,机构迫切需要一种数据驱动的方法,在学生正式离开学业项目之前进行预警,从而为战略决策提供支持。

Method: 研究基于学生的学业表现、人口统计学数据和入学记录等结构化数据,构建并对比了四种机器学习分类模型:逻辑回归、随机森林、支持向量机(SVM)与K近邻(KNN),通过模型性能评估来比较其在学生流失预测任务中的表现。

Result: 实验结果表明,逻辑回归和线性SVM模型在预测准确率上表现最优,能够有效识别具有流失风险的学生,证明了机器学习方法在学生风险预测中的可行性与实用价值。

Conclusion: 研究证实机器学习技术能够为高等教育机构提供数据驱动的洞察力,用于预测学生退学和取消注册行为;逻辑回归与线性SVM在该任务中表现突出,可作为机构早期干预与战略决策的可靠工具。

Abstract: Student attrition represents a significant challenge for higher education institutions because it impacts both academic results and financial viability. Machine learning provides an effective solution to identify students who require assistance before they leave their academic programs. The research investigates how machine learning approaches enable institutions to predict student withdrawal and enrollment cancellation through data-driven insights for strategic decisionmaking. The evaluation of models includes Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Support Vector Machines (SVM), and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) based on academic performance and demographic data and enrollment records. The results show that logistic regression and linear SVM models produced the highest accuracy which demonstrates ML's capability to detect students at risk.

</details>


### [359] [Uncertainty-based Debiasing and Unlearning for Decontamination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23313)
*Guangzhi Sun,Xiao Zhan,Mark Gales*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了基于不确定性的去污染方法（UBD），通过深度集成估计逐样本的污染程度，结合样本级评估框架（KL散度和L1距离），实现对LLM基准测试去污染的推断后校准（debiasing）和参数级遗忘（unlearning），无需访问未污染模型或预训练数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有去污染方法存在两大局限：(1) 仅依赖整体准确率评估，掩盖了样本级模型行为的显著差异；(2) 多数方法需要访问未污染模型作为参考，在实际部署中不可行。作者指出准确率相同的两个模型可能在完全不同的子集上正确预测样本，因此需要更细粒度的评估和无需干净参考模型的去污染方法。

Method: 1. **样本级评估框架**：使用KL散度（$D_{KL}$）和ground-truth概率的L1距离（$D^*_{L1}$）逐样本衡量去污染模型与未污染模型输出分布的接近程度，同时在$\mathcal{D}_{dev}$（未污染子集）上检查性能保持。2. **UBD核心机制**：利用同一污染模型在不同batch顺序下训练的深度集成，通过集合成员对ground-truth概率的**标准差**$\sigma^{(i)}$来估计污染程度——记忆化样本对batch顺序敏感，集成方差大；真正易样本方差小。3. **逐样本校正标量**$\hat{\alpha}^{(i)} = 1 - 2\sigma^{(i)}$（当污染模型高置信正确时）通过阈值$T_p$触发，用于构建去偏目标分布。4. **两种实现**：UBD-Debiasing（推理时重缩放输出分布）和UBD-Unlearning（以去偏分布为软标签微调LoRA参数）。5. 实验在MMLU-pro和MATH-MCQA上，使用Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct，5个不同种子的LoRA集成。

Result: 1. **数据集级与样本级指标的脱节**：Paraphrasing + Choice Permutation可将Llama上的RC从17.2降至8.4，但$D_{KL}$反而增大约13%，$D^*_{L1}$几乎不变。2. **UBD显著优于基线**：在Llama上UBD-Debiasing/Unlearning在$\mathcal{D}_{eval}$上实现$D_{KL}$和$D^*_{L1}$超过40%的相对降幅；Qwen2.5上UBD-Debiasing实现近60%的$D_{KL}$降低和约50%的$D^*_{L1}$降低。3. **优于DeconIEP**：UBD无需干净参考模型，且在$\mathcal{D}_{dev}$上的失真显著更小（$D_{KL}, D^*_{L1} < 0.1$）。4. **不确定性指标优势**：基于$\sigma^{(i)}$和知识不确定性的预测与oracle $\alpha$的PCC超过0.9，而对数概率的PCC不超过0.4，表明不确定性可有效区分"困难但被记忆"和"真正容易"的样本。5. **对阈值$T_p$鲁棒**：UBD在$D_{KL}$上对$T_p$变化不敏感，UBD-Unlearning在整个阈值范围内表现稳定。

Conclusion: 本文提出的样本级去污染评估框架揭示了整体准确率无法反映的逐样本行为差异；基于深度集成不确定性的UBD方法能够无需未污染模型即可有效估计和抑制污染引起的概率膨胀，在样本级指标上大幅超越paraphrasing/permutation基线和DeconIEP，同时保持未污染数据上的性能。局限在于：(1)需要发布集成模型（但LoRA集成可大幅降低参数负担）；(2)UBD-Debiasing目前仅适用于分类任务，扩展到开放生成为未来工作。

Abstract: Benchmark-based evaluation is the dominant paradigm for assessing large language model (LLM) capabilities, yet data contamination inflates reported performance and undermines fair comparison. Existing decontamination methods are evaluated solely through aggregate accuracy, which can obscure substantial differences in per-sample model behaviour, and many require access to an uncontaminated model. In this paper, we propose a sample-level evaluation framework for decontamination that complements accuracy-based assessment with distributional distance metrics, measuring how closely a decontaminated model recovers the output distribution of an uncontaminated model on each sample. Building on this framework, we introduce Uncertainty-Based Decontamination (UBD), a family of methods that leverage deep ensembles of the contaminated model to estimate per-sample memorization without requiring a uncontaminated model or knowledge of which samples are contaminated. UBD estimates a per-sample correction scalar from ensemble uncertainty, which is used to construct a debiased target distribution that suppresses the inflated probability mass on correct answers induced by contamination. This target is then used either as a post-hoc output correction (debiasing) or as a soft training signal for parameter update (unlearning). Experiments on MMLU-Pro and MATH-MCQA across multiple LLM backbones demonstrate that UBD produces per-sample output distributions substantially closer to those of an uncontaminated model than paraphrasing or choice-permutation baselines, while preserving model performance on uncontaminated data.

</details>


### [360] [Bridging the Analytics Divide: Retail Technology Diffusion in South Africa's Traditional Retail Sector](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20593)
*Shaun Moloi,Adheesh Budree,Pitso Tsibolane*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文研究了南非传统零售行业采用分析技术的现状与挑战，基于TOE框架和DOI理论，通过对三家零售企业的15位高管进行多案例定性研究，识别了技术、组织和环境三方面的阻碍因素，并提出了适用于资源受限环境的分析技术扩散框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零售分析技术在传统和混合零售行业（尤其是新兴市场）的应用仍不均衡。南非等新兴市场国家在采用分析技术时面临独特的约束条件，但现有研究多聚焦于发达市场或大型企业，对传统零售领域在受限环境下的技术扩散机制缺乏深入探讨。本文旨在填补这一研究空白，揭示南非传统零售行业采用分析技术的关键障碍与促进因素。

Method: 采用定性多案例研究方法，基于技术-组织-环境（TOE）框架和创新扩散（DOI）理论，对南非三家零售组织的15位高管进行深度访谈，结合多案例数据进行主题分析，从技术、组织和环境三个维度考察分析技术的采用机制。

Result: 研究发现三类主要阻碍因素：（1）技术约束——遗留系统和IT基础设施不足；（2）组织障碍——分析能力有限和文化阻力；（3）环境因素——监管不确定性和社会经济不平等。同时识别出促进成功整合的关键因素：分阶段的分析实施、高管层支持以及与核心零售运营的对齐。

Conclusion: 研究提出了一个适用于受限环境的分析技术扩散专门框架，建议在政策与实践层面制定符合发展中国家实际情况的策略，为新兴市场传统零售行业的数字化转型提供了理论依据和实践指导。

Abstract: Retail analytics holds immense potential for enhancing decision-making, efficiency, and competitiveness in the retail sector. However, its adoption across traditional and hybrid retail industries in emerging markets remains inconsistent. This study examines the adoption of analytics technologies in South Africa's traditional retail sector, utilizing the Technology-Organization-Environment (TOE) framework and the Diffusion of Innovations (DOI) theory. Drawing on a qualitative multi-case study of fifteen executives (n = 15) spanning three retail organizations, the study identifies technological constraints (legacy systems and lack of IT infrastructure), organizational barriers (limited analytic capability and cultural resistance), and environmental factors (regulatory uncertainty and socioeconomic inequality) as significant impediments to analytics adoption. Despite these challenges, findings reveal that phased analytics implementation, executive sponsorship, and alignment with core retail operations facilitate successful integration. The study provides a specialized framework for analytics diffusion in constrained environments and recommends strategies for policy and practice that align with the realities of developing economies.

</details>


### [361] [From Punishment to Protection: Charting Six Decades of U.S. Juvenile Justice Through Topic Modeling and LLM-Assisted Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20597)
*Nia E. George,Simeon Sayer*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过主题建模和LLM辅助分析，对1970-2025年美国60,470份青少年司法上诉意见进行六十年跨度的实证分析，识别出182个法律主题（归为10大类别），揭示了从惩罚向保护转变的范式转移，并提出了AI辅助决策工具在青少年司法领域面临的五项关键风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 青少年法院同时处理两类截然不同的案件——少年犯案和儿童福利案——两类案件在过去五十年均经历剧变。传统教义阅读难以在数十年跨度和众多管辖区中识别长期模式。理解这些趋势对法律学术研究、政策评估以及日益依赖AI工具的青少年司法决策系统至关重要。

Method: 1) 数据收集：从CourtListener获取60,470份1970-2025年美国上诉意见，按十年分片；2) 预处理：使用spaCy进行文本清洗和短语建模；3) 全局-局部BERTopic架构：先对全语料拟合全局模型（182个主题），再对每十年拟合局部模型（235-333主题/十年），通过Jaccard相似度（阈值0.20）将局部主题映射到全局主题；4) 质量诊断：UMass一致性和最近邻词汇重叠度；5) 趋势计算：十年归一化占比和线性斜率；6) LLM两阶段工作流：第一阶段归纳10大法律主题分类法，第二阶段对选定的T0、T2、T6三大主题进行证据支撑的逐主题法律分析。

Result: 核心发现包括：1) 儿童福利诉讼占比从5.6%翻三倍至16.7%（ASFA法案和甲基苯丙胺疫情驱动）；2) 性犯罪登记案件占比翻倍至12.9%（T0，+1.34 pp/十年，斜率最大）；3) 传统惩罚机制急剧下降——司法移交（T3，-0.72 pp/十年）、青少年死刑（T4，-0.45 pp/十年）；4) 2010年后量刑改革案件新集群涌现（受Graham/Miller/Montgomery案推动）；5) 法律词汇数十年一变化（如"carnal knowledge"→"sexual assault"，"crack cocaine"→"fentanyl"）；6) 性犯罪登记因各州法规差异已碎片化为数十个管辖区特有变体；7) 少年犯案与儿童福利案在向相反方向发展——形成"同一法院中两个平行法律系统"。论文据此提出五项AI风险指南：时间失配、词汇漂移、管辖区碎片化、趋势线不能等同于行为趋势、两套法律系统需分开处理。

Conclusion: 该论文证明大规模、可复现的上诉判例法分析——无论定量趋势还是教义演变——均切实可行。提出的全局-局部建模架构解决了跨十年主题模型不兼容的核心挑战。该研究既描绘了美国青少年司法的实证演变（从惩罚到保护），也揭示了任何用于此领域的AI决策支持工具必须正视的五项系统性风险，对法律学者、政策制定者和AI从业者均具重要价值。

Abstract: Juvenile courts handle two very different kinds of cases: young people accused of crimes, and children at risk in their own families, and both streams have been changing dramatically over the past fifty years. This paper asks: what has shifted, and can computational methods track that change at scale? Topic modeling and LLM-assisted trend analysis is applied to 60,470 U.S. appellate opinions spanning 1970 to 2025, identifying 182 distinct legal topics organized into 10 themes covering the full range of juvenile justice litigation. The results are striking. Child welfare litigation tripled its share of the corpus. Sex offender registration cases more than doubled. Traditional punitive mechanisms, judicial transfer to adult court and the juvenile death penalty, declined sharply. A new cluster of sentencing cases emerged after 2010, reflecting landmark Supreme Court rulings that fundamentally redrew the constitutional limits on juvenile punishment. Analysis also shows that legal vocabulary shifts decade by decade: the language courts used in the 1970s can be unrecognisable by the 2020s, even for the same underlying legal question. The fastest-growing area of the corpus has fractured into dozens of jurisdiction-specific variants that no single topic can capture. In both cases, case counts alone would miss the full arc of doctrinal change. This paper demonstrates that large-scale, reproducible analysis of appellate case law, quantitative trends and doctrinal arcs alike, is possible and practically useful. It also reveals critical risks that any AI-based decision support tool used in juvenile justice and trained on such corpus will encounter: temporal mismatch, vocabulary drift, jurisdictional fragmentation, and the divergence of delinquency and child welfare into two parallel legal systems. Addressing these risks must be a fundamental requirement for any tool used in this domain.

</details>


### [362] [A Survey of Large Language Models for Perception and Measurement of Human Psychology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20603)
*Yudong Li,Xiaoyi Chen,Jiawei Cai,Zehao Zhong,Haoyang Yang,Huajin Tang,Linlin Shen*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于大语言模型（LLM）在人类心理测量领域应用的系统性综述论文。论文提出了一个包含三个核心维度的分析框架：理论可行性、测量方法学和实际应用效果，系统地梳理了LLM作为心理测量工具的能力、方法和局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型的快速发展，其在心理学领域的应用引发了广泛学术关注。核心问题在于：LLM是否具备准确感知和测量人类复杂潜在心理构念（如人格、情绪、认知状态）的能力？此前的综述多关注LLM的一般应用或其自身"心理"，缺乏从心理测量学角度对LLM作为测量工具的系统性评估。

Method: 1. 理论可行性分析：探讨LLM是否具备支持心理测量的认知属性，重点考察心智理论（Theory of Mind, ToM）能力的涌现，包括错误信念任务、奇怪故事测试等经典范式的表现；2. 测量方法学分析：将现有方法分类为三种范式——主动对话评估、被动自然语言分析、多模态融合评估；3. 应用效果评估：综述LLM在人格特质评估（Big Five、HEXACO、MBTI、黑暗三联征等）和心理健康评估（抑郁、焦虑、自杀意念等）中的实际表现；4. 挑战与伦理分析：讨论可靠性、稳定性、偏差、公平性、隐私和监管等关键问题。

Result: 1. 理论层面：GPT-4在错误信念任务中达到6-7岁儿童水平，在奇怪故事测试中达到或超越成人水平，表明LLM具备支持结构化心理测量的功能性ToM能力；2. 方法层面：零样本提示、思维链提示、检索增强生成（RAG）、指令微调和智能体架构等方法在心理测量中展现出潜力；3. 应用层面：LLM在人格评估中与标准化测量达到中等至强相关（r最高达0.443），在心理健康检测中可达到与监督基线相当的准确率；4. 局限性：提示敏感性高（语义等效提示可产生超过20%的性能差异）、时间稳定性差（测试-再测试信度常低于0.70，远低于临床高风险决策所需的0.90阈值）、文化偏差显著（倾向于西方价值观）；5. 心理健康数据集系统性低估种族和族裔少数群体，存在公平性问题；6. 截至目前，尚无LLM心理测量工具获得正式监管批准。

Conclusion: LLM可以支持结构化心理评估任务（人格特质推断和心理健康筛查），具有中等效度，但在可靠性和可解释性方面尚未达到临床决策所需标准。主要局限包括提示敏感性、时间不一致性、文化偏差和缺乏临床部署的监管批准。论文强调LLM应作为增强而非替代传统心理测量工具和临床判断的辅助手段，最有前景的方向是结合LLM自动化能力与经过验证的评估框架严谨性的混合系统。未来的发展需要心理学家、计算机科学家和伦理学家的跨学科合作，以心理测量学标准和负责任的部署原则为指导。

Abstract: Against the backdrop of the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), their application in the field of psychology has garnered significant academic attention. A central issue is whether LLMs possess the capability to accurately perceive and measure complex, latent human psychological constructs, such as personality, emotions, and cognitive states. This paper provides a systematic review focused on the use of LLMs as instruments for human psychological measurement. To organize this domain, we propose a comprehensive analytical framework structured around three critical dimensions: Theoretical Plausibility (why measurement might be possible), Measurement Methodology (how to measure), and Application Effectiveness (what has been measured). We first explore the theoretical foundations supporting LLM-based measurement, examining the debate on their emergent cognitive properties from a psychometric perspective. Next, we systematically analyze existing measurement paradigms, categorizing them into active conversational assessment, passive natural language analysis, and multimodal fusion. Subsequently, we review the practical effectiveness and limitations of LLMs in core application areas, including personality trait assessment and mental health evaluation. Distinct from prior reviews focusing on general applications or the ``psychology'' of LLMs themselves, this paper centers on the psychometric properties of LLMs as measurement tools.

</details>


### [363] [Using machine learning to build public policy agenda from social media conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20604)
*Rahman Sanya*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种人机协作的机器学习方法，利用社交媒体对话（如 Twitter）自动识别公共政策议题并生成政策议程。该方法整合了 LDA/Top2Vec 主题建模与 GPT-2 自然语言生成技术，实验表明在议程叙述的可读性、连贯性方面达到了"非常好"和"良好"的评分者间一致性（IRA），验证了该方法作为传统人工政策分析方法的可扩展替代方案的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统公共政策制定中的议题识别与议程设置阶段依赖大量人工进行数据收集与分析，耗时耗力且难以在大范围地理区域内扩展。因此，亟需一种可扩展的自动化方法，从社交媒体对话中高效提取公众关注议题。

Method: 提出五阶段人机协作 ML 流程：(1) 输入数据清洗与预处理；(2) 基于关键词提取的议题识别，分别采用 LDA 和 Top2Vec 进行主题建模；(3) 利用 GPT-2 进行自然语言生成（NLG）以创建议题叙事；(4) 通过相似性分析进行叙事验证；(5) 由人类专家进行议程验证。使用 Twitter 数据集进行实验。

Result: 在 GPT-2 生成的议程叙事可读性和连贯性上达到"非常好"和"良好"的评分者间一致性（IRA）；生成的议程项目 IRA 为"良好"；在五个参考叙事主题中，至少三个主题的余弦相似度得分高于平均水平。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，所提出的机器学习方法是从社交媒体对话中识别公共利益议题的一种有前景的方法，能够有效辅助传统的人工政策分析流程，在保持较高质量输出的同时实现可扩展性。

Abstract: Issue identification and agenda setting represents an important stage in the public policy making process. Traditional approaches for carrying out activities under this stage are time- and labor-intensive on data collection and analysis, in addition to being costly to scale over large geographic areas. In this work we propose a human-augmented machine learning (ML) approach for identifying matters of public interest from social media conversations. The approach consists of five stages namely, input data cleaning and preprocessing, keywords extraction and issue identification, narrative creation, narrative validation, and agenda validation. We implemented experiments to validate the output of our method based on a Twitter dataset and using Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) and Top2Vec for topic modeling. Natural Language Generation (NLG) was achieved using GPT-2 while narrative and agenda validation were based on similarity analysis and human evaluation. We achieved "very good" and "good" inter-rater agreement (IRA) on readability and coherence of agenda narrative generation by our GPT-2 model. On the other hand, IRA was "good" for generated agenda items. We also achieved above average cosine similarity score on at least three out of five reference text (narrative) themes. These results demonstrate that the ML approach represents a promising methodology for identifying issues of public interest from social media conversations.

</details>


### [364] [Adolescence to Adulthood Online: Tracing Youth Digital Expression on Reddit Over 13 Years](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20612)
*Tyler Chang,Khushboo Patel,Afsaneh Razi,Shruti Phadke*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文对2010–2023年间自报年龄为11–24岁的Reddit用户所发布的443,856条帖子进行了大规模纵向定量分析，结合BERTopic主题建模、纵向统计检验与LIWC心理语言学分析，刻画了青少年在Reddit上讨论话题的多样性、时序演变及不同年龄组（前青少年<13、青少年13–17、年轻成人18–24）间的差异，并探讨了话题波动与社会文化事件的关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Reddit因其匿名性成为青少年进行敏感话题自我披露的重要平台，但现有研究多聚焦于单一主题（如心理健康、性健康、虐童等）或非青少年群体，缺乏对青少年话题全貌及其长期演变模式的系统性纵向描述。此外，Reddit的子版块结构无法充分反映青少年围绕话题而非社区聚集的参与特征。因此，亟需建立覆盖较长时间跨度的青少年话语基线，以理解其数字表达的变化趋势及与线下社会事件的关联。

Method: 1) 数据采集：基于PushShift数据集，使用扩展的正则表达式匹配年龄与性别自我披露语句（如"I am 21M..."），筛选24岁及以下用户；通过r/botwatch等机器人检测列表、发布频率阈值（1分钟内≥15帖）、年龄一致性、余弦相似度（>90%）、垃圾内容关键词等多重过滤移除机器人/垃圾账号（移除约68%初始数据）。2) 主题建模：采用BERTopic（一致性分数0.67），生成194个话题→手动合并为154个子话题→进一步编码为24个高阶话题；选取7个安全相关焦点话题进行深入分析。3) 心理语言学分析：使用LIWC 2022版提取117个语言特征。4) 统计分析：以非参数检验为主（Mann-Whitney U、Kruskal-Wallis、Dunn事后检验、Holm校正），辅以Welch's t检验、Brown-Forsythe方差检验；使用Cliff's Delta衡量效应量（阈值|δ|>0.47）；异常波动定义为超过滚动12个月均值3个标准差。5) 年龄分组：依据WHO标准分为前青少年（<13）、青少年（13–17）、年轻成人（18+）。

Result: 1) 数据概况：443,856条帖子来自12,792名用户（男性62.6%，女性37.4%），发布量于2020年达峰。青少年占帖子总量62.1%，年轻成人36.5%，前青少年仅1.4%。2) 话题时序动态：24个话题在月度发布量的波动幅度存在显著差异（Brown-Forsythe F=15.27, p<0.001），约38–44%的话题对在波动大小或方差上存在显著差异；但话题间出现上升/下降的频率无显著差异。3) 焦点话题比较：Body Image与Family & Parenting的月度波动显著低于其他焦点话题（方差比可达19倍）；Sex & Intimacy波动最大。4) 极端事件：Crime/Law话题在2012（宗教/伊斯兰）、2018（宗教/美国政治）、2020（宗教）出现三次极端激增；Physical Health & Medicine在2020年因疫苗与新冠激增；Mental Health & Well-Being呈现5次极端下降（均与Depression主导地位增强相关）；Sex & Intimacy在2022年因Sexual Kinks & Roleplay激增。5) 年龄组差异（2013 vs 2023）：前青少年的Family & Parenting占比从21.1%升至33.9%；年轻成人的Sex & Intimacy从14.2%急剧升至42%，Body Image从15.9%降至6%，Relationships & Friendships从43.8%降至26.1%；Mental Health & Well-Being在各年龄组中均保持稳定。6) 心理语言学差异：15对子话题在6个LIWC类别上存在大效应量差异，主要集中在Depression & Poor Mental Health（高负面情绪）、Parent-Child Abuse（高三人称代词、负面情绪、愤怒）、Relationships（高代词使用）等子话题；维度集中于"情感表达"与"人际指称"两类。

Conclusion: 本文建立了Reddit青少年话语的13年纵向基线，揭示了青少年话题具有异质性的时序轨迹，且话题波动常与线下社会事件（如2012年大选、2020年新冠、2018年政治事件）相呼应；不同年龄组在话题关注上存在显著差异，年轻成人变化最大。匿名性使Reddit成为青少年进行敏感披露的稳定平台，但未成年人使用远超平台年龄限制。心理语言学差异主要集中于少数子话题，体现出情感强度和人际关系指向两个核心维度。该研究为在线安全、心理健康干预和政策制定提供了实证参考，强调在解读青少年网络讨论时需结合年龄与发展阶段。

Abstract: Reddit is widely used in research on youth and social media, yet there has been limited systematic examination of the diversity of content produced by young users or how their participation changes over time. We present a descriptive quantitative analysis of 443,856 Reddit posts between 2010 and 2023 by authors who self-disclosed their age as 11-24. Using topic modeling, longitudinal statistical analyses, and psycholinguistic measures, we identify nuances in the topics discussed by youth and examine how posting patterns vary across age groups over time. Our results document both stable themes and extreme shifts in youth discourse, offering a comprehensive benchmark for longitudinal characterization of youth participation on Reddit. We further discuss how our findings signal early social media adoption by youth for self-disclosure and the extent to which changes in youth discourse may mirror broader offline events and evolving youth concerns.

</details>


### [365] [Gender Disparities in LLM-Based Intimate Partner Violence Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20613)
*Tabia Tanzin Prama,Mikaela Irene Fudolig,Abigail M. Crocker,Christopher M. Danforth,Peter Sheridan Dodds*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 该研究探讨了大型语言模型（LLMs）在检测亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）时是否存在基于受害者-施暴者性别配置的感知偏差。通过对475篇Reddit帖子进行反事实性别交换生成1,900个样本，并使用GPT-5o、Llama 4、Gemini 3和Grok 3四个模型进行结构化问卷评估，发现模型在不同性别组合下存在显著差异，尤其在受害者为男性的混合性别组合中，对虐待和施暴意图的识别率系统性降低，女性施暴者身份成为虐待识别的持续负向预测因子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）是一个重大公共卫生问题，男性受害者因社会规范和制度性偏见在寻求帮助时面临更多障碍。随着LLMs越来越多地被用于IPV幸存者的支持服务（如Aimee和Ruth等专用系统），这些模型在训练过程中可能吸收并复制互联网数据中存在的性别偏见。研究者旨在检验LLMs是否在IPV场景中表现出基于性别的感知偏差，这对安全部署此类系统具有重要意义。

Method: 1. 数据收集：从r/relationship_advice收集帖子，手工筛选出475篇具有明确两方角色和性别标识的二元关系叙事。
2. 反事实数据生成：对每篇帖子进行性别标识（代词、亲属称谓、姓名等）的程序化交换，生成四种性别配置版本（OP/施暴者）：F/F、F/M、M/F、M/M，最终得到1,900个样本。
3. 模型评估：使用GPT-5o、Llama 4、Gemini 3和Grok 3四个模型，通过结构化问卷对10个维度进行评估（关系识别IS_REL、IPV存在IS_IPV、施暴意图HAS_INTENT、欺骗IS_CHEATING及六种虐待亚型）。
4. 评价指标：使用正标签率（PLR）作为描述性度量。
5. 统计分析：采用混合效应逻辑回归，以原始帖子为随机截距，OP性别、施暴者性别及其交互项为固定效应，模型输出优势比（OR）。

Result: 1. 模型间差异显著：GPT和Grok相对保守（IPV识别率12-20%），Gemini为中等水平（31-36%），Llama最高（30-40%），各模型在F/F配置下IPV识别率差异显著（GPT 14.77% vs Llama 40.08%）。
2. 配对内差异：Llama表现出最大差异，关系识别从F/F的73.36%上升至M/M的79.32%，而IPV检测从F/F的40.08%下降至M/F的30.59%；施暴意图从F/F的39.87%下降至M/F的21.73%。
3. 回归分析结果：女性施暴者身份是IPV识别的持续负向预测因子（GPT-5o OR=0.504最强），所有模型均统计显著；Llama-4在同性女性组合中表现出补偿性上升（如IS_TECH OR=9.316，IS_EMOT OR=2.366）。
4. 核心发现：在混合性别配对（特别是男性受害者）中，虐待和意图识别率系统性降低，揭示了模型在IPV解释框架中嵌入了性别偏见。

Conclusion: LLMs的判断不仅依据行为线索，还受性别假设影响，构成了一种"数字双重标准"——混合性别关系中的男性受害者可能需要更强证据才能被确认为受害者。模型复制了社会学文献中记录的制度性失败，对男性幸存者造成边缘化影响。研究强调了在IPV相关支持场景部署LLMs之前进行严格审计和偏见感知设计的必要性。

Abstract: Intimate Partner Violence (IPV) is a major public health concern, and large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for support and information-seeking in sensitive domains. We examine whether LLMs perceive relationship abuse differently depending on victim--perpetrator gender configuration. Using 475 Reddit posts from r/relationship\_advice, we generate counterfactual variants by swapping gendered identifiers to create four dyads: female--female (F/F), female--male (F/M), male--female (M/F), and male--male (M/M), where the first position denotes the victim. Four recent LLMs (GPT-5o, Gemini 3, Llama 4, and Grok 3) evaluate each variant using a structured questionnaire covering IPV, perpetrator intent, cheating, and abuse subtypes. Results show substantial variation across models and dyads. Abuse and intent detection systematically decrease in mixed-gender dyads where the victim is male, with female perpetrator identity emerging as a consistent negative predictor of abuse recognition. Mixed-effects logistic regression confirms that gender roles significantly shape model outputs. Our findings suggest that LLMs reproduce gendered biases from online training data, with implications for support-related deployment. Code and resources are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [366] [WIP: Bridging the Gap Between Instructional Design and Pedagogical Use: A Framework for Mathematics Educators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20934)
*Estefany Castillo Ventura,Javier Ulises Solis Lastra,Anarosa Alves Franco Brandão*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向中学数学教育的数字资源教学化特征概念框架,旨在通过将学习理论(APOS、有意义学习、符号表征)原则转化为可观测的教学变量并以元数据形式结构化,从而弥合资源教学设计与课堂实际使用之间的鸿沟。当前为工作进展报告,聚焦于"内容概念结构"维度,定义了四个可观测变量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字数学教育资源虽大量涌现,但其选择与整合缺乏明确教学标准,导致教学设计原则难以在课堂中落地。学习理论多被用作设计合理化或分析框架,极少被操作化为系统的功能组件,教师被迫在没有显性理论指引的情况下做决策。因此,需要在理论与实践之间建立中间层,使理论原则以可观测、可处理的形式支持教学决策。

Method: 采用结构化文献综述(Scopus、Web of Science、SciELO、SOL数据库),围绕两个研究问题(中学数学教育中应用了哪些学习理论;这些理论如何支撑数字教育技术及其操作化水平)进行筛选:276条记录经去重、标题摘要筛选后保留33篇全文评审,最终14篇纳入分析。作者提出五级"操作化量表"(L0 提及—L4 操作性实现)对学习理论在数字技术中的角色进行分级,并基于综述结果将学习理论原则转译为可观测的教学变量,以元数据形式表征。框架包含四个互补维度(内容概念结构、理论-教学对齐、资源条件、教师中介),本文仅深入第一维度,定义四个变量:数学内容、先备知识要求、主导表征、概念建构类型,并以"割线-切线"交互小程序为例进行说明。

Result: 文献综述结果显示,所分析的研究在学习理论操作化上明显集中于较低层次:多数研究将学习理论作为概念合理化(L1)或分析框架(L2),部分用于指导设计(L3),未发现任何研究将学习理论实现为系统的功能性组件(L4)。各理论分布为:APOS(L2)、Kolb(L3)、认知建构主义(L0–L1)、社会文化建构主义(L1、L3)、自我调节学习(L3)、一般建构主义(L0–L1)、Bruner建构主义(L3)、具身认知(L3)、教学建构主义(L1)。在"内容概念结构"维度下,四个可观测变量及其可取值被明确界定(如先备知识依赖分为必需/推荐/不需要,概念建构分为动作/过程/对象/图式),并通过割线-切线小程序案例展示如何将这些变量作为元数据进行具体表征(数学内容=导数,概念性;先备知识=函数、斜率等为必需,割线/切线概念为推荐;主导表征=图形,多表征存在,协调方式为隐性;概念建构=过程水平)。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了学习理论与教育技术之间存在结构性脱节,提出通过可观测教学变量构成的元数据作为中间层,使理论原则能够支撑教师对数字资源的分析、选择与整合,而非取代教师专业判断。该框架有望支持数字资源库与推荐系统的开发,但目前仅为初步方案,需在未来通过真实教学情境的应用与评估加以验证;其余三个维度(理论-教学对齐、资源条件、教师中介)有待后续工作补完。

Abstract: Despite the wide availability of digital resources for teaching mathematics, their effectiveness still depends on selection and integration processes that often lack explicit pedagogical criteria. This condition reveals a gap between the instructional design of resources and their pedagogical use in the classroom. To address this gap, this work advances the operationalization of learning theories through observable pedagogical variables. The proposed contribution translates principles derived from learning theories into dimensions and variables structured as metadata, thereby enabling the characterization of digital resources for teacher-support systems in mathematics education. Drawing on a literature review that evidences the limited operationalization of these theories in educational technology, the paper proposes a multidimensional structure. It then focuses on one of these dimensions: the conceptual structure of content. Specifically, it shows how aspects such as prior knowledge, representation, and conceptual construction can be represented as metadata to support the pedagogically informed selection and integration of digital resources.

</details>


### [367] [Bridging Technical AI, Societal Impacts, and Workforce Competencies in AI Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20994)
*Narges Zare,Divya Ramesh,Cori Faklaris*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个AI课程映射框架，将技术系统、社会危害和劳动力胜任力三者联系起来。基于对6门课程（来自16门课程数据集）的深度分析，发现：技术覆盖通常较强，社会危害虽有涉及但整合不均，劳动力胜任力很少被显性评估。研究强调AI素养不能止于概念认知，还需包括在AI情境中负责任行动的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI教育呈现碎片化状态——技术概念、伦理、以人为本的设计和职业准备往往分开教授。技术单元侧重模型与优化，而偏见、治理和社会影响的讨论脱离了实施约束。这种技术抽象掩盖了设计决策如何转化为社会后果，公平性也无法仅通过技术指标解决。因此需要一种系统化的方法，将技术系统、社会危害和劳动力胜任力结构性地对齐。

Method: 采用定性课程映射方法，分两阶段构建数据集：首先从某大学AI学位项目中的三门协调课程（AI素养、以人为本AI、社会技术设计）开始，再通过Casey Fiesler的公共技术伦理教学大纲集合扩展，筛选包含AI相关关键词的课程。经人工审核确认16门AI相关课程，本报告对其中6门进行深入映射。构建三部分对齐模型（技术系统、社会危害、劳动力胜任力），对教学大纲、周主题、学习目标、作业和课程描述进行迭代编码，并进行跨课程比较。

Result: 1) 技术系统通常被较好地呈现，但深度不一（如公平机器学习课程深入到监督学习、嵌入、偏见检测等，而AI素养课程更宏观地讨论AI工具和平台治理）；2) 所有六门课程都涉及社会危害（偏见、隐私风险、错误信息、监控、劳动力替代、问责缺口），但整合程度不均，部分课程将危害与设计/数据/模型/评估选择直接关联，部分课程仅进行平台层面的批判而未追溯技术机制；3) 劳动力胜任力（沟通、批判性评价、跨学科协作、伦理推理、利益相关者推理、负责任创新）虽在各课程中出现，但通常通过项目、讨论隐含呈现，鲜少被显性命名或评估；4) 技术严谨性与社会批判之间存在错位——算法深度强的课程对危害解释清晰但对沟通和治理关注较少，而社会批判强的课程未充分解释背后的技术机制。案例式或项目式课程中三者对齐最强。

Conclusion: 简单增加伦理内容不足够，AI教育应从主题覆盖转向系统、影响和决策技能之间的显性对齐。劳动力胜任力应直接嵌入技术作业中，而非作为次要结果。跨课程案例共享方法使对齐更可见和可操作。未来工作将扩大数据集、整合更多课程资源、完成待验证大纲收集、改进编码方案，并开发跨机构的更清晰对齐测量。

Abstract: As AI becomes embedded across everyday life and work, educators must help students connect technical knowledge with societal consequences and workplace responsibilities. Yet AI education often remains fragmented, with technical concepts, ethics, human-centered design, and workforce preparation taught separately. This work-in-progress presents a curriculum mapping framework that links technical systems, societal harms, and workforce competencies, beginning with institutional courses and expanding through an external 335-course registry. Early findings from six courses suggest that technical coverage is often strong, societal harms are present but unevenly integrated, and workforce competencies are rarely explicitly assessed. These findings speak to AI literacy efforts by showing that literacy cannot stop at awareness of AI concepts or harms; it must also include competencies for responsible action in AI-enabled contexts.

</details>


### [368] [From Inference to Prediction: How Machine Learning is Reconfiguring Science (1990-2025)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20995)
*Malena Mendez Isla,Vincent Lariviere,Diego Kozlowski*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文基于1990-2025年OpenAlex的490万篇科学出版物,通过255种ML技术的层级分类法和嵌入语义映射,系统分析ML对科学认识论的重构,揭示物理科学为方法论核心、健康科学为主要增长领域的核心-边缘结构,以及预测性技术对推断性技术的两波替代浪潮。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ML已广泛渗透各学科,但其对科学知识生产与评估条件的认识论影响仍缺乏系统性理解。论文旨在填补这一空白,探究ML扩散如何重塑科学主张的生成与评价条件。

Method: 构建255种ML技术的层级分类法,采用基于嵌入的语义映射方法,分析OpenAlex数据库中1990-2025年的490万篇科学出版物,重建ML研究的语义空间并识别学科间的方法论分化与演化模式。

Result: 研究发现:(1) ML研究呈核心-边缘结构,物理科学为方法论核心,健康科学为最大增长领域;(2) 预测性技术集中于计算机科学,而推断性方法分散于应用学科,反映历史形成的差异化验证机制;(3) 传统重视可解释性的领域(健康科学、社会科学)中,推断性技术正被预测性架构取代;(4) 该替代分两波发生:2015-2021年由深度学习驱动,带来认识论不透明性;2022年后由少数外部公司提供的架构主导,引入数据与流程的更深层不透明性。

Conclusion: ML的扩散不仅扩展了科学的分析能力,更从根本上重组了科学知识生产与评估的条件,引发对认识论不透明性、研究自主性与外部依赖等深层问题的关注。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) has reshaped scientific practice across disciplines, yet its epistemic consequences remain poorly understood. This paper analyzes how its broad diffusion reconfigures the conditions under which scientific claims are produced and evaluated. Using a hierarchical taxonomy of 255 ML techniques and embedding-based semantic mapping, we analyze 4.9 million scientific publications from OpenAlex (1990-2025). We reconstruct the semantic space of ML research and show a core-periphery structure, with physical sciences forming the methodological core and health sciences representing the primary growth area. We identify distinct methodological profiles across domains: predictive techniques concentrate in computer sciences while inferential approaches remain distributed across applied fields, reflecting historically differentiated validation regimes. We observe the displacement of inference-oriented techniques by predictive architectures in domains that have traditionally prioritized interpretability-most notably health sciences and social sciences. This displacement unfolds in two qualitatively distinct waves. The first (2015-2021) was driven by deep learning architectures that reduced predictive error while introducing epistemic opacity. The second (post 2022) is organized around a small number of architectures delivered through external companies, introducing a further layer of opacity over data and processes that researchers cannot access or report. This transformation expands the analytical capacity of science, and also reorganizes the conditions under which scientific knowledge can be produced and evaluated.

</details>


### [369] [Incoherent Values? Probing LLM Preferences Through Parametric Variation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21102)
*Elena Ajayi,Angelica Chowdhury,Seth Lazar*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种通过"参数化变异"(parametric variation)框架来评估大语言模型(LLM)价值一致性的新方法。研究通过构造"价值阶梯"(value ladder),对原始陈述中的单一价值相关属性进行7层级强度变化(T1-T7),然后用强制选择(forced-choice)方法检验模型偏好是否保持单调性。结果显示,即使是能力最强的LLM也存在显著的不一致,能力/规模与一致性并不正相关,但启用推理(reasoning)能显著提升一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究(Mazeika et al., 2025)声称LLM具有稳定的、可被强制选择测试提取的"涌现价值",且价值一致性随模型规模增大而提升。但哲学上认为,真正的价值一致性测试不应仅在固定选项集上拟合效用函数,而应检验偏好能否在参数化变体上泛化。本研究即是要检验这一"涌现价值"论断是否成立。

Method: 1. 数据集设计:从Mazeika et al. (2025)的510个配对比较结果中筛选出146个可进行参数化变异的陈述,经严格审计后保留100个"阶梯"(涵盖12个价值类别)。每个阶梯包含7个层级(T1最少偏好到T7最多偏好),原始陈述为中点T4。2. 阶梯质量审计:三阶段过滤(层级对验证、属性验证、排名验证),仅保留通过所有测试的阶梯。3. 强制选择偏好提取:每个阶梯的7个层级与30个跨类别固定比较陈述配对(210对/阶梯),每对进行20次试验(10次原始顺序+10次翻转顺序),温度为0。4. 一致性评估:主要指标为严格单调性(strict monotonicity),辅以保序回归R²、Jonckheere-Terpstra检验、预测效用(predictive utility,80/20交叉验证+层级标签置换零分布)等。5. 测试16个模型配置(GPT-5.4三档、Opus 4.6、Nemotron-3-Super、GLM-4.5混合/基础、Mistral系列、Llama等),含推理开/关对比。

Result: 1. 参数化变异暴露了配对方法无法发现的不一致性:所有模型的严格单调性平均仅59.5%(范围10.1-80.1%),远低于接近100%的预期,即使最严格的Opus 4.6推理版也只有80.1%。2. 模型确实"有偏好"(平均J-T检验显著率77.2%,保序R²平均0.932),但方向信号与序数结构可分离——GLM-4.5基础模型99%阶梯通过BH校正,严格单调性却仅10.1%。3. 一致性不随规模单调提升:GPT-5.4家族中Mini(54.1%)反超Standard(41.3%);小模型Ministral-3B(58.2%)与GPT-5.4推理版持平。4. 类别异质性显著:"生命与物种"类别(68-89%)远高于"个人自由"(38-39%)和"宗教"(40-43%)。5. 推理带来显著一致性提升:GPT-5.4-Nano +32.9pp、Mini +20.2pp、Standard +17.3pp;最小推理模型(58.2%)超过最大的非推理模型(41.3%),且推理增益在一致性最差的类别最小,提示推理更像是"注意力机制"而非构建一致性。6. 95.1%的阶梯-模型对通过预测效用检验,表明tier信号确实被模型使用。

Conclusion: 先前研究对LLM"涌现价值"一致性的论断被显著高估。当前LLM展现的更接近"继承的分布规律"而非真正的连贯价值评估。模型能力/规模与一致性不相关(可能因蒸馏使小模型更连贯),而推理是提升一致性的更有效杠杆。但即便开启推理,模型仍无法实现跨价值类别的近100%严格单调性。因此,"涌现价值"主张应持审慎怀疑态度。本文提出的阶梯框架可作为评估AI可信度的诊断工具,未来可作为强化学习信号以训练更连贯的智能体。

Abstract: To trust another autonomous entity -- human or AI -- it helps to know that how it acts given one set of reasons is at least somewhat predictive of how it would act under others. It is hard to trust someone with incoherent values. Some think of Large Language Models as merely stochastic text generators with no evaluative core -- superpositions of billions of possible characters, not one stable identity. But others have argued that LLMs *do* have stable, emergent values, which can be elicited by presenting them with a series of forced choices between arbitrary statements, and which emerge as a function of model scale. In this paper, we test this thesis by presenting LLMs with parametric variations on those forced choices. We reason that if a model genuinely prefers A to B, then except in unusual circumstances it should also reject B in favor of an augmented version of A, which has more of what makes A desirable -- A++. Our results indicate that earlier attributions of coherence may have overstated their case. Even the most capable models exhibit significant incoherence, and coherence does not appear to emerge as a result of underlying model capability. We do, however, find that models given time to reason are less incoherent than those with thinking disabled. More generally, we develop a novel framework for eliciting and evaluating coherent values, which can be used both to assess how trustworthy current models are, and -- in future work -- to provide reward signal that can be used for making more coherent agents.

</details>


### [370] [Virginia Tech Transportation Safety Index (VTTSI)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21154)
*Jason Cusati,Cheng-Shun Chuang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了弗吉尼亚理工交通安全指数(VTTSI),一个基于云原生的实时交叉口安全评估框架。该框架融合了经验贝叶斯(EB)事故率稳定化、基于车速与冲突行为的提升因子(uplift factors)以及CRITIC赋权的多准则决策(MCDM)模块(集成SAW、EDAS与CODAS三种方法),利用多模态联网车辆遥测数据(BSM/PSM)和多年VDOT事故历史数据,每15分钟生成一个0–100的可解释、暴露调整的安全评分。系统采用FastAPI+PostgreSQL/PostGIS+Streamlit的云架构部署,并通过三处交叉口的验证和±25%参数扰动的敏感性分析证明了模型的鲁棒性与实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统交叉口安全评估主要依赖多年事故历史数据的回顾性分析,具有显著的滞后性,无法反映快速变化的实时运行状况。商业路径规划平台(如Google Maps、Apple Maps)主要优化行驶时间而非安全性;供应商提供的交叉口监控平台多采用不透明的黑盒算法,仅基于排队长度、延误或信号性能等有限指标,既不整合长期事故历史,也无法提供透明、可解释的安全推理。同时,现代联网车辆遥测、IoT传感和路侧监控系统已产生高频多模态数据流,但实时安全评估的进展仍然有限,尤其是缺乏显式结合历史事故风险与新兴指标(车速方差、弱势道路使用者VRU交互、类冲突事件)的框架。本文旨在填补这一空白,构建一个透明、可解释、数据驱动的实时安全指数,统一长期事故趋势与短期运行信号。

Method: 1. **数据源**:六张实时表(BSM、PSM、vehicle-count、vru-count、speed-distribution、safety-event)+ VDOT 2017–2024年历史事故数据,统一以15分钟为时间窗口进行聚合。
2. **实时安全指数(RT–SI)**:
   - 严重度加权事故率:r_i = Σw_s·C_{i,s}/E_i(权重:致命=10、受伤=3、PDO=1)
   - EB稳定化(无暴露情形):通过2017–2024训练、2025留置验证,以Poisson对数损失最小化在λ网格上搜索,最优λ*=100000,全局均值r_0=3.365
   - 三类有界提升因子:速度缺口F^spd、速度方差F^var、VRU冲突F^conf(均截断于[0,1]),组合U=1+0.3F^spd+0.3F^var+0.4F^conf
   - VRU与车辆子指数分别加权0.6/0.4,组合后通过min-max缩放至0–100
3. **MCDM安全指数**:
   - 决策矩阵:5个准则(车辆数、VRU数、平均速度、速度方差、事件数)× (交叉口×时间箱)备选方案
   - CRITIC赋权(基于标准差与1−ρ_{jk}对比度)
   - 三种MCDM方法:SAW(加权求和)、EDAS(基于与平均解距离)、CODAS(基于欧氏/曼哈顿距离与NIS对比)
   - 二次CRITIC对三种方法输出再赋权,得到混合MCDM指数
4. **混合融合**:SI^Final = α·SI^RT + (1−α)·SI^MCDM(默认α=0.7,可由用户调整)
5. **云架构**:FastAPI后端 + PostgreSQL/PostGIS数据库 + Streamlit前端,均部署于Google Cloud Run;并集成基于OpenAI GPT-4o工具调用的SafetyChat对话模块。
6. **敏感性分析**:对RT–SI所有参数联合施加±25%扰动,共50次随机抽样。

Result: 1. **时间模式**:所有变量(车辆数、VRU数、车速、方差、事故)呈现明显的双峰日变曲线(早晚高峰),安全指数与暴露量同步波动,与理论预期一致。三处交叉口结论一致。
2. **MCDM内部一致性**:SAW/EDAS/CODAS两两Pearson相关r≈0.78–0.99,确认CRITIC赋权下方法间高度一致。
3. **暴露主导性**:车辆与VRU计数与MCDM指数强相关(r≈0.76–0.97),表明暴露量是当前实时风险的主要驱动力。
4. **RT–SI与MCDM互补性**:两者呈中等正相关——RT–SI锚定历史事故风险,MCDM对短期波动更敏感,互补性强。
5. **无事故交叉口行为**:Glebe–Potomac(2017–2024无历史事故)RT–SI压缩在0–6之间,EB基线退化为全局均值,提升因子仅轻微抬升——符合EB稳定化设计预期。
6. **缺失数据**:遥测稀疏时RT–SI与MCDM均塌缩至低稳定值,无虚假尖峰。
7. **敏感性**:±25%联合扰动下,平均绝对偏差≈0.09,95分位≈0.37,最大值≈0.68(均<1分);RT–SI保持原有时间结构,仅振幅受轻微影响。
8. **参数重要性**:VRU与车辆融合权重(ω_VRU、ω_VEH)对偏差影响最大;在无事故点,EB收缩参数与严重度权重几乎无效;提升因子系数影响有限,因各项被有界化设计截断。

Conclusion: VTTSI成功证明可以将多年事故历史与高频联网车辆遥测统一为一个0–100的可解释、暴露调整的实时安全指数。RT–SI(EB+提升因子)与MCDM(CRITIC+SAW/EDAS/CODAS)两条并行管线提供了互补的风险视角:前者反映长期结构风险,后者捕捉短期运行异常。α加权融合在波动性与响应性之间取得平衡。验证显示指数呈现合理的日变模式,在±25%参数扰动下保持鲁棒(<1分偏差),并对运行湍流与近事故事件保持适当敏感性。局限性主要来自扁平数值表示无法刻画车道几何、冲突拓扑与轨迹上下文,以及PSM渗透率不足对VRU信号的影响。未来工作将引入"代理式交通安全知识图谱(TS–KG)",以关系化表征和多智能体推理弥补当前框架在因果推断、可解释性与语义推理方面的不足,并扩展至视频分析、LiDAR/CV2X感知、天气与路面条件等多源数据,实现更广泛的生态系统集成与公平感知校准。

Abstract: The Virginia Tech Transportation Safety Index (VTTSI) is a real-time, cloud-native framework for quantifying intersection safety using multimodal connected-vehicle telemetry and multi-year VDOT crash history. Traditional crash-based methods rely on lagged, aggregated data and cannot reflect rapidly changing operational conditions. VTTSI addresses this gap through a hybrid modeling approach that fuses Empirical Bayes (EB) crash stabilization, uplift factors derived from speed and conflict behavior, and a CRITIC-weighted multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) module combining SAW, EDAS, and CODAS. The system produces interpretable, exposure-adjusted safety scores on a 0--100 scale every 15 minutes. A cloud-deployed architecture built on FastAPI, PostgreSQL, PostGIS, and Streamlit supports interactive visualization of traffic volumes, VRU exposure, speed variance, and real-time incident activity. Validation across intersections demonstrates coherent diurnal patterns, consistency among MCDM methods, and sensitivity to observable operational turbulence. Sensitivity analysis further shows that the RT--SI is robust to parameter perturbations, with deviations typically remaining below one point on the 0--100 scale. By integrating long-term crash risk with short-term behavioral dynamics, VTTSI provides a transparent, adaptive, and proactive safety-monitoring framework suitable for transportation agencies, traffic management centers, fleet operators, and autonomous vehicle systems.%~\cite{persaud2007, montella2020systemic, schultz2025_surrogate, Amraji2025CombinedSafetyIndex}.

</details>


### [371] [CEDAR-42001: From ISO/IEC 42001 Conformity to Architecture-Aware, Audit-Visible Assurance Posture for AI Cyber-Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21276)
*Priyanka Prakash Surve,Asaf Shabtai,Yuval Elovici*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: CEDAR-42001是一种两阶段方法,将ISO/IEC 42001人工智能管理系统(AIMS)审计证据转化为面向AI信息物理系统(AI-CPS)的架构感知、审计可见的保证态势。Stage A保留合规性判定;Stage B为每条审计记录增加四类诊断输出(架构归因、五维成熟度画像及瓶颈识别、风险比例化目标成熟度、基于规则库的行动建议),并聚合成战略、运营、战术三类决策产品。在Meridian Robotics合成案例中,89.9%的审计行合规,但仅34.3%达到基线高保证类别;通过2023年Cruise robotaxi事件的回溯应用验证了方法的适用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISO/IEC 42001:2023规定了AIMS的合规性要求,但合规性评估存在三大局限:(1)不显示受影响的架构层级;(2)不显示实践成熟度是否匹配风险情境;(3)不指明应采取的后续行动。在AI-CPS中,单层弱点(如感知L2)会跨层传播至控制决策(L5)与物理执行(L1),因此条款级合规性判定无法直接回答战略(资源分配)、运营(优先弱点识别)与战术(具体改进措施)层面的决策需求。论文将治理证据所衍生的有界诊断定义为"审计可见的保证态势"(audit-visible assurance posture),以填补这一决策缺口。

Method: 采用两阶段架构:Stage A通过26条优先级排序的规则层级将每条审计行映射为合规、改进机会(OFI)、轻微不符合、严重不符合或未评估;Stage B叠加四类诊断字段:(B1)五维成熟度(Traceability、Operationalization、Monitoring、Improvement、Cross-layer Integration,各0-4分)经17条IRDMO门控规则映射至Initial/Repeatable/Defined/Managed/Optimized五级并识别瓶颈约束;(B2)将记录归因至治理层G或L1-L7七层AI-CPS架构(物理执行L1、感知L2、数据处理与状态估计L3、中间件与通信L4、AI决策与控制L5、应用逻辑L6、人为监督L7)及Cross-layer报告类别;(B3)基于CPS影响与安全/安全关键性分配最低与延伸目标成熟度并计算目标差距;(B4)由发现类型决定行动类别(不符合→纠正措施,OFI→改进措施,合规但低于目标→保证加强,未评估→证据获取,合规达标→维持),并结合子条款、主层级、瓶颈约束与风险情境生成具体行动内容。评估采用159条原子审计问题(由单一分析师对ISO/IEC 42001第4-10章进行原子分解得到),通过Meridian Robotics合成AIMS证据库(自主移动机器人组织)进行端到端管道覆盖测试,并对2023年10月Cruise robotaxi事件进行回溯应用。评估分离评估者编码的判断依赖型输入与引擎确定性生成输出,执行阶段对固定输入具有计算可重复性。

Result: Meridian合成案例:159条审计行全部评估,Stage A产出143条合规(89.9%)、8条轻微不符合、7条严重不符合、1条OFI;激活9/26条合规规则,覆盖治理层与全部7个AI-CPS层(治理127行,其余32行跨层归因),严重不符合分布于G、L2、L4、L5。成熟度均值:Traceability 2.78、Operationalization 2.72、Monitoring 1.86、Cross-layer Integration 1.65;L2的Monitoring与Cross-layer Integration均为0.8,L7的Improvement为1.0。基线高保证类别(Monitoring、Improvement、Cross-layer Integration均值≥2.5)仅49/143行(34.3%)达到;敏感度分析下,五种操作化方案的比例在22.4%至46.2%之间。Cruise回溯应用:51行可评估(50条不符合、1条合规),108行标记为未评估;记录在G、L2(行人位置表征不足)、L5(碰撞后自动驾驶行为选择)、L7(远程协助介入时间与权限)上呈簇状分布,产生差异化的层级特定行动。

Conclusion: CEDAR-42001作为治理至保证的交接机制,保留了ISO/IEC 42001合规性判定并补充架构归因、成熟度诊断、风险比例化目标与行动建议,使合规性与保证(监测、改进、跨层集成)在同一可追溯审计行内共存。Meridian案例显示合规与保证代表治理的不同维度,二者不可相互替代;Cruise回溯应用证实方法能区分治理、感知、决策与监督四类关切。方法不替代技术性CPS安全评估(不评估攻击面、软件漏洞、控制器行为、运行时遥测或对抗鲁棒性),仅识别需要更深层技术保证、组织改进或定向补救的审计证据点。主要局限:保证构念、成熟度门控、目标规则与行动模板均由作者定义,159题库由单一分析师分解,固定编码输入下引擎确定性可重复但不构成评估者间信度证据;Cruise分类未证明唯一正确、前瞻可重复或可跨AI-CPS域泛化,需未来在运营AIMS中、由多评估者参与并与独立技术保证发现对比来验证。

Abstract: AI-enabled cyber-physical systems (AI-CPS) turn data-driven decisions into physical actions, creating assurance challenges across sensing, computation, control, human oversight, and governance. ISO/IEC 42001:2023 specifies requirements for an artificial intelligence management system (AIMS), but conformity assessment alone does not show which architectural layers are affected, whether practices are mature enough for the risk context, or what actions should follow. We present CEDAR-42001 (Control-Evidence Decision and Action Reasoning), a two-stage method that converts ISO/IEC 42001 audit evidence into an architecture-aware assurance posture traceable to the audit record. Stage A preserves the conformity determination. Stage B adds four outputs to each audit row: (i) attribution to a governance stratum or one of seven AI-CPS layers; (ii) a five-dimensional maturity profile with binding-constraint identification; (iii) a risk-proportionate target maturity; and (iv) a rulebook-derived action recommendation. The enriched rows are aggregated into strategic, operational, and tactical decision products. We evaluate CEDAR-42001 using a synthetic autonomous-fleet AIMS and by comparing conformity-only results with the enriched outputs. Although 89.9 percent of audit rows were conforming, only 34.3 percent of conforming rows reached the baseline High-assurance category; across alternative operationalizations, this proportion ranged from 22.4 percent to 46.2 percent. A retrospective application to the 2023 Cruise robotaxi incident shows how the method captures documented concerns across governance, perception, decision-making, and human oversight and maps them to layer-specific actions. CEDAR-42001 does not estimate exploitability or replace technical CPS-security testing; it identifies where audit evidence warrants deeper technical assurance, organizational improvement, or remediation.

</details>


### [372] [Discriminatory Compliance: How LLMs Answer Queries from Protected Groups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21296)
*Dinesh Ayyappan,Carlos Castillo*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 该研究系统性地揭示了主流LLM在面对受保护群体用户查询时存在的"歧视性合规"问题，即因多数群体假设导致少数群体获得次优回复。通过多模型、多群体、多披露方式的实验设计，证明了这种不一致性的广泛存在及其对弱势用户的潜在伤害风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM的安全防护设计基于"有用、诚实、无害"原则，但在实际应用中存在多数群体假设偏见。LLM通常在缺乏用户背景信息时做主流假设回答，这对少数群体或受保护背景的用户可能造成伤害（如建议抑郁症患者做兼职）。这构成了一个关键的安全漏洞：表面完整但缺少用户关键特征的查询可能导致服务质量不平等、知识获取不公等问题。

Method: 研究采用2×2×N的实验设计：(1) 从Personalized Safety和Contextualized Evaluations数据集中选取38个健康相关问题，分为18个语义类别；(2) 依据EU Charter Article 21确定受保护群体，分为Type 1（法律平等对待义务）和Type 2（合理便利义务）两类，加上亚临床和多数群体作为对照；(3) 设计四种信息披露方式（显式/隐式 × 简短/详细），以模板形式呈现；(4) 测试5个模型（Anthropic Opus 4.6、Sonnet 4.6、Haiku 4.5、Qwen3、GPT-Safe）；(5) 通过余弦距离量化回复变化，并用LLM-as-a-judge（Opus 4.6）对6个标签（完成、拒绝、情境承认、共情措辞、专业转介、危机资源）进行评估。

Result: 主要发现包括：(1) 所有模型都显示出相比无披露基线的显著语义偏移，GPT-Safe偏移最大，Opus 4.6最小；(2) Type 2残障群体的回复偏移最大，获得最少的个性化回复；(3) 亚临床条件（无法律保护）引发的反应与受保护群体更相似；(4) 披露方式对多数群体和受保护群体影响不大，但对亚临床条件影响显著；(5) 危机资源仅在特定情境（贫困、抑郁、饮食障碍等）下提供，Opus 4.6在转介和资源提供上最为保守，Qwen3在共情表达上最多，GPT-Safe在专业转介和危机资源上最多；(6) 存在明显的"披露红利"：披露条件后获得专业转介的概率大幅提升（如抑郁症从无披露到隐式简短披露时专业转介率从48.2%升至59.7%）。

Conclusion: 研究得出三个核心结论：(1) 开发者面临在个性化和普适性之间平衡的困难，受保护群体用户获得的个性化程度最低；(2) LLM无法清晰区分临床严重程度，对措辞的敏感度对用户不透明，可能造成信息伤害；(3) 应在条件光谱上考虑风险，包括亚临床状况；当合规可能有害时，应采取保守策略：先询问再回答，或在可能需要时包含危机资源等有益信息。论文强调不存在简单的"安全"解决方案，需要持续多维度的监控。

Abstract: Chatbots developed using Large Language Models (LLMs) implement various safeguards for sensitive questions and/or scenarios. These safeguards require making certain assumptions about the person asking the question. We define discriminatory compliance as patterns in question answering that disproportionately disadvantage users from minority or protected backgrounds, for instance by omitting information that would be valuable for them. In this paper, we show that state-of-the-art LLMs respond inconsistently to questions from personas from protected identity groups, and that some of these inconsistencies mean that key information that should be provided to minority or protected background personas is missing. We show that this behavior is, additionally, inconsistent across and within model providers as well as across background conditions and ways of phrasing those conditions.

</details>


### [373] [Distance-based subsidy rate design to incentivize ride-hail access to advanced air mobility hubs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21390)
*Zhenglei Ji,Hai Yang,Joseph Y. J. Chow*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文研究了先进空中交通（AAM）与网约车（ride-hailing）的多模式协同问题，提出了一种基于距离的补贴率设计方案，以激励乘客使用网约车前往AAM垂直起降机场（vertiport）。研究以纽约市三大机场为案例，结合实际打车数据和不同时间价值（VOT）的乘客群体，分析了空中的士运营商的盈利性、票价水平与乘客需求的空间分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先进空中交通（AAM）的成功运营在很大程度上依赖于其与地面交通模式的有效整合。在许多应用场景中，AAM运营商需要与网约车运营商合作，为空中的士乘客提供无缝的"第一英里/最后一英里"接驳服务。然而，如何设计合理的激励机制使网约车运营商愿意配合AAM运营商，以及AAM运营商如何在保障自身盈利的同时吸引足够客源，是亟待解决的关键问题。现有研究缺乏对AAM与网约车协同中补贴设计的系统性探讨。

Method: 1. 提出基于距离的补贴率设计框架，综合考虑AAM运营商的盈利约束和旅客的路线选择行为。2. 以纽约市（NYC）机场接入为案例研究。3. 整合纽约市高载客量网约车（HVFHV）的实际数据，反映真实空间需求分布。4. 将乘客按不同时间价值（VOT）分组，分析差异化客户基础。5. 评估不同空中的士运营成本和票价水平下，补贴机制的临界条件。6. 识别曼哈顿区域内不同候选垂直起降机场的客流量和利润贡献差异。7. 定位在低票价情境下能够为三大机场产生最高乘客需求的出租车区域。

Result: 1. 当空中的士运营成本超过12美元/英里时，AAM运营商需要向网约车运营商提供补贴以激励其参与机场接驳服务。2. 曼哈顿不同候选垂直起降机场的客流量和利润贡献存在显著差异，反映了空间需求的不均匀分布特征。3. 在较低的空中出租车票价情境下，识别出了能为纽约三大机场（肯尼迪、拉瓜迪亚、纽瓦克）共同带来最高乘客需求的若干出租车区域。4. 证明基于距离的补贴率设计在促进垂直起降机场可达性方面具有显著优势。

Conclusion: 基于距离的补贴率设计方案能够有效促进AAM与网约车的多模式协同，在保障AAM运营商盈利的同时提升垂直起降机场的可达性，并培育较高的空中的士客流量。研究结果强调了空间需求异质性和乘客时间价值差异对AAM-网约车协同运营的重要性，为实际票价制定和垂直起降机场选址提供了实践指导。设计合理的补贴机制是实现AAM成功融入城市综合交通系统的关键。

Abstract: The success of advanced air mobility (AAM) operations is largely contingent on its effective integration with other ground transport modes. Under many use cases, AAM operators have to work with ride-hailing operators to create a seamless air taxi travel experience with adequate first and last-mile access. In investigating this multimodal coalition, this study proposes a distance-based subsidy rate design for AAM operators to incentivize ride-hail access to AAM hubs, incorporating air mobility operators' profitability considerations and travelers' route choices jointly. Using New York City (NYC) airport access as a case study, this study integrates high-volume for-hire vehicle (HVFHV) data from NYC taxi zones to consider real-world spatial demand distributions while considering passenger groups with different values of time (VOT) to derive insights on distinctive customer bases. Overall, the results show that AAM operators would need to subsidize the ride-hailing operators on vertiport access trips when air taxi operating costs exceed $12/mi. The analysis of ridership at AAM hubs indicates that ridership and profit contributions differ across different candidate vertiports in Manhattan, reflecting spatial demand heterogeneity. Additionally, having the airport access system in place, the taxi zones that generate the highest passenger demand to all three major NYC airports are identified under lower air taxi fare scenarios. These findings highlight how a distance-based subsidy rate design is beneficial in facilitating better access to vertiports and to foster high air taxi ridership with optimal AAM fare levels.

</details>


### [374] [Push-Pull Determinants Among Bangladeshi Students Enrolled in NCR Private Universities: A Single-Destination Exploratory Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21429)
*Md Millat Hosen,Md Nazmus Sakib*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 这是一项探索性单目的地研究，调查了就读于印度国家首都区（NCR）三所私立大学（Sharda University、Noida International University、Galgotias University）的孟加拉国学生的推拉因素。研究基于Lee（1966）的推拉理论框架，采用在线问卷调查（n=56，经质量筛选后），结合描述性统计、K均值聚类和二元逻辑回归分析方法。研究发现：政治与行政中断是孟加拉国最强的推力因素（M=3.73），而地理与文化邻近性（M=3.80）和签证可达性（M=3.73）是两个并列最强的拉力因素；基础设施满意度是推荐意愿最强的预测因子（OR=2.54）；聚类分析识别出三种决策画像群体：全面驱动型、邻近主导型和低显著性型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 南亚区域内学生流动日益重要，但印度NCR作为孟加拉国出境学生的目的地在学术界未被充分探索。现有的推拉研究主要关注西方目的地，印度作为南亚区域内学生目的地的系统性研究有限。具体而言，三个维度研究不足：（1）这一特定起源-目的地二元关系中推力与拉力因素的相对显著性；（2）教育咨询机构作为信息中介的作用；（3）入学后满意度动态及其与推荐行为的关系。论文的理论贡献在于检验短途区域内流动是否更多地由地理邻近、文化熟悉度和签证可行性的"复合可达性优势"所组织，而非由离散的、按等级排序的拉力因素所决定。

Method: 研究采用横断面定量调查设计，基于Lee的推拉理论框架。问卷通过Google Forms分发，包括五个部分：人口统计、推力因素（4项李克特量表）、拉力因素（4项李克特量表）、咨询网络与决策路径、入学后结果。数据收集时间为2026年3月18日至5月11日，通过WhatsApp群组和BCC电子邮件分发，共收到63份回复，经质量筛选（排除直线作答、咨询矛盾和极端分叉响应）后保留56份有效样本。分析方法包括：（1）描述性统计（均值、标准差、频数分布、交叉表）；（2）K均值聚类（k=3）应用于8个推拉李克特分数，聚类有效性通过单因素ANOVA验证；（3）二元逻辑回归预测高推荐意愿（E2≥4），主模型包含5个理论驱动的预测因子以应对事件/变量比（EPV=5.8）的限制。Cronbach's α显示拉力子量表内部一致性优秀（α=.907），推力子量表较低（α=.652）。

Result: 主要结果包括：（1）推力因素排序：政治与行政中断（B4, M=3.73）>缺乏专业技术课程（B3, M=3.27）>入学考试竞争激烈（B2, M=2.84）>公立大学学位有限（B1, M=2.80）；（2）拉力因素排序：地理与文化邻近性（C3, M=3.80）≈签证可达性（C4, M=3.73，二者无显著差异p=.598）>学费可负担性（C1, M=3.45）>NCR生活成本（C2, M=3.39）；（3）替代目的地：澳大利亚和德国并列最多（各33.9%），其次是英国（26.8%）、加拿大（19.6%）；（4）咨询网络影响：73.2%（宽阈值）或66.1%（严格阈值）的受访者受到咨询影响，主要用于大学和课程选择（48.2%）；（5）满意度与推荐意愿正相关（Pearson r=.497, Spearman ρ=.535, p<.001）；（6）逻辑回归显示基础设施满意度是高推荐意愿最强预测因子（OR=2.54, 95% CI [1.09, 5.89]）；（7）K均值聚类识别三种决策画像：全面驱动型（39.3%）、邻近主导型（33.9%）、低显著性型（26.8%），ANOVA验证所有六项关键变量跨聚类差异显著（p<.01）。

Conclusion: 研究得出四项主要结论：第一，地理与文化邻近性与签证可达性构成复合可达性优势，是该起源-目的地走廊的主导拉力因素，超越了成本和项目可用性的重要性，这精化了短途区域内流动的推拉解释框架；第二，孟加拉国的政治与行政中断是主要推力因素，其突出地位可能与2024年政治转型有关，应在孟加拉国政治环境演变时重新评估；第三，满意度和推荐意愿同升同降，基础设施满意度是推荐行为最强预测因子，机构应优先缩小入学前宣传与实际学生体验之间的差距；第四，三种经统计验证的决策画像聚类为差异化机构沟通和支持策略提供了类型学基础。研究局限包括样本量小（n=56）、单目的地设计限制外部效度、研究者关联的分发渠道（首席作者曾实习于Sharda大学国际关系部）、便利抽样、性别失衡、推力子量表内部一致性较低、K均值假设等。未来研究应通过更大分层样本、多目的地比较设计、纵向追踪、性别分层抽样和对低显著性型群体的定性跟进来解决这些局限。

Abstract: International student mobility from Bangladesh is a significant feature of South Asian higher education, yet India's National Capital Region (NCR) remains underexplored as a destination for outbound Bangladeshi students. This exploratory single-destination study examines push-pull factors among Bangladeshi students enrolled at private universities in India's NCR. A structured online survey was administered to students at Sharda University, Noida International University, and Galgotias University (n = 63; n = 56 after quality filtering). Descriptive statistics, K-means clustering, and binary logistic regression were applied within Lee's push-pull framework. Political and administrative disruption in Bangladesh's academic calendar was the leading push factor (M = 3.73). Geographical and cultural proximity was the strongest pull factor (M = 3.80), closely followed by visa accessibility (M = 3.73), with no significant mean difference between them. Australia and Germany were the most frequently considered alternative destinations (33.9% each). Advisory networks influenced 73.2% of respondents under a broad threshold and 66.1% under a stricter threshold, mainly for university and course selection. Satisfaction and recommendation intent were positively associated, and infrastructure satisfaction showed the strongest association with high recommendation intent in a five-predictor logistic model (OR = 2.54, 95% CI [1.09, 5.89]). K-means clustering produced three exploratory decision-profile groups: Comprehensively Motivated, Proximity-Led Enrollers, and Low-Salience Enrollers. The findings suggest that geographic nearness, cultural familiarity, and visa accessibility may operate as a composite accessibility advantage in this short-haul intra-regional corridor.

</details>


### [375] [UNCASExt -- A Systematic Computational Framework for Uncertainty Propagation and Scope Consistency in Absolute Environmental Sustainability Assessments (AESA)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21465)
*Erwan Ike de Bantel,Thibault Pirson,Gonzalo Puig-Samper,Jan Marcus Hartmann,David Bol,Ghada Bouillass,Bernard Yannou,Marija Jankovic,Michael Zwicky Hauschild*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出UNCASExt框架及其配套开源Python包pyaesa，用于在绝对环境可持续性评估（AESA）中系统地传播不确定性并确保范围一致性。框架通过形式化分配程序，使估算的环境负担与分配的承载能力在影响路径建模、生产/消费核算、B2C/B2B活动三个维度上实现范围匹配，并支持回溯性与前瞻性评估及动态温室气体预算。通过法国电力消费2019-2060案例研究，揭示功能单位失配可导致中位数4.6倍的承载能力低分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 绝对环境可持续性评估（AESA）通过将人类活动与地球系统承载能力（CC）进行对比来判定其绝对可持续性，但其可靠性面临两大挑战：（1）不确定性来源未被充分纳入（如输入数据不完整、规范性分配选择、建模局限等）；（2）绝对可持续性比率（ASR）中分子（估算环境负担）与分母（分配的承载能力）之间存在范围不一致问题，涵盖影响路径建模、生产/消费核算、B2C/B2B活动等维度。此外，缺乏可复现、系统化实现的软件工具也制约了AESA的更广泛采用。

Method: UNCASExt是对原UNCASE框架的扩展，包含三大贡献：（1）扩展AESA中考虑的不确定性来源，支持通过Monte Carlo模拟将结果变异性归因到各独立不确定性源；（2）提出功能单位、系统边界、分配路径及相应执行指标的分类体系，确保ASR分子与分母的范围一致性；（3）提供开源Python包pyaesa，实现从全球到国家-部门层面的系统化、可复现分配。框架还纳入时间动态：支持回溯性与前瞻性评估，允许静态稳态或动态承载能力（包括基于IPCC AR6在SSP转型情景下的GHG预算）。案例研究将框架应用于2019-2060年法国电力消费的绝对环境可持续性评估。

Result: （1）基于EXIOBASE 3.10.2中所有可用部门-区域对的量化分析表明，估算环境负担与分配承载能力之间的功能单位失配可导致严重低分配，中位数低分配因子达4.6倍；（2）法国电力消费案例研究（2019-2060）成功展示UNCASExt框架在回溯性与前瞻性场景下的可操作性，并支持对法国未来电力结构多种情景的决策评估。

Conclusion: UNCASExt与pyaesa为AESA的协调统一提供了可扩展的解决方案，弥合了方法学指南与实际应用之间的差距。框架通过形式化分配程序确保范围一致性，扩展不确定性分析能力，并提供软件工具支持复现性，可广泛适用于国家和部门层面的AESA应用，同时为政策制定和企业科学碳目标设定（如SBTi）提供方法学支撑。

Abstract: Absolute environmental sustainability assessment (AESA) has gained increasing attention in environmental research and policymaking. However, its reliability is challenged by several sources of uncertainty that remain insufficiently accounted for, as well as by scope inconsistencies within the absolute sustainability ratio (ASR), which compares estimated environmental burdens with allocated carrying capacities for a given human activity. This work introduces UNCASExt, an extension of the UNCASE framework for systematically propagating uncertainty and ensuring scope consistency in AESA, together with a supporting open-source Python package, pyaesa. At country and sector levels, the computational framework formalizes allocation procedures that match the scope of allocated carrying capacities with that of estimated environmental burdens across three dimensions: impact pathway modeling; production-based versus consumption-based accounting; business-to-consumer versus business-to-business activities. It also incorporates temporal dynamics, supporting both retrospective and prospective assessments with either static steady-state or dynamic carrying capacities, including greenhouse gas budgets from the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change Sixth Assessment Report under Shared Socioeconomic Pathway transition scenarios. The framework is applied to a case study of electricity consumption in France over the period 2019 to 2060. The results show that mismatches between the functional units of estimated environmental burdens and allocated carrying capacities can lead to substantial underallocation, with a median factor of 4.6x across all available sector-region pairs in EXIOBASE 3.10.2. Overall, UNCASExt and pyaesa provide a scalable solution to support AESA harmonization and a versatile way forward to bridge the gap between methodological guidelines and practical application.

</details>
