Abstract: Pre-trained language models (PTLMs) hosted on platforms such as Hugging Face form complex lineage structures similar to software dependency graphs. However, unlike traditional software ecosystems, PTLM repositories often lack reliable provenance due to missing metadata, such as licenses, reuse methods, pipeline tags, model types, and training libraries. To address this gap, we introduce Semantic Fingerprinting (SemFin), a lightweight approach that combines Hugging Face (HF) configuration files with model repository tags to automatically impute missing model metadata fields and reconstruct model lineage chains. We evaluate SemFin on a large-scale dataset of 317,133 PTLMs. Our results show that configuration files typically encode the technical requirements necessary to instantiate and reuse models, enabling them to serve as a structural blueprint for model reuse, particularly for transformer-based architectures. By combining these configuration files with model repository tags, SemFin significantly outperforms the existing propagation-based imputation approaches, improving prediction accuracy by up to 31.4% and 26.6% compared to Graph Avg and Hub Avg baselines. Importantly, SemFin also imputes metadata for 16.6% of isolated models where propagation-based methods fail. Applying SemFin to impute missing reuse-method and license metadata for 167,089 unlabeled models reveals that traceable reuse method chains expand by 75.9% and license lineage chains by 53.6%, uncovering 86 previously invisible reuse method patterns, while the proportion of incompatible license patterns only increases from 34.8% to 36.8%. These findings demonstrate how automatically derived structural signals can support the automated construction of AI Bills of Materials (AIBOMs), helping transform metadata from an error-prone manual declaration into information inferred directly from model artifacts.

</details>


### [479] [GitReq: A Gold Standard Dataset for Software Quality Requirements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21810)
*Farha Kamal,Md Humaun Kabir,Md Rakibul Islam*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: GitReq是一个从GitHub issue tracker挖掘并经专家验证的软件质量需求数据集,包含6,302条标注数据,覆盖8个ISO/IEC 25010:2011对齐的类别(性能、安全、可移植性、可用性、容错、可扩展性、可维护性及功能性基线),填补了GitHub平台缺乏细粒度质量分类基准数据集的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有需求分类数据集存在四大局限:(1)规模小,最广泛使用的语料库仅含625条需求;(2)领域多样性不足,多来源于学生项目或SRS文档;(3)功能需求(FR)与非功能需求(NFR)覆盖不完整,缺乏统一基准;(4)平台缺口——GitHub issue tracker虽包含大量开发者撰写的质量问题(性能瓶颈、安全漏洞等),却没有任何公开的专家验证数据集对其进行细粒度质量分类。软件质量相关缺陷占所有软件缺陷的40-60%,亟需基于真实开发者表达的大规模标注数据。

Method: 采用四阶段流水线构建:(1)类别特定的GitHub挖掘——对Security/Performance/Portability等标准类别使用"类别标签+通用需求意图标签+关键词"的三重信号挖掘,对Availability使用多策略挖掘,对Fault-tolerance使用多标签挖掘,对Maintainability/Scalability等稀疏类别使用标签+多抽取策略,FR仅使用通用标签和87个功能关键词。(2)分离的NFR与FR预处理流水线——NFR流水线关注语义内容(关键词、需求动词、长度窗口)并采用TF-IDF余弦相似度(阈值0.85)去重;FR流水线强制形式化规范语言合规性(shall/must/用户故事模式),包含14条独立拒绝规则的两阶段过滤。(3)专家人工标注——7名专家(1名博士+6名3-5年经验的软件工程师)经三阶段培训(共享理解、联合标注、独立标注),使用Fleiss' Kappa衡量一致性。(4)基于共识的质量过滤——通过多数投票和集体讨论解决分歧,2,437条无共识文本中仅285条被保留。从55,588条原始候选中经预处理得到8,554条,最终保留6,302条。

Result: 最终数据集6,302条需求分布于4,080个仓库,类别分布为:Security 1,646(26.1%)、Performance 1,509(23.9%)、Portability 1,284(20.4%)、Availability 738(11.7%)、Functional 531(8.4%)、Fault-tolerance 293(4.6%)、Scalability 157(2.5%)、Maintainability 144(2.3%)。NFR中79.3%由匹配的GitHub类别标签确认,FR实现100%形式化规范语言合规。整体Fleiss' Kappa=0.72(0.62-0.75),表明标注一致性良好。零样本LLM评估中,GPT-5.2获得最高宏平均F1=0.641,LLaMA 3 70B为0.632,Mistral 7B为0.439,Gemma 3 4B为0.366;稀疏类别(可扩展性、可维护性)和噪声较高的类别(可用性、功能性)仍具挑战性,验证了GitReq作为非平凡基准的价值。数据集已在figshare公开发布(doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.31669477)。

Conclusion: GitReq填补了issue类型分类语料库与形式化规范数据集之间的空白,提供了首个基于GitHub平台、专家验证、细粒度FR/NFR质量分类的公开基准。其真实开发者语言表达区别于PROMISE/PURE等SRS数据集,适用于训练监督分类器、跨平台迁移学习研究、CI/CD流程中自动化质量覆盖工具开发,以及LLM的提示敏感性、少样本适配和错误模式分析等研究。局限在于仅限英语GitHub issue,Scalability类标注一致性较低且样本量小,类别分布不均衡需采用分层采样或过采样策略。

Abstract: GitHub issue trackers contain millions of developer-written quality concerns, including performance bottlenecks and security vulnerabilities, yet no publicly available GitHub dataset classifies these into fine-grained software quality categories. We construct and release GitReq GitHub Requirement Issue, comprising 6,302 expert-validated requirements mined from 55,588 raw GitHub candidates across 4,080 repositories, labeled across eight ISO/IEC 25010:2011-aligned categories: Performance, Security, Portability, Availability, Fault-tolerance, Scalability, Maintainability, and a Functional baseline. Dataset construction involved category-specific triple-signal GitHub mining, separate non-functional requirement (NFR) and functional requirement (FR) preprocessing pipelines with per-category parameters, and expert human annotation achieving substantial inter-annotator agreement (Fleiss' Kappa~=~0.72). Zero-shot evaluation with four large language models (LLMs) establishes baselines, with GPT-5.2 reaching the highest macro-averaged F1 of 0.641. GitReq is publicly released with full materials to advance research in automated requirement classification and software quality analysis.

</details>


### [480] [G-Issue: Analyzing Lifetime and Evolution of Issue-related Artifacts from Open Source Repositories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21837)
*Sayed Mohsin Reza,Saif Uddin Mahmud,Omar Badreddin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出并评估了一个名为 G-Issue 的开源 issue 工件挖掘工具，通过与 Python API、GHTorrent、PyDriller、G-Repo 等主流工具进行性能对比，并基于 10 个热门开源仓库（如 Spring Framework、Kafka、Selenium 等）分析 issue 的生命周期与时间演化趋势，结果表明 G-Issue 速度最快（比同类工具快至少 33%），但内存占用略高于 Python API。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源软件开发中 issue 跟踪系统是反馈、新功能请求和缺陷报告的关键来源，但若未能有效管理 issue，会导致软件质量下降和维护成本飙升。当前研究在 issue 挖掘速度、issue 生命周期分析以及跨仓库的 issue 演化趋势方面存在不足，缺少一个集成化的工具同时支持快速挖掘、生命周期分析和演化可视化。

Method: 作者开发了基于 Web 的 G-Issue 工具（隶属于 ModelMine 框架），采用索引、分页、查询规约等技术从 GitHub 抓取 issue 相关工件。研究包含三个 RQ：(1) 通过三类任务（Size-related、Time-related、State-related，各检索 1000 条 issue）对比 G-Issue 与 Python API、GHTorrent、PyDriller、G-Repo 在执行时间（ET）和最大内存（MM）上的表现；(2) 计算 10 个精选开源仓库（满足 ≥5000 commits、≥100 contributors、≥3000 stars、≥500 forks）的 issue 平均生命周期；(3) 使用直方图和核密度估计（KDE）展示各仓库逐年 issue 数量在开放/关闭状态下的演化趋势。

Result: G-Issue 在三个任务中执行时间最短（12.1s/30.22s/11.8s），相比 Python API 提速约 33%，但最大内存占用（18223–20340KB）略高于 Python API（10211–16547KB）且远低于 GHTorrent；PyDriller 和 G-Repo 不支持 issue 挖掘。issue 生命周期方面，Spring Framework 平均需 1220 天解决（最长 5491 天），Skywalking 仅需 37 天；所有项目最短解决时间均为 0 天。演化分析显示，Spring Framework、JUnit-5、Checkstyle 和 Signal-android 近期关闭率下降且新增 issue 呈上升趋势，呈现"锯齿状"波动模式。

Conclusion: G-Issue 作为一个集成化的 issue 挖掘分析工具，在速度上显著优于现有工具，为 issue 管理、开发者任务分配和软件质量管理提供了新视角。研究表明，高 star/fork 的热门项目 issue 更多且平均解决时间更长，关闭率下降往往预示新 issue 增加。未来的工作将利用自然语言处理技术对 issue 文本进行分析，以自动识别和分配 issue 标签。

Abstract: Software developers or contributors report issues related to bugs, errors, and missing documentation during community-based software development. These issues are treated as feedback and are crucial to enhancing software new features, documentation, and quality. If software issues are not being addressed with a correct developer, software quality degrades and is unable to use in the end. Hence, it is essential to analyze the software issue-related artifacts to understand the behavior of the software. This paper investigates the performance of the proposed issue-related artifacts mining tool G-Issue with other state-of-the-art tools. We also investigate issue lifetime and evolution of issues over time among well-known and maintained repositories. The results show that G-Issue is faster in mining issue-related artifacts but takes more memory than general Python API during mining issue mining. The results depict that we can prioritize issues based on issue lifetime and evolution. Such results may provide a new horizon about issues that can help in issue management, developer assignment, and quality management. G-Issue URL: this https URL

</details>


### [481] [Bringing Managed Language Support to WebAssembly with External Library Linking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21919)
*Shuyao Jiang,Ruiying Zeng,Yangfan Zhou,Michael R. Lyu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 WALL-E 框架，通过外部库链接（External Library Linking）策略，采用客户端-服务器架构将 Wasm 模块与托管语言库（Python、Java、JavaScript 等）连接，使托管语言库在其原生运行时中执行，从而避免双重虚拟化开销。该框架支持 10 种托管语言且无需修改 Wasm 运行时，在基准测试中整体通过率达 95.68%，执行速度比运行时嵌套方案（python-wasmedge）快数百倍，通信开销极低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WebAssembly 已成为云和边缘计算中重要的编译目标，但其语言支持能力不成熟，尤其是对托管语言（如 Python、Java、JavaScript）的支持有限。现有的"运行时嵌套"方案（即把托管语言运行时编译为 Wasm 后再运行用户程序）存在三大问题：（1）可扩展性差——需要为每种语言重新编译运行时；（2）性能差——双重虚拟化引入大量开销；（3）语言功能兼容性差——许多原生扩展和包无法正常工作。WALL-E 旨在从根本上解决这一瓶颈。

Method: WALL-E 的核心思想是外部库链接（External Library Linking），将托管语言编写的应用视为外部库，让其在原生运行时中运行，通过 HTTP 客户端-服务器架构与 Wasm 模块交互：

1. **客户端-服务器架构**：Rust 编写的启动程序编译为 Wasm 字节码（HTTP 客户端），托管语言库封装为 HTTP 服务器（如 Python Flask、Node.js Express）保持在其原生运行时中。

2. **库注册阶段**：用户提交库源文件和 JSON 元数据描述（库名、语言、端点、函数签名、依赖等），服务器端自动进行验证、资源分配（UUID 标识、IP/端口分配）、服务实例化（按语言生成对应 Web 服务框架脚手架）和健康检查。

3. **库调用阶段**：客户端构造 JSON 调用请求（library_id、func、params），通过元数据驱动的参数编组系统（基本类型用字符串表示、复杂类型如 NumPy 数组用 Base64+shape/dtype 元数据）发送至服务器；服务器解析参数后调用目标函数，返回序列化结果。

4. **安全性**：Wasm 端保持沙箱隔离，外部库在受信任环境中执行，需通过白名单注册。

5. **实现**：基于 WasmEdge 0.14.0 和 Rust toolchain 1.27.1 构建。

Result: **RQ1（语言可扩展性）**：在 10 种托管语言（JavaScript、Python、Java、PHP、C#、TypeScript、Ruby、R、Scala、Kotlin）的 Computer Language Benchmarks Game 测试中，278 个可运行测试中 266 个通过，整体通过率 95.68%；8 种语言达到 100% 通过率（Python 90%，PHP 70.97% 失败，根因分别是 Python 多进程全局初始化问题和 PHP 进程控制原语在 Web 服务受限）。所有真实应用（Tesseract.js、Elasticsearch、ggplot2、MSQuic 等）均成功部署。

**RQ2（执行性能）**：与 python-wasmedge 对比，15 个微基准测试中，WALL-E 在计算密集型任务平均加速 647×（最高 matrix 959×、prime 833×），I/O 密集型 500×，内存密集型 386×。真实库 jsonschema 加速 689×，markdown 加速 449×，性能随调用粒度 k∈{1,8,32} 变化不显著。

**RQ3（通信开销）**：7 阶段细粒度测量显示，计算密集型基准的通信开销仅占 0.30%，其中网络传输占 0.26%、客户端 0.02%、服务器 0.02%，实际函数执行占 99.70%。真实库 jsonschema 开销 11.39%，markdown 开销 2.25%（受序列化负载大小影响）。

Conclusion: WALL-E 通过外部库链接机制成功解决了 Wasm 对托管语言支持的难题，在可扩展性（10 种语言无框架修改）、性能（数百倍加速）和语言兼容性（原生运行时生态）三方面显著优于运行时嵌套方案，且通信开销可接受。其局限性在于：（1）不支持外部运行时回调到 Wasm；（2）安全模型依赖受信任主机环境而非 Wasm 沙箱；（3）跨语言接口、参数编组和错误传播增加了开发者的认知负担。该工作为多语言边缘计算奠定了基础，并为 Wasm 生态系统的性能优化和云原生部署开辟了新方向。

Abstract: WebAssembly (Wasm) has emerged as a powerful bytecode format for running applications with near-native performance in portable and secure environments. However, while Wasm currently supports compiled languages like C, C++, and Rust, it lacks robust support for managed languages such as Python, Java, and JavaScript. This limitation hinders the deployment of applications in domains like machine learning and data processing that rely heavily on managed language ecosystems. To address this, we propose WALL-E, a novel framework to integrate managed languages into Wasm environments without complex runtime nesting or recompilation. WALL-E employs a unique external library linking strategy, using a client-server architecture to connect Wasm modules with managed language libraries running in their native runtimes. This approach preserves the native execution speed and language feature compatibility of managed languages by eliminating the overhead associated with double-layer virtual machines. Our evaluation shows that WALL-E supports ten managed languages without framework modifications and achieves a speedup of hundreds of times over the runtime nesting solution, with low communication overhead. WALL-E enhances the practicality of Wasm in cloud and edge computing, enabling efficient multi-language applications.

</details>


### [482] [A11YRepair: Bridging Web Accessibility Barriers via Knowledge-Enhanced Divide-and-Conquer Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21926)
*Kai Huang,Ling Zhu,Jian Zhang,Xiaofei Xie,Chunyang Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: A11YRepair 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的 Web 无障碍（A11Y）违规自动修复框架，采用"分而治之"策略对违规进行分层聚类，并选择性地融合 WCAG 领域知识，以解决多故障场景下传统自动程序修复（APR）工具效果差的问题。同时作者构建了包含 60 个真实 GitHub Web 项目的基准 A11YBench。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Web 无障碍工具主要聚焦于检测而非修复，且传统 APR 系统（SWE-agent、OpenHands、GUIRepair）在真实 A11Y 场景下表现不佳。原因包括：（1）Web 页面 A11Y 违规常以多故障、结构性相关形式出现（85% 的网页含超过 10 条违规），整体处理会导致规划失效；（2）逐条迭代处理会产生冗余定位、补丁冲突和副作用；（3）盲目注入 WCAG 知识会增加上下文噪声和成本，对简单违规无益。亟需一种能平衡任务粒度、捕获违规关系并选择性融合领域知识的修复范式。

Method: A11YRepair 包含五大组件：（1）违规分组机制——分两层：故障定位分组（基于 DOM 区域的规则化初始分组 + LLM 视觉/语义迭代精化）与补丁生成分组（按 WCAG Success Criteria 的 criterion-based 和 situation-based 聚类）；（2）故障定位——结合聊天模型与嵌入模型进行文件定位，并通过多轮反射（Locate Reflection）迭代修正候选文件集；（3）补丁生成——以 situation-level 分组为粒度生成 search/replace 格式的最小化补丁，并通过轻量级重建渲染校验；（4）WCAG 驱动知识融合——采用"反思后再使用知识"的两阶段机制，先判断是否需要 WCAG（Necessity Analysis），再选择具体 Techniques（Technique Selection）；（5）端到端验证——使用 IBM Accessibility Checker 重新评估。实现采用 o4-mini 与 text-embedding-3-small 模型。

Result: 在 A11YBench（60 个项目、147 个网页、8886 条违规、45 种违规类型）上的实验表明：A11YRepair 修复率达 76.8%，平均每条违规成本仅 $0.018，优于 GUIRepair 等 SOTA 基线；消融实验验证了分而治之设计、选择性 WCAG 知识融合和多轮反射定位的有效性；生成的补丁已被 Google、Microsoft、Facebook、IBM、K8s、Docker、Alibaba 等多个开源项目合并，体现出实际应用价值。同时框架在新项目和不同基础 LLM 上表现出良好的泛化性。

Conclusion: 该工作提出了首个面向 Web 无障碍违规的源码级 LLM 修复框架 A11YRepair，通过目标导向的分而治之工作流和选择性 WCAG 知识融合，有效解决了多故障、跨文件的复杂 A11Y 修复难题。配套构建的 A11YBench 基准填补了仓库级 Web 无障碍修复评估的空白，并已通过实际开源项目合并验证了工业可用性，为未来无障碍自动修复研究提供了基础。

Abstract: Web accessibility (A11Y), which ensures web content is perceivable and usable for users with disabilities, is a critical requirement for modern web applications. Yet existing tooling overwhelmingly focuses on detecting A11Y violations rather than repairing them. Automated program repair (APR) techniques appear promising for this setting, but our study shows that state-of-the-art APR systems perform poorly when applied to real-world A11Y violations. Unlike conventional sparse-bug scenarios, web A11Y issues often manifest as multiple structurally related violations per page, requiring coordinated edits across multiple files. Existing repair systems fail to manage this multi-fault scale, as they handle each bug individually without considering their relationships or incorporating domain rules such as the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG). We propose A11YRepair, an LLM-based framework for web A11Y repair. A11YRepair introduces a divide-and-conquer workflow that first clusters violations requiring coordinated edits to reduce redundant localization, and then decomposes each cluster by root cause so the LLM can generate focused and consistent patches. The framework further incorporates WCAG-driven knowledge to strengthen domain awareness during both fault localization and patch synthesis. To support systematic evaluation, we construct A11YBench, a benchmark of 60 real-world web projects collected from GitHub. Experimental results show that A11YRepair achieves higher repair effectiveness and lower cost than state-of-the-art baselines, and ablation studies confirm the importance of its divide-and-conquer design and selective domain knowledge integration. Specifically, patches generated by A11YRepair have been merged into open-source projects from Google, Microsoft, Facebook, IBM, K8s, Docker, and Alibaba, demonstrating its practical value.

</details>


### [483] [Cross-Platform Software Birthmarking for Real-World Binaries via Intermediate Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21988)
*Haruaki Tamada*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于中间表示（IR）的跨平台软件出生标记（birthmark）方法，通过 Ghidra P-code 将不同格式的二进制文件（PE、Mach-O、ELF）提升为统一的中间表示，以实现跨操作系统和 CPU 架构的软件剽窃检测。实验验证了跨架构一致性极高（r=0.9846），并发现 Windows 平台存在因库函数膨胀导致的"稀释效应"，而 Simpson 指数表现出最佳的判别能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有软件出生标记研究的目标平台有限（多集中于 Java 字节码），缺乏对跨平台（不同 OS、二进制格式、CPU 架构）真实可执行文件的鲁棒性评估。随着 LLVM 等跨编译基础设施的兴起，同一源代码可编译为多种平台的二进制文件，使得跨平台剽窃检测变得迫切但困难。

Method: 1. 开发出生标记工具包 Oinkie，从可执行文件中提取三类出生标记（opcode 序列 opseq、opcode 频率 opfreq、opcode 集合 opset）。2. 使用 Ghidra 将多种格式二进制文件（amd64/arm64 的 macOS Mach-O、Linux ELF、Windows PE）提升为 Ghidra P-code，再转换为 Oinkie-IR（JSON 格式）。3. 实现八种相似度比较算法（Dice、Jaccard、Simpson、LCS、Levenshtein、Euclidean、Cosine、Weighted Jaccard）。4. 采用 top-n 选择和 Hungarian 算法聚合函数级相似度。5. 评估目标包括 bzip2 各版本（相似度评估）、C/Go/Rust 实现（可信度评估）以及跨平台编译的 36 个二进制文件（鲁棒性评估）。

Result: 1. 相似度评估：bzip2 各版本间相似度均超过 0.75，验证了方法对近似软件的识别能力。2. 可信度评估：约 80% 的独立软件对相似度低于 0.4，能有效区分不同软件；md5 与 sha256 因算法相似出现混淆。3. 跨架构鲁棒性：amd64 与 arm64 间相似度排序高度一致（相关系数 r=0.9846, p<0.0001）。4. 平台异常分析：发现 Windows 平台的"稀释效应"——clang 在 Windows 上函数数从 68 膨胀至 2098，导致跨 OS 比较出现异常双峰分布，甚至出现 Windows-clang 与 Linux-Go 相似度（0.74）高于 Linux-clang 的反常现象。5. 语言屏障：跨语言相似度最低（0.1-0.3），是最大的变异因素。6. 算法对比：基于集合的方法（尤其 Simpson 指数）判别能力最强，对噪声鲁棒；基于序列的方法（LCS、Levenshtein）计算开销高约 7 倍但未带来成比例的性能提升。

Conclusion: 基于 IR 的出生标记方法能有效抽象 ISA 差异，跨 CPU 架构一致性极高；然而编程语言差异构成显著屏障，Windows 等平台的库函数膨胀导致稀释效应。Simpson 指数等基于集合的方法在隔离逻辑共性与抗噪方面表现最佳。推荐采用分层策略：基于集合的方法用于快速初筛，基于序列的方法用于深度验证。未来工作将聚焦于自动化库函数过滤以缓解环境噪声，并优化相似度计算的可扩展性。

Abstract: Software birthmarking detects plagiarism through characteristic program features, yet cross-platform resilience remains under-evaluated. This paper proposes a unified birthmarking approach for real-world binaries by lifting disparate formats into a common intermediate representation via Ghidra P-code. Experiments across diverse platforms and languages demonstrate exceptional consistency across CPU architectures ($r=0.9846$), independent of ISA (Instruction Set Architecture) specific details. The study also identifies a ``dilution effect'' in Windows binaries, in which the proliferation of library-derived functions degrades similarity scores. Despite this noise, the Simpson index demonstrates superior discriminative power. These findings clarify the practical capabilities and essential requirements for robust cross-platform birthmarking.

</details>


### [484] [From Driving Videos to Simulatable Scenarios](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21993)
*Alexandre Levy,Ernest Valveny Llobet,Antonio Manuel López*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: D-V2S 是一个两阶段框架，利用视觉语言模型(VLM)和大型语言模型(LLM)，自动将驾驶视频转化为可在 CARLA 等仿真器中执行的 SCENIC 场景脚本，实现从真实驾驶场景到可控、可重复仿真的自动化转换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶汽车(AV)需要通过仿真评估安全性，但当前场景创建依赖工程师手动编程，耗时且需要专业知识。虽然已有方法可从文本或轨迹生成仿真场景，但缺乏从视频直接自动生成可仿真场景的端到端方案，且现有方法在语义保真度、可编辑性方面存在不足。

Method: D-V2S 采用两阶段流水线：(1) 驾驶记录分析器(DRA)使用 VLM（如 GPT-4o）配合精心设计的提示词，将驾驶视频转化为包含交通参与者、动作、空间关系的自然语言描述；(2) 场景生成器(SG)使用 LLM（如 GPT-4o）配合上下文条件提示（包含 SCENIC 编程规则和描述-脚本示例对），将自然语言描述翻译为可执行的 SCENIC 脚本。两阶段设计使中间输出（自然语言）可编辑，便于场景变体生成。

Result: 主要结果：(1) DRA 评估中，GPT-4o 在语义覆盖率(SCS=0.91)和人类偏好(58.6%)上显著优于 LLaVA 和 Qwen-VL；(2) SG 评估中，语义保留率(SP=0.93)和人类偏好(75%)显著优于 LCTGen 和 ChatScene；(3) 端到端 D-V2S 在 5 个用例上平均保持 90% 的语义一致性(E2E-SC)，94% 的生成脚本可直接编译执行；(4) 定性展示使用消费级 GoPro 视频验证了框架的实用性。

Conclusion: D-V2S 证明仅通过提示工程（无需模型微调）即可有效实现从驾驶视频到可仿真场景的自动转换，在语义保真度和人类评估方面均优于现有方法。该框架支持自然语言和脚本参数的编辑，便于场景变体生成，适用于 AV 的调试、基准测试和回归测试。未来工作将集成到 AV 开发的 AI 闭环中并解决当前失败案例。

Abstract: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) face driving scenarios ranging from routine traffic to rare events. To assess safety it is crucial to reproduce these scenarios in a controllable, repeatable, and scalable manner, with simulation playing a key role. This paper introduces D-V2S, a novel framework that automatically generates simulatable driving scenarios from driving videos. D-V2S operates in two stages: a Driving Record Analyzer (DRA) uses a vision language model (VLM) with our designed prompt to produce natural-language descriptions from input videos, capturing road layouts and dynamic traffic interactions; subsequently, a Scenario Generator (SG) uses a large language model (LLM) and our conditioning context to translate these descriptions into executable scenarios. Using simulations, we show that D-V2S generates scenarios where 90% of the relevant semantic elements of the videos are present. We also provide qualitative results demonstrating D-V2S's capability to transform real-world driving videos into simulatable scenarios. Moreover, we provide both semantic and human driven ablative analyses of D-V2S's modules. In particular, we show how the VLM choice matters for DRA, and how our SG achieves a 75% preference rate over other state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [485] [Failure Analysis in Transition: An Industry Survey of Challenges, Priorities, and Standardization Needs in Advanced Packaging and Heterogeneous Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22149)
*Himanandhan Reddy Kottur,Nusra Akter Takia,Mahamudul Hassan Fuad,Istiaq Firoz Shiam,Matthew Walsh,Navid Asadizanjani*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文是一篇基于匿名问卷调查的实证研究，探讨半导体行业从业者对异构集成（heterogeneous integration）、芯粒（chiplet）架构、混合键合（hybrid bonding）及先进封装结构在失效分析（failure analysis, FA）领域面临挑战的看法。调查收集约100份回复，涵盖组织背景、产品领域、未来优先级、关键瓶颈、样品制备难题、新兴架构痛点及工作流加速与数据标准化需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着异构集成、芯粒架构、混合键合、背面（backside）技术及日益埋入式（buried）封装结构的发展，传统失效分析方法面临重大挑战。论文旨在了解半导体设计、封装、系统、工具及失效分析领域的从业者如何认知这一转型，识别行业当前痛点与未来需求，为后续技术路线与标准制定提供基准依据。

Method: 通过匿名问卷调查的方式，对半导体设计、封装、系统、工具及失效分析相关组织进行广泛取样。问卷设计涵盖七个维度：组织背景、支持的产品领域、失效分析的未来优先级、关键瓶颈、样品制备挑战、新兴架构特定痛点、工作流加速与数据标准化需求。共回收约100份有效回复，并采用量化评分（如10分制重要性评分）与百分比统计进行数据分析。完整数据在附录A（表II）中公开。

Result: 主要发现包括：(1) 异构集成、芯粒及三维产品占受访群体的69%，反映新兴架构已成为行业主流；(2) 封装与异构集成失效分析获得最高重要性评分（7.92/10）；(3) 混合键合被54%的受访者评为最难分析的新架构；(4) 更高分辨率的无损成像（non-destructive imaging）以8.18/10的评分位列未来最关键加速技术；(5) 83%的受访者支持建立正式的数据标准化框架。

Conclusion: 调查表明，异构集成与先进封装已成为半导体失效分析的核心焦点，混合键合等新兴结构对传统FA方法构成严峻挑战。行业迫切需要更高分辨率的无损成像技术，并强烈认同数据标准化的价值。公开的完整调查数据有助于推动后续基准研究、行业协作及方法学创新，以应对后摩尔时代封装失效分析的新需求。

Abstract: Failure analysis is being reshaped by heterogeneous integration, chiplet-based architectures, hybrid bonding, backside technologies, & increasingly buried package structures. To examine how practitioners view this transition, an anonymous survey was distributed across a broad set of organizations involved in semiconductor design, packaging, systems, tools, & failure analysis. The survey collected approximately one hundred responses & probed organizational background, supported product domains, future priorities in failure analysis, critical bottlenecks, sample preparation challenges, emerging architecture specific pain points, & perceived needs for workflow acceleration & data standardization. The results show that heterogeneous integration, chiplet, and three-dimensional products dominate the respondent base at 69%, while package & heterogeneous integration failure analysis received the highest importance rating at 7.92 out of 10. Hybrid bonding emerged as the most difficult new architecture to analyze at 54%, higher-resolution non-destructive imaging ranked as the most important future accelerator at 8.18 out of 10, and 83% of respondents supported formalized data standardization frameworks. The complete survey data are provided in Appendix A (Table II) to improve transparency & support future benchmarking.

</details>


### [486] [Natural Language-Focused Software Engineering via Code-Documentation Equivalence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22247)
*Aryaz Eghbali,Zhongxin Liu,Michael Pradel*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文提出了"文档-代码等价性"（documentation-to-code equivalence）的新概念，要求文档包含足够信息以重新生成对应的代码，并设计了名为 Documentary 的迭代式自动生成等价文档的方法。评估显示该方法能为 53.4% 的 Python 函数生成等价文档，并显著提升 LLM 在代码理解任务上的性能（输出预测准确率提高 12.8–24.5%），同时人类开发者也认为其生成的文档比原始人工文档更有用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有源代码文档往往不完整、过时或不准确，且在 LLM 时代文档质量更为关键（文档是 LLM 的重要上下文来源）。以往工作要么聚焦于代码摘要（牺牲完整性），要么聚焦于文档与代码的一致性（仅保证正确性但无完整性保证），且普遍以"与人类文档的文本相似度"作为评价标准，缺乏客观、自动化的评估方法。因此需要一个能同时保证正确性与完整性的强语义属性，并据此自动生成高质量文档。

Method: 1. 定义等价性：文档 d 等价于代码 c（关于 LLM L 和上下文 ctx），若 L 能仅基于 (d, ctx) 生成出与 c 等价的代码；这同时保证了正确性（sound）与完整性（complete）。2. 设计 Documentary 迭代算法：a) 基于候选文档和上下文，用 LLM 生成函数体；b) 用 LLM-as-judge 判断生成体与原代码是否等价；c) 若不等价，让 LLM 描述两者差异并据此修正文档；d) 重复最多 5 次迭代，最后还有一次精简与重检步骤。3. 在两个 SE 任务上评估：a) 代码理解（通过输出预测任务，即根据函数签名和文档预测函数返回值）；b) 代码编辑（用户研究，给开发者自然语言修改描述让其修改代码）。

Result: 1. RQ1：Documentary 在 238 个 Python 函数数据集上生成了 53.4% 等价文档（基线为 34.0%），精度为 66.4%（基线为 34.0%）。2. RQ2：等价文档具备跨模型可迁移性，用 gpt-5-nano 和 gemini-2.5-flash-lite 从 gpt-4.1-nano 生成的文档重建代码的等价率分别为 89.6% 和 74.7%。3. RQ3：消融实验显示中位迭代次数为 2、75% 在 5 次内收敛；最佳 size limit 为 1× 原函数长度。4. RQ4：平均每个函数耗时 33.8 秒，平均成本 $0.009（约 78K 输入 token + 3K 输出 token），对大型代码库成本可控。5. RQ5：等价文档使 LLM 输出预测准确率比人工文档高 12.8–24.5%，完全正确预测的测试用例从 41.5% 提升至 60.5%。6. RQ6：11 名参与者的用户研究表明，使用 Documentary 文档时开发者在"理解帮助"（3.76 vs 2.58, p=0.0004）和"修改帮助"（2.85 vs 2.15, p=0.0425）上评分显著更高。

Conclusion: 文档-代码等价性是一个比一致性（consistency）更强、比摘要（summarization）更完整的属性，能够通过代码-代码等价这一可自动验证的判据客观评估文档质量。基于此属性构建的 Documentary 迭代方法可以自动为约半数真实 Python 函数生成等价文档，并被证明对 LLM 和人类开发者都有显著帮助：LLM 能更准确预测函数行为，开发者理解与修改代码的效率也更高。等价文档还具备模型无关性，能跨 LLM 复用，且生成成本极低，适合大规模代码库部署。该工作推动了"以自然语言为中心的软件工程"愿景——即以高质量文档作为人类与 LLM 协同开发的关键媒介。

Abstract: Source code documentation is an integral part of software development and maintenance, as it helps in understanding the code and facilitates communication among developers. However, existing documentation is often incomplete, outdated, or inaccurate, which can lead to misunderstandings and errors. In the era of large language models (LLMs), which are being extensively used for software engineering tasks, the quality of documentation becomes even more critical, as documentation provides important context for the models. In this paper, we introduce the notion of documentation-to-code equivalence, a novel property that captures whether documentation accurately and completely describes the code it documents. We present a novel approach, called Documentary, to automatically generate equivalent documentation for a given code snippet. Our evaluation shows that Documentary can generate equivalent documentation for 53.4% of the evaluated function-level code snippets. To show the benefits of documentation-to-code equivalence, we describe and evaluate two software engineering tasks: code understanding and code editing. Our results show that documentation-to-code equivalence allows an LLM to predict the output of a function with 12.8--24.5% higher accuracy, when compared to human-written documentation and documentation generated by a baseline approach. Furthermore, human developers consider documentation generated by Documentary to be more useful for understanding and editing code than the original human-written documentation.

</details>


### [487] [Formal-Method-Guided Vibe Coding: Closing the Verification Loop on AI-Generated Safety-Critical Software Through Model-Driven Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22413)
*Ran Wei,Le Zhu,Haochi Wang,Jim Woodcock,Fang Yan,Simon Foster,Xiangyang Ji*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 Forge 流水线,通过将 LLM 生成的 Java 代码经由成熟的模型驱动工程(MDE)基础设施转化为多种形式化模型,使用 Dafny、FDR4、Isabelle/HOL 三个互补验证器进行验证,并将验证失败转化为结构化修正提示反馈给 LLM,从而实现安全关键系统(符合 DO-178C、IEC 61508、ISO 26262)的自动形式化验证闭环,使开发者无需接触形式化模型即可获得认证相关证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 LLM "vibe coding" 范式虽能快速生成代码,但无法为安全关键系统提供认证所需的形式化正确性保证。现有方法存在两大缺陷:其一,要求 LLM 生成 Dafny、Verus、Lean 等验证感知语言(此类语言在 LLM 训练数据中稀缺且工业工具链不支持);其二,将验证作为后置过滤器而非反馈信号,无法引导生成器走向正确。核心问题在于:如何在不强迫开发者使用非主流形式化语言的前提下,让 LLM 生成的工业主流语言(如 Java)代码能够产出认证相关的验证证据。

Method: Forge 采用七阶段闭环流水线,分三大族:(1)需求与生成(阶段 1-2):五层自顶向下提示序列(架构→骨架→叶子→控制器→评审)生成符合提取可处理子集的 Java 代码;(2)提取(阶段 3-5):通过自研的 Spoon-to-EMF 桥接器将 Java 解析为 EMF 模型,再用 Epsilon ETL 脚本(~4400 行)将其转换为 RoboChart 状态机,最后通过 EGL 模板从同一 Java EMF 模型生成 Dafny 规范,从 RoboChart 模型生成 CSP-M 脚本和 Z-Machine 理论;(3)验证与反馈(阶段 6-7):三个互补验证器并行执行——Dafny(Z3 SMT 求解器)进行函数级演绎验证、FDR4 进行 CSP 行为级精化检查、Isabelle/HOL 进行模型级结构证明;并加入 6d 空洞性审计防止空验证通过。所有阶段产生的失败均被转化为统一模式的修正提示(包含状态、问题列表、原始工具输出、修复指令和 Java 追踪),反馈至下一轮代码生成。Java 代码被约束在"提取可处理子集"内(禁止 lambda、流、模式匹配 instanceof 等),以保证模型提取的忠实性。

Result: 在三个外部编写的、复杂度递增的案例研究上评估(SRanger 单控制器地面机器人 23 条需求、LRE AUV 安全管理器 51 条需求、Chemical Detector 多控制器 81 条需求):RQ1(通用性)确认同一基础设施无需案例专用代码即可端到端验证所有三个研究;RQ2(检测能力)建立缺陷分类表,证明三个验证器捕获不同缺陷类(合同违规、死锁、行为发散、结构死锁、不变量违反)且不可互换;RQ3(必要性)冷启动基线实验显示 0/30 次单次冷生成能通过严格收敛标准;Dafny 拒绝全部 10 次 SRanger 冷生成,LRE 中 7/10 在 Dafny 失败,Chemical Detector 全部 10 次编译失败;RQ4(收敛性)5 次独立运行每个案例共 15 次,所有运行在 2-3 轮(中位数 2)内收敛,迭代次数与案例规模无关;RQ5(归因)编译仅消融实验(折扣验证器反馈、保留 8 个编译-提取阶段)显示 15/15 次运行在停止点均产生验证失败工件——具体为 Dafny 单独必要(6 个停止点)和 Isabelle 单独必要(2 个停止点),FDR4 从不单独失败。代码生成每次约消耗 25-50 万输出令牌,流水线时钟时间 1-15 分钟(由 Isabelle 证明主导,失败证明需 10-15 分钟耗时搜索,收敛后秒级完成)。

Conclusion: Forge 提出了关于形式化验证在 LLM 驱动工作流中应处位置的结构性论证:不在 LLM 内部,也不是生成后的后置过滤器,而是作为草稿-判别循环中判别端,复用已为手工模型产出认证相关证据的 MDE 基础设施,使其同样适用于 LLM 生成的代码。该方法验证了:(1)形式化验证不应放在 LLM 内,LLM 应是草稿生成器,验证基础设施是判别器;(2)三个验证器产出与标准认可形式对应的证据(演绎验证、精化检查、定理证明),可纳入 GSN/SACM 保障案;(3)Java 提取可处理子集的限制延续了 MISRA、Ravenscar-Java、SCJ 等安全关键语言子集传统,但动机新颖——保护模型提取可处理性而非运行时可预测性。未来工作需在语义忠实性论证、跨 LLM 模型族合规性、多语言 T2M 桥接、保证案集成、工具资质认证等方面展开。贡献包括首个现代 Java 的 EMF 原生文本到模型转换(支持 Java 17+ 密封接口、记录、模式语法)、三验证器互补设计及缺陷级账户、需求到证明的完全可追溯链,以及开源实现。

Abstract: Vibe coding -- accepting LLM-generated source from natural-language intent with minimal review -- is fast and may be adequate for low-criticality consumer software. But for safety-critical systems governed by DO-178C, IEC 61508, or ISO 26262, it offers no path to certification: large language models (LLMs) provide no formal correctness guarantees, and existing remedies target verification-aware languages (Dafny, Verus, Lean) that are scarce in pretraining data and absent from industrial toolchains. This paper closes the gap. We present Forge (Formal method Oriented Refinement loop for GEnerated code): a closed-loop pipeline that guides vibe coding through formal verification using established Model-Driven Engineering (MDE) infrastructure. Through vibe coding, we generate Java source code; our pipeline then extracts -- via model transformations -- formal artefacts in three different formalisms, each checked by a complementary verifier: deductive verification (Dafny), Communicating Sequential Processes (CSP) refinement via the Failures-Divergences Refinement checker (FDR4), and theorem proving using Z-Machines in Isabelle; every verification failure becomes a structured correction prompt that drives the next code-generation iteration. The LLM is the draft generator, the MDE chain is the discriminator, and the developer never has to read the formal models. Empirically, we find that the pipeline produces standards-relevant verification evidence for LLM-generated Java -- a step toward certification.

</details>


### [488] [WebCQ: Cooperative Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning for Scalable Web GUI Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22502)
*Yujia Fan,Sinan Wang,Zebang Fei,Yao Qin,Huaxuan Li,Yepang Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: WebCQ是一种基于协作多智能体深度强化学习(Cooperative MARL)的可扩展Web GUI测试方法,通过引入QTRAN算法实现多智能体高效协调,采用轻量级同步机制适配异步Web测试场景,并通过融合语义与探索特征的动态动作向量解决了DQN在动态动作空间下的应用难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于MARL的GUI测试方法(如MARG和Fastbot)依赖表格型强化学习算法(如Q-learning),在面对现代复杂Web应用(状态空间庞大、交互元素众多)时存在两方面关键瓶颈:1)状态爆炸导致Q表无界增长,通信开销严重;2)以定位符(locator)为中心的动作定义无法有效捕获动作语义。因此亟需一种能够规模化应用于大型商业Web应用的多智能体测试方案。

Method: WebCQ将多智能体Web GUI测试建模为Dec-POMDP问题,采用CTDE(集中训练、分散执行)范式,核心设计包括:(1)引入QTRAN算法,通过状态价值函数V_jt协调联合Q函数与个体Q函数的分解,实现高维状态下的多智能体协作;(2)提出轻量级同步机制——各智能体独立异步探索,仅在所有智能体至少完成一次状态转移后才触发集中训练,避免步级阻塞,允许领先智能体多做一步以减少网页加载延迟;(3)基于标签-深度的状态向量(对常见HTML标签计算DOM平均深度)替代耗时的HTML序列相似度匹配;(4)三组分动作向量——当前动作文本与GloVe正关键词的余弦相似度、执行频次、子状态的探索潜力(10维直方图);(5)动态动作空间处理:将状态向量与每个候选动作向量拼接后输入DQN策略网络,采用ε-贪心策略选择动作;(6)混合奖励函数r=(R_sim+R_exec)×(1+R_time),结合页面相似度(APIMiner度量)、执行频次和时间补偿项。策略网络采用四层DenseNet,各智能体拥有独立Q函数,通过QTRAN损失(L_td+L_opt+L_nopt)联合优化。

Result: 在8个大型商业网站上的5智能体3小时对比实验中:WebCQ^5平均探索978.8个状态(较MARG^5的734.1提升33.3%),执行1220.6个唯一动作(较MARG^5的858.2提升42.2%),并在6/8的网站上触发更多故障;统计检验(Mann-Whitney U)在多数网站上具有显著性差异且A_12效应量大。消融实验中,WebCQ较无通信版本提升27.1%状态数、较无QTRAN版本提升21.3%状态数,验证了通信与QTRAN的必要性。20小时长时实验中WebCQ保持更高的每小时动作吞吐量,显示其Q表/网络扩展开销更小;在N=3、5、8、12的扩展性测试中,WebCQ随智能体增加持续提升,而MARG在8、12智能体时出现性能下降。

Conclusion: WebCQ是首个将多智能体Web GUI测试建模为Dec-POMDP并引入QTRAN实现有效协作的工作,有效克服了现有MARL测试方法的可扩展性瓶颈。其核心技术贡献——QTRAN协调、轻量级异步同步、语义增强的动态动作向量——共同实现了对大型商业Web应用的高效探索。该方法在状态覆盖、动作多样性和故障发现上均显著优于MARG等SOTA方法,并在长期执行与智能体规模扩展时展现出更强的稳定性,为现代Web GUI测试提供了一种可扩展且有效的解决方案。源代码与实验数据已公开(Zenodo:10.5281/zenodo.19222038)。

Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL)-based techniques have shown promise for GUI testing. However, as the complexity of modern GUI software increases, existing MARL-based approaches (e.g., MARG and Fastbot) struggle to scale due to the inherent limitations of their underlying tabular reinforcement learning algorithms. This limits their applicability to large-scale commercial GUI software, especially web applications with vast state spaces and many interactive elements. To fill this gap, we propose WebCQ, a novel MARL-based approach for scalable web GUI testing. WebCQ incorporates QTRAN for multi-agent coordination and a lightweight synchronization mechanism, allowing it to work under asynchronous web testing scenarios. It extracts semantic and exploration features for each UI event to form an action vector. This vector is concatenated with the current state vector and fed into the policy network, enabling DQN-based decision making within a dynamic action space. We evaluated WebCQ on eight large-scale commercial websites. Under the same time budget and agent count, WebCQ explored 33.3% more states and executed 42.2% more unique actions than MARG, while triggering more failures on six of the eight websites under test. It also demonstrated strong scalability, maintaining higher action throughput during 20-hour experiments, and achieving greater performance improvements as the number of agents increased. These results show that WebCQovercomes key limitations of existing MARL-based approaches, providing a scalable and effective solution for enhancing modern web GUI testing.

</details>


### [489] [What Characterizes Pairwise Modular Smells?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22576)
*Chenxing Zhong,Daniel Feitosa,Paris Avgeriou,Huang Huang,Wei Song,He Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究Pairwise Modular Smell (PairSmell)这一新型架构坏味的特征化与可解释性问题。通过快速文献综述提炼19个对特征，并利用11个开源Java项目中超过613万个实体对训练的机器学习模型，识别出影响PairSmell两种形式（InSep不当分离对与InCol不当共置对）的关键特征，相比基线模型ROC-AUC最高提升58.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有软件模块化改进方法存在两大局限：(1) 软件模块化技术需大量成本，开发者很少实施；(2) 现有架构坏味检测粒度过粗（模块级），难以指导具体重构策略。作者前期工作提出的PairSmell虽细粒度至实体对级别，但依赖多个模块化工具的"黑箱"共识输出，可解释性差，限制了其推广与有效性。本研究旨在从实体对特征角度解释PairSmell的产生原因，提升其可解释性与实用性。

Method: 1. **快速文献综述**：整合两篇最新系统综述（178篇原始研究），采用主题综合法提炼19个跨6个维度（关联性、距离、独立性、复杂度、内聚性、规模）的实体对特征；2. **数据收集**：基于11个Java开源项目（涵盖数据库、搜索引擎等不同领域）构建6,135,877个实体对数据集；3. **样本平衡**：采用逆变换采样（ITS）处理类别不平衡问题，重复采样3次验证鲁棒性；4. **特征筛选**：使用Spearman秩相关系数（阈值0.7）去除共线性特征；5. **预测建模**：训练LR、SVM、RF三种分类器，评估ROC-AUC和AUPRC指标；6. **模型解释**：使用置换特征重要性和偏依赖图（PDP）量化各特征对预测的影响；7. **定性分析**：通过代表性PairSmell实例进行人工分析补充说明。

Result: (1) **模型性能**：SVM在分离对上表现最佳（ROC-AUC=0.673），RF在共置对上表现最佳（ROC-AUC=0.812），相对基线分别提升34.6%和58.6%；AUPRC较最佳基线提升1.57-2.77倍。(2) **InSep关键特征**：out-degree（出向依赖数）、degree（与其他实体共享术语数）、total-fields（声明字段数）；其中高out-degree先升后降，低total-fields仅在与直接依赖结合时影响显著。(3) **InCol关键特征**：sim-tfidf（语义相似度）、intersection（共享术语数）、degree、in-degree（入向依赖数）；高sim-tfidf/intersection/degree降低InCol概率，高in-degree增加InCol概率。(4) 通过6个具体项目实例（Hadoop、Iotdb、Mahout、Pulsar、Kafka）阐释了特征如何影响PairSmell的产生。

Conclusion: 本研究通过系统化的特征分析与可解释机器学习，揭示了PairSmell的内在成因：PairSmell具有"可嗅探性"（sniffable），开发者可通过关键对特征识别并解释坏味实例。主要贡献包括：(1) 建立了PairSmell与19个对特征之间的系统性关联，深化了对PairSmell可解释性的理解；(2) 提出了基于特征驱动的重构策略（如应用依赖倒置原则、信息隐藏原则、提取类重构等）来缓解PairSmell；(3) 对模块化研究提出启示：未来模块化工具应关注特征共线性问题，并超越单纯的关系特征，更多考虑实体的独立性、规模等维度。研究也指出PairSmell的两大局限：基于最低层级文件夹的检测可能产生误报，工具类包应排除在分析之外。

Abstract: Enhancing the modular structure of existing systems has attracted substantial research interest, primarily through (1) software modularization and (2) identifying design issues (e.g., smells) as refactoring opportunities; however, both approaches often prove impractical to guide effective improvement. Inspired by both aforementioned approaches, our previous study introduced a novel and practical architectural smell -- called Pairwise Modular Smell (or PairSmell) -- for identifying flawed architectural decisions that necessitate further examination. The objective of this study is to explain PairSmell from the perspective of pair characteristics. To this end, we first conduct a rapid review to collect and synthesize 19 pair characteristics that have been used in the literature to represent relationships between two entities. The collected characteristics are then used to train machine learning models for predicting two forms of PairSmell -- inapt separated pairs InSep and inapt collocated pairs InCol, based on a curated dataset of over 6,135,000 pairs of entities derived from 11 open-source Java projects. The trained models achieve up to a 58.6% improvement in ROC-AUC over the baselines. The interpretation of the models reveals that the most influential features for InSep are out-going dependencies, terms shared with others, and declared fields; while those for InCol include semantic similarity based on tf-idf, terms shared between the pair, terms shared with others, and in-going dependencies. We complement the work with a series of practical examples to illustrate how the influential pair characteristics impact the occurrence of PairSmell.

</details>


### [490] [On Good Authority: Release-Authority Measurement for Registry-Mediated Package Ecosystems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22593)
*Igor Santos-Grueiro*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出"前驱感知的发布权威记录"(predecessor-aware release-authority record)，通过比较每个软件包发布版本与其直接前驱版本在发布者、仓库、工作流、来源证明、签名及中介证据等六个维度的差异，在五个注册中心型生态系统(npm、PyPI、Maven Central、crates.io、RubyGems)中识别发布路径的"控制平面不连续性",构建了一个可在发布时进行审计的候选审查队列。Go作为基于 VCS/proxy/checksum-log 的边界适配器单独报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有软件供应链度量以依赖图为核心,只能回答"代码会流向哪里",而无法回答"该版本是通过什么公开路径发布的"。发布者账号变更、CI 工作流切换、来源证明消失、仓库重链、签名密钥变更等控制平面事件可在载荷分析可用前就为审查提供信号。axios 事件、PyPI 上 litellm/telnyx 事件、Shai-Hulud 2.0 与 Mini Shai-Hulud 包蠕虫活动、xz 后门等均构成研究动机。

Method: 方法包含五个关键设计:(1)以 (ecosystem, package, version) 为发布键,对比同一包的前驱版本在 6 个字段上的有类型差异;(2)以注册中心为优先级的多源证据归一化流水线(注册中心 + 来源证明 + 仓库缝合),Go 走 VCS/proxy/sumdb 边界;(3)三级审计协议:仓库缝合队列(200 行,7% 错误率)与策略触发队列(150 行,2% 错误率);(4)三层校准:三位安全从业者在 60 行共享核心上盲审(20/30 立即审查、9/30 监控、1/30 不审查、30 个对照全为不审查,Fleiss κ=0.666),加上盲作者工作簿与自动化评分诊断;(5)外部对齐:OpenSSF/OSV MAL、Datadog 恶意包清单、npm/PyPI 注册中心动作与 OSV/GHSA 公告。窗口固定 2024-04-06 至 2026-06-13,采用 18-3-3 时序切分。

Result: 主要结果:(1)45,812 个发布版本、43,100 次有效前驱比较、942 个生态-包坐标,识别出 204 个策略触发的发布路径不连续性;(2)精确触发策略队列:204 个(0.47%);(3)统一语义距离规则 s≥2:320 个,覆盖 190/204 触发(93.1% 策略覆盖、99.9% 权威覆盖);(4)描述性制度距离规则(Maven d≥1、其余 d≥2):337 个,覆盖全部 204 个触发;(3)PyPI 是低距离公开变化的主要贡献者(2,659 个 d≥1),Maven 触发集中于签名维度(d=1 即触发);(4)外部对齐中 0 个确切恶意版本与策略触发重叠,16 个版本从冻结快照中缺失,后验实测确认这些版本在当前注册中心也不可用;(5)权威触达高度集中:中位触发权威触达为 0,前 10 个触发占总触达的 66.2%。

Conclusion: 发布权威转换定义了一个独立于依赖图的可审计审查面。透明的前驱变化规则足以打开候选队列;当队列仍然过宽时,学习排序可作为第二阶段压缩工具。制度差异重要:Go 的 VCS/proxy/sumdb 路径不可与注册中心发布者语义合并;RubyGems 在保守策略下触发为零。方法有明确边界:同路径代币复用、未变更的受感染 CI、以及从快照中删除的版本需要载荷、私有或快照证据,不在此发布路径记录覆盖范围内。研究强调队列构建与严重性判定分离,从业者审核将触发划分为"立即审查/监控/不审查"三档,PrAm 损失/工作流发布者不连续性通常为高严重性,首次采用工作流来源证明与稳定命名空间下的纯签名为低严重性。

Abstract: Dependency graphs show where released code can flow, while leaving implicit whether the public path used to publish a release changed. We introduce a predecessor-aware release-authority record that compares each package release with its immediate predecessor across publisher, repository, workflow, provenance, signing, and mediation evidence. We instantiate the record over a purposefully sampled, audited April 2024--June 2026 cohort from npm, PyPI, Maven Central, this http URL , and RubyGems: 45,812 releases, 43,100 eligible predecessor comparisons, and 942 package coordinates. Go is reported separately as a VCS/proxy/checksum-log boundary adapter. Transparent rules identify 204 policy-triggering public release-path discontinuities. The exact trigger policy is the primary candidate queue. A uniform semantic-distance rule selects 320 releases and covers 190/204 triggers; a descriptive regime-specific rule selects 337 releases and covers all 204. In a blinded 60-row shared core, three practitioners rated 20/30 triggers as immediate review, 9/30 as monitoring, 1/30 as no review, and all 30 controls as no review. These signals are review cues over public release-path evidence. Exact malicious versions in our external alignment have zero overlap with the policy triggers. Same-path compromise, unchanged compromised CI, and versions absent from public snapshots require separate evidence beyond this release-path record.

</details>


### [491] [Identifying Quality Indicators in Student Self-Reflections in Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22683)
*Matthew Minish,Matthias Galster,Fabian Gilson*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于评估软件工程学生反思写作的八项指标框架，并基于此框架验证了一个自动化分类器，通过微调的 RoBERTa 模型实现了高效、与人类评估者水平相当的反思文本自动评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反思是软件工程教育（尤其是项目式课程）中的核心能力，但教师人工评估学生书面反思耗时且反馈往往笼统、缺乏针对性，难以有效指导学生迭代改进其反思实践。需要一种可扩展、结构化的自动化评估方案来减轻教师负担并提供及时、具体的反馈。

Method: 在现有反思写作框架基础上进行迭代式调整与精炼，构建出八项指标评估框架；由三位标注者对学生的反思文本进行独立标注，并通过计算评分者间一致性来验证框架的可靠性（达到中等至可靠的信度）；随后训练并比较多种仅编码器（encoder-only）的 Transformer 模型，同时与采用零样本提示（zero-shot prompting）的纯解码器（decoder-only）大语言模型进行对比评估。

Result: 经过微调的 RoBERTa 模型在准确率和速度上均显著优于基于零样本提示的解码器大语言模型；该分类器在大多数指标上达到了与人类评估者相当的一致性水平，并能实现近乎瞬时的文本分类；最终提供了两种针对不同评估优先级进行优化的模型变体。

Conclusion: 经过微调的仅编码器模型能够实现反思写作的高效自动评估；所提出的八项指标框架与自动化分类器共同为软件工程教育中提供及时、结构化的学生反思反馈提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Context: Reflection is a fundamental skill in software engineering education, particularly in project-based courses where students learn through extended group work and need to develop their ability to reflect iteratively throughout their work. For students to benefit from reflection, their written reflections need to be assessed so that feedback can guide and improve their reflective practice. However, manually assessing written reflections to guide reflections is time-consuming, and often results in broad, non-specific feedback for a student to improve. Objective: This study builds on reflective writing frameworks to produce an eight-indicator scheme for assessing student reflections in software engineering. Furthermore, this study validates an automated classifier for assessing reflections against the framework, enabling scalable and structured feedback whilst reducing instructor workload. Method: We adapted existing reflection frameworks through iterative refinement to create our eight-indicator framework. Three annotators labelled student reflection texts, establishing moderate to reliable inter-rater agreement. We then trained and evaluated multiple encoder-only transformer models and compared them with decoder-only large language models using zero-shot prompting. Results: The fine-tuned RoBERTa model achieved the strongest performance, substantially outperforming decoder-only models in both accuracy and speed. The classifier demonstrated human-level agreement on most indicators whilst enabling near-instantaneous classification. We provide two model variants optimised for different assessment priorities. Conclusions: Our fine-tuned encoder-only models enable efficient automated assessment of reflective writing. The framework and automated classifier offer a means to provide timely, structured feedback on student reflections in software engineering.

</details>


### [492] [Habituation at the Gate: Rising Approval and Declining Scrutiny in Human Review of AI Agent Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22721)
*Haoran Yu,Lifei Liu,Xiaochong Jiang,Yuwen Jia,Su Wang,Pin Qian,Yihang Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 基于AIDev数据集对400名重复评审者进行纵向分析，发现人类评审者随着审查AI代理PR的经验积累，批准率显著上升（跨经验分位+14.5个百分点），同时内联评论数量下降22%、审查延迟增加3.5倍，呈现出"反射性习惯化"而非理性信任校准的特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编码代理大规模提交PR的时代，代码审查是确保软件质量的关键人工关卡。然而现有研究尚未探讨人类评审者是否会在反复接触AI生成代码的过程中降低审查标准，即所谓的"橡皮图章"假设。若确实存在习惯化效应，将削弱AI安全论证所依赖的人工监督层。

Method: 使用AIDev数据集中400名重复评审者（每人≥10次代理PR审查，共11,429次审查）的纵向数据，采用评审者内（within-reviewer）设计：按时间将每位评审者的审查分为早/晚期，计算个体审批率变化（ΔAR）；并按经验十分位进行汇总分析。通过逻辑回归控制日历时间效应、通过PR规模控制难度效应、通过108名跨代理评审者进行交叉代理控制、并以同一仓库6,618个人类PR作为日历对照。采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验和Spearman相关分析，使用审批率、变更请求率和审查延迟作为结局指标。

Result: 总体批准率从30.1%升至36.8%（Wilcoxon p<10⁻⁶），跨经验十分位累积差距达+14.5pp（27.9%→42.4%），变更请求率从11.2%降至5.6%。52%的评审者变得更倾向于批准。审查延迟从3.9小时增至13.5小时（3.5倍），但内联评论数减少22%（p=0.0014）、评论字数减少28%。审批率变化与评论投入下降呈强负相关（ρ=-0.556）。趋势由经验驱动而非日历时间驱动、属于代理特异性（人类PR批准率同期下降）、且PR难度未变（中位数规模持平）。

Conclusion: 审批率上升、评论投入下降与队列时间增加三者并存的模式，最符合工作负荷增长下产生的反射性习惯化，而非纯粹的理性信任校准。这一发现对依赖人工审查作为代理软件质量关卡的团队构成警示。作者建议采取评审者轮换政策、连续批准审计及个人趋势仪表盘等实践措施。主要局限在于无法完全排除代理代码质量在该观测窗口内确实改善的可能性。

Abstract: As AI coding agents (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Devin, OpenAI Codex, Cursor) submit pull requests to open-source repositories at scale, a key question arises: do human reviewers gradually lower their scrutiny for AI-generated code over time? We conduct a longitudinal within-reviewer analysis using the AIDev dataset, studying 400 repeat reviewers who collectively submitted 11,429 reviews over a seven-month observation period. Comparing each reviewer's early and late review episodes, we observe a population-level shift in approval rate from 30.1% to 36.8% (Wilcoxon signed-rank p < 10^{-6} on paired shifts). Pooled by within-reviewer experience decile, the cumulative gap reaches +14.5 pp from first to tenth decile. This shift is experience-driven (persists after controlling for calendar time), agent-specific (human PR approval rates decline over the same period), and not explained by PR difficulty (median PR size is flat). However, review latency increases rather than decreases (+3.5x), while inline comment volume decreases (-22%, p=0.0014), suggesting reviewers spend more time in queue but less time actively inspecting code. The combination of rising approval, declining comment effort, and increasing queue time is most consistent with reflexive habituation under growing workload rather than rational trust calibration alone.

</details>


### [493] [Integrating Heterogeneous Digital Twins in Federated Ecosystems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22791)
*Christian Vergara-Marcillo,Rami Bahsoon,Nikos Tziritas,Wendy Yanez-Pazmino,Panagiotis Oikonomou,Georgios Theodoropoulos*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出"联邦节点管理器"（Federation Node Manager）作为一种模块化的边界集成机制，用于在联邦生态系统中连接异构的、分布式的数字孪生（DT），实现可控的能力暴露、协议与模式适配以及实时状态与事件交换，并通过智能交通领域的应急响应场景进行了原型验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单个数字孪生在跨组织、跨技术边界的生态系统级部署中存在互操作性与运行时协调难题；现有"联邦数字孪生生态系统"研究多停留在概念性架构层面，缺乏将异构DT实际集成的具体机制，更缺少兼顾本地自治、数据主权与协同决策的边界组件。

Method: 基于系统联邦（Federation of Systems）原则，从本地自治与主权、互操作性六层（技术/语法/语义/动态/语用/组织）以及运行时协调三方面推导集成需求；设计"联邦节点管理器"作为边界抽象层，内部包含边界接口、核心控制与编排、互操作管理（协议适配、模式中介）、运行时协调支持（状态/事件/本地同步/联邦上下文管理）以及本地治理与共享支撑（安全、策略、配置、元数据、生命周期、数据管理）等模块；采用基于SUMO的Python原型，部署应急车辆DT与多个信号交叉口DT，通过HTTP-MQTT桥接实现联邦级消息交换与信号抢占协调。

Result: 在225次有效仿真中，相比固定配时基线（FTCM），本地可互操作模式（LIDP）使应急车辆平均行程时间降低25.72%，联邦协调模式（FCDP）降低32.30%；FCDP较LIDP进一步改善8.85%（中等拥堵8.75%，高拥堵8.00%，严重拥堵9.64%），Wilcoxon符号秩检验p<0.001、Cohen's d=0.75；节点级处理开销为亚毫秒级（本地DT 6.19–9.47 ms），网络传输与排队延迟168.5–441.5 ms，未对时间敏感的本地计算造成干扰。

Conclusion: 联邦节点管理器作为联邦DT生态系统的使能组件，在保留各DT本地自治与治理的前提下，实现了异构平台之间的可控互操作与运行时协调；原型验证表明该机制在时间关键的应急出行场景中带来显著的端到端增益，且引入的处理延迟可忽略；未来工作将扩展至更复杂的智能交通网络，评估中间件在严格时限条件下的表现，并探索跨领域的多种决策拓扑。

Abstract: Digital Twins (DTs) are increasingly used to virtualise physical systems at different scales, enabling monitoring, simulation, and predictions to support decision-making. However, while individual DTs are effective in stand-alone settings, ecosystem-scale deployments require multiple autonomous and distributed DTs to cooperate across system boundaries despite differences in modelling approaches or software technologies, making interoperability and runtime coordination critical challenges. Although \textit{Federated Digital Twin Ecosystems} have emerged as a promising direction, existing research remains at the conceptual stage, offering high-level architectures while leaving the practical integration of heterogeneous DTs underexplored. This paper proposes the \textit{Federation Node Manager}, a modular integration mechanism that connects local DTs to a federated environment through controlled capability exposure, protocol and schema adaptation, and timely state and event exchange for coordinated operations. We present a conceptual design and a prototype implementation, and demonstrate their feasibility in the smart mobility domain for emergency response scenarios. The proposed mechanism serves as an enabling component within a broader service-oriented federated DT ecosystem.

</details>


### [494] [EnerInfer: Energy-Aware On-Device LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23001)
*Bohua Zou,Nian Liu,Binqi Sun,Matteo Mascherin,Debayan Roy,Yutao Liu,Yu Peng,Ning Jia,Haibo Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: EnerInfer是首个面向端侧LLM推理的能量感知框架，通过解耦的模型结构感知预测与排序驱动的在线反馈控制，联合优化NPU和内存(DDR)频率，在不违反QoE约束的前提下显著提升能效并管理热舒适度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端侧LLM推理虽具隐私、可靠性和成本优势，但能量与热问题仍是关键瓶颈。现有系统普遍以最大吞吐为目标，隐含假设"越快越好"，但实际用户消费token的速度（朗读约5.3词/秒、说话<3词/秒）远低于设备最大解码速度，造成大量能量浪费。研究面临三大挑战：(C1)能效与吞吐随模型、引擎、平台和运行条件大幅变化，且商用设备缺乏组件级功耗传感；(C2)不同配置间的能效排序缺乏一致的偏序关系，简单反馈机制失效；(C3)请求到达与响应长度难以预测，温度演化复杂。

Method: EnerInfer采用三层架构：(1) 离线预测层——以LLM的6个关键超参数（层数、隐藏维度、注意力头数、KV头数、中间维度、词表大小）作为输入，使用解耦设计（独立的峰值吞吐预测器+相对缩放预测器）替代单一整体模型，随机森林(RF)实现，吞吐预测MAPE低至2.3-4.2%；(2) 能效优化层——基于2D帕累托前沿构建排序配置集，在运行时通过反馈机制选择满足QoE约束的最高能效配置；(3) 热管理层——采用轻量级线性回归模型（20秒温度历史+NPU预测功耗）进行有限时域热预测（MAE=0.16°C，R²=0.988），结合模型预测控制(MPC)动态切换能效优先与热约束模式，避免温度超过42°C阈值。

Result: 在真实LLM（LLaMA2-1.3B/7B、LLaMA3-3B、Qwen2-1.5B、Gemma2-2B）和三类平台（高端/中端手机、笔记本、开发板）上：(1) 能效提升最高达65%（手机）、12%（笔记本）、24%（开发板），不违反QoE；(2) 排序预测Kendall's Tau在手机和笔记本上达0.90-0.95，接近Oracle性能；(3) 热管理在背靠背推理中比纯能效模式多生成27.9%的token、延长32.1%时间至温度阈值；(4) 真实部署中（含CPU、显示等开销）端到端总能耗降低4.2-11%。

Conclusion: EnerInfer证明了端侧LLM推理存在大量"配置松弛"，通过联合管理NPU与内存频率，可在保证用户QoE的前提下显著提升能效并控制温升。其解耦预测+排序反馈+MPC热管理的三层设计克服了缺乏组件级传感、模型相关排序不稳定和请求不可预测三大难题。该框架可在一日内适配新平台，并可扩展至GPU/TPU等其他XPU（GPU后端验证能效提升26.1%）。未来工作包括支持稀疏计算与推测解码（需引入基于历史的命中率预测）以及探索温度阈值附近的先进控制算法。

Abstract: On-device LLM inference is increasingly attractive for privacy-preserving, reliable, and cost-effective deployment, yet its energy and thermal costs remain a critical bottleneck. Existing systems primarily optimize for decoding speed, implicitly assuming that faster execution is always preferable. We show instead that on-device LLM inference often has exploitable configuration slack: modestly lowering NPU and memory frequencies preserves quality of experience (QoE) while substantially improving energy efficiency and reducing heat. Realizing this opportunity in production is challenging. The most energy-efficient NPU/DDR setting varies with the model, inference engine, platform, and runtime conditions, with no stable ranking across configurations. Commercial devices further lack component-level power sensing, and shell temperature evolves with request arrivals, response lengths, and thermal history. To address these challenges, we propose EnerInfer, the first on-device LLM inference framework that jointly manages energy efficiency, throughput, and thermal comfort for LLM workloads. EnerInfer replaces per-model profiling and sensor-heavy control with disaggregated, model-structure-aware prediction and ranking-driven online feedback. It predicts throughput and power for unseen LLMs across NPU/DDR frequency settings, selects QoE-satisfying efficient configurations under runtime interference, and uses lightweight limited-horizon thermal prediction to dynamically switch between energy-optimized and thermally constrained inference. Evaluations on real-world LLMs show that EnerInfer improves energy efficiency by up to 65%, 12%, and 24% on phones, a laptop, and a development board, respectively, without QoE violation.

</details>


### [495] [The EVerest Dataset for Secure Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23197)
*Sophie Corallo,Debora Grupp,Dominik Fuchß,Jan Keim,Frederik Reiche,Tobias Hey,Anne Koziolek*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文提出了 EVerest 数据集，这是一个基于电动汽车充电站开源软件栈 EVerest 的多工件（multi-artifact）安全工程数据集，涵盖安全需求、软件架构模型、源代码和自然语言文档，并带有细粒度的安全标注，填补了现有数据集在端到端安全验证方面缺少需求—架构—代码三者兼备的空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端安全验证需要贯穿需求、架构到代码三个阶段，并配以细粒度安全标签。然而现有数据集要么仅覆盖需求（如 PROMISE NFR），要么仅覆盖代码（如 DiverseVul），没有任何数据集同时覆盖需求、架构与代码，且同时提供安全目标分类与通用需求分类标签。这阻碍了端到端安全验证（如安全需求分类、命名实体识别、架构追踪链接、设计时与代码级安全验证）的研究。

Method: 数据集构建分四步：(1) 通过在线问卷从 EVerest 社区粗粒度获取安全需求，围绕机密性、完整性、可用性和认证四个安全目标设计问卷，经两名安全背景博士试点后分发，最终 7 名参与者提交 67 条需求，清洗后保留 57 条；(2) 与 4 位 EVerest 开发人员进行半结构化访谈（每次约 90 分钟），将粗粒度需求细化为显式引用 EVerest 组件的细粒度需求，共得到 93 条；(3) 从源代码（2024 年 6 月 3 日 commit 177a8e6）派生基于 Palladio 组件模型的软件架构模型，包含 29 个组件、34 个接口和 144 个服务效应规约；(4) 由多名标注员对需求进行标注，使用 SecLan 元素类型（组件、实体、数据、状态、硬件节点、硬件连接、控制流、数据流、内部活动等），标注接受窗口（短/长序列）、指代和共指以及架构追踪链接，通过标注员间一致性协商解决分歧，最终保留 84 条安全需求。

Result: 数据集包含：(1) 84 条带安全目标标注的精炼安全需求；(2) 1,445 个细粒度安全元素，涵盖组件、实体、数据、数据流、状态等；(3) EVerest 软件架构模型（含需求到架构的追踪链接）；(4) EVerest 源代码；(5) 自然语言文档，以 Apache 2.0 协议公开。此外，在数据集构建过程中发现了一个真实的安全弱点 CWE-1295（认证令牌存储违反），已披露给项目维护者并被修复。数据集支持安全需求分类、命名实体识别、架构追踪链接恢复、设计时与代码级安全验证等研究任务。

Conclusion: EVerest 数据集是首个同时涵盖需求、架构与代码并提供细粒度安全标签的多工件资源，填补了安全工程领域的空白。该数据集不仅支持多种安全分析任务的研究，还在实践中产生了实际价值（发现并修复 CWE-1295 漏洞），证明了端到端安全验证数据集的必要性和实用性。该数据集将以 Apache 2.0 协议公开发布。

Abstract: End-to-end security verification, from requirements through architecture to code, requires datasets that span all three artifact types with fine-grained security labels. No existing dataset provides this combination. We present the EVerest dataset, a multi-artifact resource based on EVerest, an industry-driven open-source software stack for electric vehicle charging stations. The dataset includes 84 manually elicited security requirements annotated with security objectives, 1,445 fine-grained security elements (components, entities, data, data flows, states, etc.), acceptance windows, coreferences, and architectural trace links, as well as the EVerest software architecture model, source code, and natural language documentation. It enables research on security requirements classification, named entity recognition, architectural trace linking, and design-time or code-level security verification. During dataset creation, a real security weakness (CWE-1295) was identified, disclosed to the project maintainers, and subsequently fixed. The dataset is publicly available. A short video is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [496] [Generate with CodeXHug: A Dataset to Enhance Model Cards with Code Usage Patterns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23329)
*Stefano Palombo,Claudio Di Sipio,Juri Di Rocco,Davide Di Ruscio*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: CodeXHug是一个精选数据集，将Hugging Face上的预训练模型(PTMs)与GitHub上实际使用这些模型的代码片段进行映射，包含7,325个模型和372,063个Python文件，旨在通过代码使用模式增强模型卡(model cards)的实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Hugging Face上的预训练模型虽广受欢迎，但许多模型卡缺乏具体的代码使用示例，给新手开发者集成和使用带来困难。同时，许多模型仅在玩具项目或作为HF仓库镜像使用，其在实际项目中的真实采用情况尚不清晰。因此需要构建一个关联PTMs与真实代码使用模式的精选数据集，以支持开发者和研究者更好地理解和使用PTMs。

Method: 数据收集流程包括：(1)基于2024年6月的HF社区项目转储进行数据清洗，筛选出262,670个具有标签和模型卡的PTMs；(2)按下载量选取前10%的流行模型(20,545个)，并在13个代表性类别中平衡采样，得到17,760个PTMs；(3)利用PyGithub库在GitHub上搜索这些PTMs的实际使用项目，收集Python源文件和README内容，最终得到7,325个模型和372,063个Python文件。数据存储采用MongoDB。应用场景方面：采用基于文件数(>100)的离群值过滤、K-means聚类(结合all-MiniLM-L6-v2嵌入模型)和基于IQR的代码长度过滤来识别代表性代码片段，再利用Llama 3模型以零样本提示方式生成代码使用模式。

Result: 数据集呈现出明显的长尾分布：少数PTMs(如gpt-2、roberta-large、Salesforce/blip-image-captioning-large)被超过800个项目广泛使用，而大多数PTMs使用频率较低；约43.7%的GitHub仓库使用多个PTMs。text-generation是最流行的标签。离群值过滤后，从63.99到369.82的均值文件数使分布更加均衡(偏度从3.86降至1.17，峰度从16.09降至0.31)。生成的代码使用模式示例(如kakaobrain/karlo模型)展示了数据加载、预处理和模型构建等典型模式。

Conclusion: CodeXHug是首个将Hugging Face PTMs与GitHub上实际代码使用进行全面映射的数据集，支持多种研究任务，包括代码助手开发、PTMs使用分析、模型卡自动生成以及API推荐。该数据集已在Zenodo开放获取。未来工作将扩展数据集规模、引入更多模型仓库(如TensorFlow Model Garden、ONNX Model Zoo)和源代码平台(如GitLab、Software Heritage)，采用更先进的聚类技术和不同LLM，并通过用户研究验证方法在实际项目中的有效性。

Abstract: Pre-trained models (PTMs) are becoming increasingly popular in the software engineering community. Their usage is facilitated by model repositories, e.g., HuggingFace, which collect, store, and maintain a wide range of PTMs. However, the actual adoption of these models in real-world projects is still an open question, i.e., many of them are used in toy projects or simply as a mirror for the HF repository. In addition, most of the available model cards and textual documents that contain critical information about their usage do not include explanatory code patterns, thus increasing the difficulty for newcomers. Thus, we see the need for a curated codebase related to PTMs to support developers and practitioners who are interested in using them in their projects. In this paper, we present CodeXHug, a curated dataset of HuggingFace PTMs exploited in the Github ecosystem and the related code usage patterns. Starting from the latest HF dump, we first conduct a data curation to collect PTMs with a tag and a model card. Then, the Github platform has been queried to find actual usages of the identified PTMs, resulting in 7,325 different models and 20,545 Python files. To demonstrate a concrete application of CodeXHug, we propose a usage scenario focused on extracting representative code usage patterns for specific PTMs through a statistical analysis and clustering techniques applied to relevant code snippets.

</details>


### [497] [The Prevalence and Impact of Licenses in Open Software Projects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23445)
*Mahmoud Jahanshahi,Bogdan Vasilescu,Audris Mockus*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对超过1亿个软件项目的许可证使用情况进行了大规模实证分析，揭示了开源许可证的整体分布、语言生态系统的差异，以及许可证变更对项目活跃度的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源许可证决定了代码如何被使用、再使用和分发，并影响项目的外部参与度和整体活跃度。然而，目前缺乏对许可证分布现状、跨语言生态系统差异以及许可证变更对项目活动影响的大规模系统性研究。

Method: 研究者对超过1亿个软件项目进行大规模分析，识别其许可证及许可证类型；按语言生态系统对项目进行分类；通过比较采用初始许可证和最终许可证一年内项目活动的变化，分析许可证变更对项目产出的影响。

Result: 研究发现：(1) 多数项目不包含任何许可证；(2) 宽松型许可证在数量上占主导，且占比随时间持续增长；(3) 限制性许可证更可能被保留下来；(4) 各语言生态系统之间存在显著差异，C语言生态系统明显倾向于限制性许可证；(5) 从限制性转向宽松型许可证的影响因生态系统而异——C语言生态系统活动减少，而Python生态系统活动则增加。

Conclusion: 许可证类型的流行程度在时间上发生了显著变化，且许可证变更的影响因语言生态系统不同而呈现相反效果，凸显了在开源治理中考虑语言生态背景的重要性。

Abstract: The terms of how publicly available source code can be used are dictated by its license. The license (or its absence), in turn, affects what code the project may reuse and how its code can be (re)used and may also affect external participation and overall activity of the project. We aim to better understand the general state of license distribution overall and within language ecosystems and to investigate if license changes are associated with a noticeable variations of project output. To accomplish that we identify licenses and license types for over 100M software projects and find that most do not contain any license, that permissive licenses represent the bulk of most licenses, and that permissive licensing is representing an increasing proportion of all licenses over time. Restrictive licenses are more likely to be retained, however. There is a great variation among language ecosystems with C-language strongly favoring restrictive licenses. The analysis of license change impact comparing activity within one year of the adoption of the initial and final licenses shows that the change from restrictive to permissive license varies with the ecosystem. C-language ecosystems show reduced activity while Python shows increased activity when comparing restrictive to permissive license transition. Our results demonstrate dramatic changes in license type prevalence over time and find that the effects of license changes may have opposite effects depending on the language ecosystem.

</details>


### [498] [An Automated Framework for Input Alphabet Construction in Stateful Protocol Implementation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23464)
*JiongHan Wang,WenChao Huang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于大语言模型(LLM)与结构化变异的自动化框架，用于在有状态协议实现的状态机学习中自动构建输入字母表，并结合Mini-Batch增量学习策略解决字母表膨胀带来的效率瓶颈。实验在FTP、SMTP、RTSP、TLS 1.3等4类协议的9个实现上复现了2个已知CVE漏洞，并新发现了10个语义缺陷（3个已修复，1个获CVE编号）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 状态机学习(state machine learning)是有状态协议语义漏洞检测的重要手段，但当前方法严重依赖人工手工定义输入字母表，存在两大瓶颈：(1)手工字母表无法覆盖非合规(non-conformant)消息，导致大量潜在语义缺陷被遗漏；(2)字母表规模膨胀会使基于L*算法的主动自动机学习产生Θ(k²)的成员查询复杂度，在大规模字母表下甚至无法在合理时间内终止。论文以TLS 1.3中wolfSSL的CVE-2022-25638为典型例证，说明构造触发漏洞所需的非标准消息(如EmptyCert和含未知签名算法的CertificateVerify)需要深度协议专家知识，难以跨协议泛化。

Method: 框架包含两大核心模块：(1) **扩展输入符号集的自动构建**：利用LLM(ChatGPT 5.3)解析协议规范并生成符合Header-Payload结构的JSON配置文件，再基于三类结构化变异规则——Payload Nullification(载荷置空)、Payload Error Content Replacement(载荷错误替换)、Header Error Content Replacement(首部错误替换)——生成覆盖合规与非法消息空间的候选符号集U = P ∪ M。(2) **Mini-Batch学习策略**：定义基础字母表Σ₀及核心状态机SM₀，再通过两种启发式策略逐步扩展——Single-Symbol Mutation Priority(单符号变异优先)适用于单消息型语义缺陷；Diverse-Symbol Mutation Priority(多符号变异优先，引入FIFO活跃窗口)适用于多消息协同型语义缺陷。为避免冗余学习，算法3将基础状态机的观测表(observation table)直接嵌入L*算法中，理论将查询复杂度由Θ(k²)降为Θ(Σkᵢ²)，实际在时间阈值T_th与最大窗口W_max约束下循环。

Result: 在LightFTP/ProFTPD/Pure-FTPD(FTP)、Exim(SMTP)、Live555(RTSP)、wolfSSL与OpenSSL(TLS 1.3 Server/Client)共9个被测实现上的实验表明：(1) **RQ1**：LLM生成的配置文件经人工核验全部符合协议规范，符号数较基础字母表扩展3–22倍(如FTP由6→207)；(2) **RQ2**：对完整符号集直接学习时LightFTP、RTSP等无法在12小时内终止，而Mini-Batch方法可在数分钟至数小时内完成；嵌入基础状态机后，单符号策略平均提速32.5%，多样符号策略在2小时内多学16.4%的状态机；(3) **RQ3**：成功复现CVE-2021-3336与CVE-2022-25638两个高危认证绕过漏洞(Diverse-Symbol策略在12小时内5次重复实验均100%检出)，并新发现10个语义缺陷(3个已修复，含Pure-FTPD中RNTO命令被分配CVE编号)，涵盖重复/不当返回码、TYPE/USER/CWD/PORT/PLAY命令的规范兼容性违规及空响应异常等。

Conclusion: 论文将LLLM的协议理解能力、基于变异的输入空间扩展与增量Mini-Batch学习相结合，提出了一种协议无关、可扩展的语义漏洞检测范式，突破了传统状态机学习对人工字母表与协议专业知识的依赖。该工作证明了自动化构造非合规消息输入的可行性，并为大型字母表下的高效学习提供了理论与实证支持(查询复杂度Θ(Σkᵢ²)优于直接Θ(k²))。作者亦指出当前手工变异策略在覆盖度与冗余开销上的局限，以及网络I/O与同步等待带来的效率问题，未来可融合fuzzing生成更具针对性的变异基元，并引入多线程缓解同步开销。

Abstract: As a prevalent analytical technique for stateful protocol implementations, state machine learning suffers from a core bottleneck stemming from handcrafted input alphabets. Manual alphabet definition inherently limits the completeness of input exploration, making it difficult to capture anomalous non-conformant messages and consequently missing latent semantic defects. In this paper, we target automatic input alphabet generation to break the above limitation for state machine learning. We adopt large language models to parse protocol message layouts and produce candidate input symbols following structured mutation rules, which automatically covers valid and invalid message spaces and eliminates reliance on manual protocol expertise. Considering the rising overhead brought by continuously growing alphabets, we introduce a mini-batch incremental learning strategy to reuse existing learned automata when incorporating new alphabet entries. Comprehensive experiments on practical protocol stacks indicate our approach can reproduce existing security vulnerabilities and identify novel semantic bugs. A subset of these newly discovered issues has been confirmed and patched by developers, proving the practicability and effectiveness of our proposed method.

</details>


### [499] [Ensuring Open Source Integrity: The Intersection of Copy-Based Reuse and License Compliance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23495)
*Mahmoud Jahanshahi,Bogdan Vasilescu,Audris Mockus*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文研究了开源软件中基于复制的代码重用（copy-based reuse）与许可证合规性问题。基于World of Code基础设施构建了全开源生态的复制式代码重用网络，通过回归模型量化了许可证类型对代码被复用概率的影响，并分析了潜在的许可证不合规风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注基于依赖关系的代码复用（如通过包管理器），而忽视了直接复制代码这种隐蔽的复用方式。这种复制式复用缺乏显式依赖声明，使得许可证合规性追踪极为困难。论文旨在量化这种潜在的许可证不合规风险，并理解许可证类型如何影响代码被复用的可能性。

Method: 1. 使用World of Code (WoC) 基础设施构建复制式代码重用网络（基于Ptb2Pt映射识别blob级别的复制关系）；2. 聚合到项目级别，得到18亿+唯一的上下游项目组合；3. 构建许可证复用矩阵，将许可证组合分为"无问题"、"低风险"和"高风险"三类；4. 使用逻辑回归模型（控制项目规模、活动度、编程语言等协变量）分析许可证类型对复用概率的影响；5. 分层抽样约50万项目用于回归，抽样57,341个高风险项目对用于复制式与依赖式复用的对比分析。

Result: **RQ1（许可证类型对复用概率的影响）：**
- 宽松许可证（MIT、Apache）在Python、C/C++、JavaScript项目中显著提高复用率
- Copyleft许可证总体上降低复用率，但在JavaScript项目中是例外
- 弱Copyleft许可证仅在Rust、C/C++和Java项目中降低复用率
- 公共域许可证出人意料地与较低的复用率相关（尤其在JavaScript和Ruby中），可能是由于法律不确定性

**RQ2（潜在的许可证不合规）：**
- 在低敏感度聚合下，39.4%的项目组合存在高风险潜在不合规
- "无许可证对无许可证"组合是最常见的高风险场景
- 依赖分析工具仅能发现2.43%的复制式重用，揭示了现有工具的严重不足
- 大量重用（82百万实例）存在潜在合规风险

Conclusion: 许可证类型是影响开源代码被复用的重要因素，但效果因编程语言而异。宽松许可证最有效地促进复用，而公共域许可证因法律模糊性反而抑制了复用。复制式代码重用是开源生态中许可证不合规风险的主要来源之一，而现有的依赖追踪工具严重不足以检测此类复用。论文呼吁开发更先进的复制式重用检测工具，加强开发者的许可证教育，并促进更明确和一致的许可实践。

Abstract: As other creative work, source code is protected by copyright. The owner can license the work, e.g., to permit copy and other kinds of use, and even start legal proceeding against license violators. However, source code can be reused in subtle ways, e.g., via copying without explicit package manager dependencies, making it hard to reason about potential license noncompliance. Using the World of Code infrastructure approximating the entirety of open source software, in this paper we create a copy-based code reuse network mapping direct copying across projects, and use it to quantify the extent of potential license noncompliance across the entire open source ecosystem. In addition, we estimate regression models to understand whether code copying is affected by the origin project's license, and, if so, how it varies with other project characteristics. We find that code in repositories with permissive licenses, such as MIT and Apache, shows higher likelihood of reuse across programming languages. In contrast, copyleft licenses, like the GPL, exhibit mixed effects. Public domain licenses, despite their aim of allowing unrestricted use, are associated with lower likelihood of copy-based reuse. A widespread potential license noncompliance appears to accompany copy-based reuse, with 39.4% of project combinations at potential noncompliance risk, particularly when licenses are unclear or absent. Our findings reveal that only 2.43% of reuse detected through the copy-based network was discoverable via dependency analysis, highlighting the limitations of existing dependency-tracking tools in capturing copy-based reuse.

</details>


### [500] [Source-Free Detection and Impact Analysis of Compiler Optimization Problems in Mobile Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23512)
*Han Hu,Xiaoheng Xie,Bo Sun,Jian Gu,Gang Fan,Li Li*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出OptDetect框架，通过二进制反汇编、指令块级分类和加权聚合，从移动应用二进制文件中无源码地检测编译器优化级别问题。研究发现30.5%的原生库使用低优化级别(O0/O1)，影响91.7%的Google Play头部应用；修复后CPU指令数减少10-63%，用户性能投诉减少42%，评分提升0.14分。生态系统层面，某主流第三方库仓库中49.7%的库存在低优化问题，揭示了被忽视的SDK供应链性能瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动应用普遍存在帧率下降、过热、功耗过高等性能问题。研究团队从一款热门游戏的HarmonyOS版本调试中发现，相同代码逻辑下HarmonyOS版本比Android版本多执行约60% CPU指令，根因在于部分原生库以O0/O1而非O2/O3编译。这种"无功能错误但性能退化"的隐蔽瓶颈在生产环境中长期未被发现，现有性能分析工具无法从二进制中识别编译优化级别，因此需要一种无源码的自动化检测方法来揭示这一被忽视的问题。

Method: 1) **框架设计**：OptDetect六阶段流水线——原生库提取、二进制反汇编(.text段)、指令分块(2048字节窗口)、BiLSTM深度学习分类(5个优化级别：O0/O1/O2/O3/Os)、加权分数聚合(权重O0=0.0, O1=0.25, O2=0.75, O3=1.0, Os=0.5)、优化级别分配(基于90%主导阈值和四个过渡区间)。2) **数据集**：Optimization-Detector(约17,000个.so文件)和Assemblage(真实GitHub项目)，按项目级别80/20划分，跨7种ISA训练统一模型。3) **RQ2大规模分析**：分析830个Google Play头部应用中的21,972个原生库。4) **RQ3案例研究**：6个商业App+6个开源App，通过PMU测量CPU退役指令数，分析13,156条应用商店评论。5) **生态系统调查**：分析某主流第三方库仓库的1,073个库。6) **开发者访谈**：18位有3年以上经验的开发者半结构化访谈。

Result: **RQ1检测精度**：Opt-Detector数据集加权准确率93.0%，F1=93.1%；Assemblage真实数据集加权准确率81.9%，F1=81.8%；二元低/高优化分类准确率90.8%；平均每个库分类耗时0.23秒。**RQ2流行度**：30.5%库为低优化水平，影响91.7%应用；仅4.1%达高优化；游戏类最差(32.7%-36.5%)，可穿戴次之(31.2%-34.2%)，常规App最好(24.3%-28.4%)；最常见的低优化库包括libcrashlytics-trampoline.so(146个应用，得分0.023)和Unity的libil2cpp.so(141个应用)。**RQ3影响**：商业App CPU指令减少10-63%(中位数20.5%)，开源App减少15-58%(中位数32%)；5/6商业App性能投诉关键词减少(中位数-42%，Wilcoxon检验p=0.031)，评分提升(中位数+0.14)；96%(24/25)开源App低优化库源自第三方预编译二进制；某主流仓库49.7%(533/1,073)的库存在低优化问题，83.7%为系统工具和FFI接口。

Conclusion: 编译器优化级别不匹配是移动应用生态中一个被广泛忽视但影响深远的系统性性能瓶颈。问题根源在于SDK供应商交付调试版本、依赖链复杂性、发布流程失误以及缺乏检测工具。OptDetect作为首个面向生产规模移动App的源无关检测框架，可集成至CI/CD流水线作为构建门禁，或在SDK仓库发布前进行审核。论文呼吁建立行业级优化标准，从供应链上游解决低优化原生库的传播问题。

Abstract: Mobile apps frequently suffer from performance issues such as frame drops, overheating, and excessive power consumption. While developers optimize algorithms and debug code, a critical bottleneck often goes unnoticed: native libraries compiled with low optimization levels (O0/O1 instead of O2/O3). Because these libraries execute without functional errors, the resulting performance degradation remains hidden in production apps, affecting millions of users. We present \textsc{OptDetect}, a source-free framework that detects compiler optimization problems directly from app binaries without requiring source code or build metadata. \textsc{OptDetect} handles mixed optimization levels within a single binary through a pipeline of binary disassembly, chunk-level classification, and weighted score aggregation, achieving 93.0\% accuracy on controlled datasets and 81.9\% on real-world datasets. Applying \textsc{OptDetect} to 21,972 native libraries from 830 top-ranked Google Play apps, we find that 30.5\% of libraries use low optimization levels, affecting 91.7\% of apps. Through case studies on 12 production apps (6 commercial, 6 open-source), we demonstrate that fixing detected issues reduces CPU instructions by 10-63\% (median: 20.5\%) for commercial apps and 15-58\% (median: 32\%) for open-source apps, with performance complaints decreasing by a median of 42\% and ratings increasing by a median of 0.14 points. Further investigation reveals a previously overlooked root cause: widely-used third-party libraries are themselves distributed at low optimization levels, with 49.7\% of 1,073 libraries in a major repository exhibiting this problem. These findings highlight the need for automated detection tools and industry-wide optimization standards.

</details>

### [501] [Universal Encoders for Modular Relational Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.21434)
*Jakub Peleška,Gustav Šír*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种模块化的关系深度学习（RDL）框架，核心是通用行编码器（Universal Row Encoder），将行级语义编码与图消息传递解耦，从而实现跨数据库的知识迁移与显著降低模型体积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RDL方法面临两大泛化瓶颈：（1）模式特定（schema-specific），每换一个新数据库需从头训练；（2）采用单体（monolithic）架构，将特征编码与图消息传递纠缠在一起，削弱了关系数据库的关键归纳偏置。社区需要向"关系基础模型"演进，以支持零样本/少样本的跨模式迁移。

Method: （1）提出关系基础模型的"四大支柱"概念框架：语义粒度、结构拓扑、时序因果性、统一优化。（2）将预测器分解为三段式模块化流水线 h_v=f_θ(r_v)，z_v=g_φ(G_S, h_v)，ŷ_u=d_ψ(z_u)。（3）核心组件通用行编码器为Transformer架构，对每列构造上下文嵌入 x_j = f_stype(v_j) + g_name(c_j) + g_table(t) + g_stats(s_j) + g_miss(δ_j)，将原始值、列/表名、全局分布统计量与缺失标记融合；列间采用无位置编码的intra-row self-attention，再以sum/max/attentive三种池化拼接投影到固定维度 d。（4）支持编码器单独预训练与端到端预训练两种监督预训练范式，采用leave-one-database-out协议。

Result: 在RelBench及CTU Relational共18个数据库上以leave-one-database-out协议验证：（1）通用行编码器在冻结编码器+同质GNN设置下即可在多个分类/回归任务上匹配或超过任务特定HGNN基线；（2）冻结编码器在user-visits、post-votes等任务上表现优异；（3）微调预训练编码器相对冻结仅有微弱提升，说明大部分可迁移收益在预训练阶段已被捕获；（4）模型体积最多缩减约10倍（如rel-trial上从368.81MB降至34.06MB），同时回归任务MAE仅出现约18%的相对增加。

Conclusion: 工作形式化并提出了关系基础模型的四大支柱，提供了以通用行编码器为核心的模块化RDL基线，证明预训练行级语义编码可加速新数据库的适配并显著缩小模型规模；当前实现主要解决第一支柱（语义粒度）问题，结构拓扑、时序因果与统一优化仍需后续研究在架构层面进一步落实。

Abstract: Relational Deep Learning (RDL) models multi-tabular databases as temporal heterogeneous graphs for end-to-end representation learning. While RDL is evolving rapidly, existing approaches face significant generalization obstacles. They are either schema-specific, requiring training from scratch for every new database, or they rely on monolithic architectures that entangle feature encoding with graph message-passing. Analyzing these limitations, we establish four core pillars for building foundational relational models: semantic granularity, structural topology, temporal causality, and unified optimization. Addressing these pillars, we propose a modular approach that decouples row encoding from graph message-passing. We introduce the Universal Row Encoder, a transformer-based module that integrates raw cell data with schema metadata$-$including column semantics, table names, and global distribution statistics$-$to produce table-width invariant row embeddings. By explicitly feeding global statistics to an intra-row self-attention mechanism, the encoder natively contextualizes unseen features and handles sparse data. Serving as a flexible "backend" for any downstream graph architecture, our pretrained encoder enhances cross-database knowledge transfer on the established RelBench benchmarks while improving learning convergence and memory footprint.

</details>


### [502] [Paraphrasing Attack Resilience of Various AI-Generated Text Detection Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14240)
*Andrii Shportko,Inessa Verbitsky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了三种AI生成文本检测方法（微调RoBERTa、Binoculars、文本特征分析）及其基于随机森林的集成方法在面对改写攻击（paraphrasing attack）时的鲁棒性，发现了一个核心矛盾：包含Binoculars的集成方法在正常检测中表现最佳（F1=0.8061），但在改写攻击下性能下降也最显著（F1降至0.6716），揭示了AI文本检测中性能与鲁棒性之间存在的权衡（tradeoff）困境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的广泛使用，AI生成文本的滥用问题（如学术造假、假新闻传播）日益严重，而人类对AI文本的手动检测准确率极低（仅约24%）。同时，AI检测绕过工具（如GPTinf等改写工具）层出不穷，使得现有检测方法的可靠性受到严重挑战。然而，此前的研究缺乏对当前最先进检测方法在改写攻击下鲁棒性的系统分析，特别是对零样本方法Binoculars的抗攻击能力尚不清楚。因此，本文旨在系统评估多种AI文本检测方法在改写攻击下的表现。

Method: 1. 数据集：使用COLING 2025 Task 1提供的二进制机器生成文本检测数据集（训练集610k条，测试集74k条），包含HC3、M4GT、MAGE、CURDT、IELTS、NLPeer、PeerSum和MixSet等子数据集。攻击数据使用GPTinf对201条AI文本进行改写，与201条人类文本组合（共402条）作为改写后测试集。

2. 三种检测模块：
- **微调RoBERTa**：添加大小为2的最终分类层，在12k条训练数据上微调（学习率2e-5，batch size=16，epochs=4）。
- **Binoculars**：使用falcon-7b和falcon-7b-instruct两个模型计算交叉困惑度（cross-perplexity），零样本方法。
- **文本特征分析**：提取5个文本特征——平均词长、词汇多样性、标点频率、句长标准差和停用词比率。

3. 集成方式：通过随机森林（Random Forest）作为元学习器，将三种模块的输出组合成特征向量，形成7种不同的集成方案。

4. 统计方法：使用bootstrap（n=9000）计算F1的置信区间，并使用21对McNemar检验进行配对统计比较（Bonferroni校正后α=0.0048）。

Result: **正常检测性能（攻击前）**：
- 三模块全集成（Text Features + RoBERTa + Binoculars）F1最高，达0.8061
- 文本特征 + Binoculars集成F1=0.8035（第二高）
- 任何集成均优于单一模块

**改写攻击后性能**：
- Binoculars单独使用时性能下降最严重（0.7497→0.5533，下降0.1964）
- RoBERTa鲁棒性最强，几乎无性能下降
- 文本特征方法也几乎无下降（0.7207→0.6682）
- 全集成方法从0.8061降至0.6716

**关键发现**：
1. 包含Binoculars的集成方法在攻击前性能最强，但攻击后下降最显著
2. RoBERTa对改写攻击的鲁棒性最好，表明其语言理解能力可捕捉深层特征
3. Binoculars的交叉困惑度方法对文本结构和措辞变化较敏感
4. 通过McNemar检验确认了部分模块间的性能差异具有统计显著性

**其他分析**：
- Binoculars的检测效果随上下文窗口增大而提升，在256-512 tokens处达到最优
- 量化对Binoculars的影响约为2%，在资源受限环境下不值得

Conclusion: 本文提出了"性能与鲁棒性的二元对立"（dichotomy of performance vs. resilience）这一核心观点：当前最先进的AI文本检测方法在面对改写攻击时表现出了显著的脆弱性，最高性能的方法恰恰是攻击下损失最大的方法。这一发现挑战了当前对SOTA检测技术可靠性的认知，呼吁AI检测社区重视性能-鲁棒性的权衡问题。研究还验证了多检测器堆叠的集成方法能带来显著的信息增益。论文建议未来工作应：（1）在更大的数据集和多种绕过攻击下复现结果；（2）测试分布外提示（out-of-distribution prompts）；（3）纳入更多特征（如情感分析）。本研究的局限在于改写数据集规模较小（200条），且仅测试了GPTinf一种改写工具。

Abstract: The recent large-scale emergence of LLMs has left an open space for dealing with their consequences, such as plagiarism or the spread of false information on the Internet. Coupling this with the rise of AI detector bypassing tools, reliable machine-generated text detection is in increasingly high demand. We investigate the paraphrasing attack resilience of various machine-generated text detection methods, evaluating three approaches: fine-tuned RoBERTa, Binoculars, and text feature analysis, along with their ensembles using Random Forest classifiers. We discovered that Binoculars-inclusive ensembles yield the strongest results, but they also suffer the most significant losses during attacks. In this paper, we present the dichotomy of performance versus resilience in the world of AI text detection, which complicates the current perception of reliability among state-of-the-art techniques.

</details>


### [503] [Towards CSI-Native Foundation Models: A Channel-Adaptive Roadmap for 6G](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20670)
*Chenyu Zhang,Xinchen Lyu,Chenshan Ren,Shuhan Liu,Qimei Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向6G的信道自适应CSI原生基础模型框架，通过将预训练、位置建模和注意力控制与无线信道的物理特性对齐，解决了现有方法将CSI视为通用张量而忽略其传播条件特性的根本缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无线基础模型研究主要遵循"通用骨干网络适配"和"CSI模型预训练"两条技术路线，但两者均将CSI简化为通用任务张量，忽略了CSI作为传播条件响应的本质特征——即时间-频率-空间三维几何结构。这种模态差异（modality gap）导致模型在学习过程中产生结构性失配，限制了跨场景、跨任务的泛化能力。论文指出，必须设计CSI原生基础模型，使模型在数据调度、位置编码和注意力控制全流程中嵌入信道自适应机制。

Method: 论文提出了一个统一的信道自适应框架，包含三个核心模块：(1) 异构性感知的预训练数据调度——通过尺度描述符构建、分桶约束批采样和场景保留随机化，将硬件引起的尺度变化与环境驱动的场景变化解耦；(2) 信道自适应3D位置编码——采用轴特定旋转先验、样本级调制和掩码相位应用，将CSI token索引转换为信道感知的时间-频率-天线物理偏移；(3) 相关性感知注意力控制——通过相关性上下文构建、自适应窗口调节和注意力执行机制，根据物理相干性边界动态约束token交互范围。

Result: 在模块级验证中：异构性感知预训练在CSI重建、时域预测和频域外推任务上分别降低NMSE达7.19 dB、4.08 dB和5.27 dB；3D位置编码在天线配置变化时展现出优越的尺度外推能力（8倍未见天线配置下增益达5.4 dB）；相关性感知注意力在中/高移动性下分别降低推理延迟16.1%和18.8%。在系统级评估（Sionna SYS）中：仅使用7.01%的密集导频开销即可达到-18.64 dB平均NMSE，净频谱效率相比密集LMMSE和WiFo分别提升36.6%和15.5%。

Conclusion: 论文论证了构建CSI原生基础模型的关键在于让AI核心组件与无线传播物理严格协同设计，而非简单移植通用基础模型方法论。信道自适应生命周期——涵盖尺度感知异构性暴露、物理时间-频率-天线几何编码和相关性约束的token交互——是可复用无线智能的架构性前提。论文还展望了CSI原生分词器、预训练目标、仿真到现实的少样本适配、部署感知模型和ISAC/数字孪生多模态融合等未来方向。

Abstract: Wireless foundation models offer a path toward reusable channel state information (CSI) intelligence for sixth-generation (6G) systems. However, existing generic-backbone adaptation and CSI pretraining methods often treat CSI as task tensors rather than propagation-conditioned channel responses, thereby failing to capture the intrinsic time-frequency-spatial geometry of wireless environments. This paper presents a channel-adaptive roadmap toward CSI-native foundation models, proposing a unified framework that aligns pretraining, positional modeling, and attention control with three channel requirements: scale-aware heterogeneous exposure, physical time-frequency-antenna coordinates, and correlation-bounded token interaction. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of the proposed framework across three dimensions: zero-shot generalization, reducing NMSE by more than 4 dB across spatial-temporal-frequency tasks; scale extrapolation, yielding up to a 5.4 dB gain under 8 times unseen antenna scaling; and inference efficiency, accelerating mobility-aware processing by up to 18.8%. A system-level evaluation with Sionna SYS further shows that the proposed framework uses only 7.01% of dense-pilot overhead, reaches -18.64 dB average NMSE, and improves average net spectral efficiency by 36.6% over dense LMMSE and 15.5% over WiFo, indicating that CSI-native representation learning can support pilot-efficient radio access.

</details>


### [504] [NeuroShield: A Device-Agnostic Foundation Model for EEG Authentication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.20673)
*Matin Fallahi,Patricia Arias-Cabarcos,Thorsten Strufe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出NeuroShield，一种用于EEG身份验证的设备无关基础模型。该模型采用双阶段Transformer架构，可处理变通道数、变通道布局和变信号长度的脑电信号。在15,762名受试者的3个公开数据集上预训练后，在2个未见过的下游数据集上微调使EER相对当前最优基线降低0.44–8.06个百分点，并能泛化到训练时未见过的通道布局和更长的信号窗口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG身份验证模型通常与采集设置（头戴设备硬件、通道布局、信号时长）绑定，导致每出现新设备或数据集都需重新开发模型，限制多数据集学习、知识迁移和模型复用。现有方法多采用固定输入结构（预定义通道集、固定时间窗口），难以跨设备、跨协议部署，是该领域面临的核心碎片化问题。

Method: 提出双阶段Transformer架构：(1) 时间Transformer独立处理每个通道的时间patch序列，使用固定ALiBi偏置支持变长输入；(2) 通道Transformer基于3D电极坐标编码的几何感知位置嵌入融合各通道的CLS token。训练采用监督对比损失（SupConLoss）+多相似度挖掘。在TUH-EEG（14,987受试者）、DVS-rsEEG（608受试者）、PREDICT（167受试者）三个数据集上预训练，覆盖17–64通道、7种通道布局；在PEERS和FRC-EEG两个未见设备上评估迁移能力，包含零样本、全微调（NS-FullFT）、最后层微调（NS-LastFT）、参数高效微调（NS-PEFT）四种迁移设置。

Result: 在PEERS数据集上，NS-FullFT将EER从基线10.25%降至7.71%（1秒窗口），4秒窗口时进一步降至5.47%（低于此前最优6.22%）；在FRC-EEG（消费级14通道Emotiv Epoc X）上EER从18.18%降至14.75%。零样本性能在所有未见设备上均显著低于50%随机水平（13.50%–21.05%）。模型可泛化到训练时未见的通道（21个PEERS-only通道与训练时见过的68个通道性能无显著差异），并可外推到训练时2.0秒以上的输入时长（4.0秒时EER持续降低）。通道随机丢失10%以内性能几乎不受影响。空间灵活性来自3D坐标编码而非通道顺序——打乱通道顺序影响很小，去除坐标信息则性能大幅下降。预训练数据组成分析表明多会话多样性比单纯增加单会话受试者数量更有价值。相对LaBraM等通用EEG基础模型在零样本设置下接近随机水平，NeuroShield在身份验证任务上具有明显针对性优势。

Conclusion: NeuroShield是首个可跨异构EEG采集设置（不同头戴设备、通道布局、信号时长）复用的身份验证基础模型，通过双阶段Transformer架构和3D几何感知位置嵌入实现灵活的时空输入。实验证明EEG身份验证可作为可复用的表征学习问题而非孤立的数据集特定建模任务。开源发布以支持可复现性和社区采用。局限性：EER仍高于人脸等成熟生物特征模态，需进一步降低；未来工作包括扩展预训练语料、评估更强威胁模型、研究消费级设备和跨协议设置的迁移。

Abstract: A central challenge in EEG authentication is that models are typically tied to the acquisition settings in which they are trained. In particular, variations in headset hardware, channel layout, and signal duration create heterogeneous recordings that existing models are not designed to handle, causing each new headset or dataset to be treated as a separate model-development problem. This fragmentation limits multi-dataset learning, hinders knowledge transfer, and reduces model reusability. To address this limitation, we present NeuroShield, a reusable foundation model for EEG authentication that learns identity-discriminative embeddings from variable-channel and variable-length EEG recordings through a dual-stage transformer architecture. We pretrain NeuroShield on three public EEG datasets comprising 15{,}762 subjects and 28{,}116 sessions, and evaluate transfer on two unseen downstream datasets. Our evaluations show that, after fine-tuning, NeuroShield reduces equal error rate by 0.44--8.06 percentage points relative to the state of the art. NeuroShield further generalizes to segments longer than those seen during training and operates across channel layouts not encountered during pretraining.
