Conclusion: LoadKAN成功构建了一种兼顾预测精度与内在可解释性的电力负荷预测框架，证明了混合KAN模型在电力预测领域的巨大潜力。其特征隔离注意力机制设计有效解决了KAN直接应用于时间序列的训练不稳定性问题，同时为KAN可解释性的充分发挥提供了结构保障。通过对六类移动模式的细粒度分析，该研究揭示了不同电力市场中人类活动与能源消费的复杂非线性关系，为电网运营、需求响应策略制定及能源规划提供了有价值的洞见。未来工作可探索建模移动特征之间的相互依赖关系以获得更全面的行为影响视图。

Abstract: Accurate electricity load forecasting is a crucial prerequisite for stable power system operations. While prevalent deep learning models present competitive performance, they often operate as black boxes and lack interpretability. While the Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN) has emerged as a promising alternative because of its learnable activation function design, its direct application to time-series forecasting faces challenges in modeling complex temporal data patterns. Also, simple integration into existing architectures, such as serving as replacement of neural modules, cannot fully leverage KAN's interpretability strengths. To address these gaps, this study develops LoadKAN, a novel hybrid and interpretable framework for load forecasting that synergistically combines a specifically-designed feature-isolated temporal attention mechanism with a KAN module. The attention stage aims to extract temporal dynamics from each input feature independently, such as historical load and human mobility, providing distilled feature representations to the KAN module for interpretable predictions. When evaluated on datasets from three representative U.S. electricity markets, our LoadKAN remains highly competitive when compared to extensively-tuned, state-of-the-art, black-box deep learning benchmarks. More importantly, LoadKAN's interpretability enables a granular analysis of the learned non-linear relationships between six distinct mobility patterns and electricity load. Through KAN-learned activation functions, our quantitative sensitivity analyses on mobility features reveal complex and market-specific dependencies. These findings further demonstrate the ability of our LoadKAN to generate insights often obscured by opaque black-box neural forecasting models.

</details>


### [768] [Selective Time Series Forecasting via Metalearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23448)
*Ricardo Inácio,Vitor Cerqueira,Marília Barandas,Carlos Soares*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于元学习（metalearning）的选择性时间序列预测框架，通过从近期滞后值中提取结构性特征来建模预测误差的经验百分位秩（一种尺度不变统计量），从而在预测发出之前实现拒绝机制。该方法将拒绝决策与预测本身及训练域解耦，使其能够跨异构时间序列领域有效迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习在时间序列预测中虽然取得了最先进的结果，但其精度在不同样本间差异显著——某些实例本质上难以预测。虽然拒绝选项机制（reject option）在分类和回归中已较为成熟，但在预测领域探索不足。现有方法通常依赖预测区间宽度或置信度分数等代理指标，但这些方法与训练域紧密绑定，泛化能力有限。

Method: 方法分为两个阶段：（1）性能估计——通过滚动起点（rolling origin）评估在源域上收集预测误差；（2）元学习——以经验百分位秩（经逐序列归一化的尺度不变目标）作为回归元目标，以从近期滞后窗口中提取的结构性特征（通过TSFEL提取趋势、季节性、复杂度等统计/时域/频域描述符）作为输入，使用CatBoost回归器训练元模型。推理时元模型在预测发出之前对每个预测起点进行评分，可选择零样本迁移或领域自适应。预测模型采用KAN和NHITS两种架构。

Result: 在M3、M1和Tourism基准数据集的域内和迁移学习实验中，该方法在Spearman秩相关（0.71-0.90）、AUCO和ErrDrop等元层级指标上一致优于基于预测区间宽度、残差尺度、残差方差等基线方法。在基层级评估中，方法在不同拒绝比例（q=0.05至0.40）下均持续降低保留预测的sMAPE，且与oracle上界的平均差距最小。领域自适应（使用30%目标域数据）显著恢复迁移性能，证实了尺度不变设计的有效性。

Conclusion: 该研究证明可预测性（forecastability）可被视为近期观测的结构性属性，从而在预测实现之前实现风险感知决策。尺度不变目标与领域无关特征的结合使拒绝机制能有效跨域迁移。局限性包括依赖元训练数据的代表性、不提供形式化不确定性量化保证。未来的方向包括与保形预测结合以实现校准覆盖保证、扩展到多元和不规则时间序列、以及预测器与拒绝模型的联合训练。

Abstract: Deep learning methods have achieved state-of-the-art in time series forecasting, yet their accuracy varies considerably across samples, as some instances remain inherently difficult to predict. Reject option mechanisms, which allow models to abstain from high-risk predictions, are well established in classification and regression but underexplored in forecasting. Existing abstention strategies typically rely on proxies, such as the width of the prediction interval or learned confidence scores derived from forecasts. However, these approaches are inherently tied to the training domain, limiting their ability to generalize. We propose a selective forecasting framework that addresses this limitation by modeling the empirical percentile of forecasting errors, that is, a scale-invariant statistic, based on structural characteristics extracted from recent lags via metalearning. By decoupling the rejection decision from the forecast itself and grounding it in domain-agnostic features, the framework enables effective abstention transfer across heterogeneous time series. Experiments in both in-domain and transfer learning settings show that rejecting samples predicted as challenging consistently improves forecasting accuracy across coverage levels.

</details>


### [769] [Do Location Encoders Capture Spatial Effects? A GeoShapley Benchmark Across Scales](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23453)
*Daniel Kiv,Shaowen Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文使用博弈论解释器 GeoShapley，对 TorchSpatial 框架中的 11 种位置编码器在网格、郡县和全球三个尺度下恢复空间变化系数（SVC）的能力进行了基准测试，评估其在有无原始坐标、是否经过对比训练条件下恢复真实空间效应的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 位置编码器将地理坐标映射为高维嵌入以供下游机器学习使用，但这些嵌入是否捕获了可解释的空间效应尚不明确。当空间输入本身由神经网络生成时，位置就成为黑箱中的黑箱——地理信息分散于 D 个嵌入维度中，标准逐特征事后解释器会将归因分散到所有维度，无法恢复单一连贯的位置效应。GeoShapley 通过将所有位置特征视为单一联合玩家解决了该问题，但此前仅在原始坐标和解析空间基上验证过，对学习型任务无关神经编码器（覆盖平面与球面几何）的恢复能力尚未经过测试。

Method: （1）方法框架：采用 GeoShapley 将所有位置特征分组为单一联合玩家 "GEO"，通过 Shapley 值框架计算内在位置效应及与协变量的交互效应，从而恢复 SVC。（2）合成数据：响应变量为两个非空间协变量的线性组合，系数随空间变化（β₀ 抛物线、β₁ 线性梯度、β₂ 正弦/多尺度振荡），覆盖 25×25 网格（N=625）、美国郡县质心（N≈3,000）和全球采样（N=10,000）三个尺度；β₂ 在全球尺度上构建为跨反子午线连续的球面多尺度振荡。（3）编码器：测试 11 种 TorchSpatial 编码器（Space2Vec-grid/-theory、tile_ffn、wrap_ffn、NeRF、五个 Sphere2Vec 变体、随机傅里叶特征），D=8；包含无编码器的原始坐标基线。（4）条件：交叉设计——有/无原始坐标 × 未训练/对比训练，共四种配置。（5）模型与评估：下游使用 MLP（ReLU 激活，Adam 优化，5 折随机搜索调参），每组配置 25 个随机种子；用 GeoShapley 恢复 β̂₀、β̂₁、β̂₂，以 Pearson 相关系数 r 作为主要评估指标。（6）鲁棒性：补充非线性数据生成过程验证。

Result: （1）β₁ 恢复在所有尺度、所有编码器下均高度保真（r>0.98），几乎无差异。（2）β₂ 恢复更具尺度依赖性：网格和郡县尺度下，大多数编码器达 r≈0.92–0.95，原始坐标基线具有竞争力，编码器间的微小优势（≤0.02）可忽略；全球尺度下编码器差异显著扩大——Sphere2Vec-sphereM+（r=0.991）、wrap_ffn（r=0.988）、Sphere2Vec-dfs（r=0.982）表现最佳，其余编码器与基线（r=0.926）聚集在 0.92–0.94 区间。（3）对比训练通常不改善甚至轻微降低恢复性能（Δ 多为负），仅 Sphere2Vec-sphereM 在全球 β₂ 上提升 0.030。（4）移除原始坐标后，编码器间差异显著扩大并出现尺度反转：全球恢复最佳的编码器（Sphere2Vec-sphereM+、wrap_ffn、Sphere2Vec-dfs）在网格尺度上跌至 r≈0.56–0.64，而 NeRF、Space2Vec-grid、rff 在网格上保持 r≈0.85+ 但在全球上表现差。（5）非线性鲁棒性测试中，β₂ 恢复基本不变，β₁ 因 GeoShapley 将全局非线性吸收到主效应中而中度下降（Δr 从 -0.02 到 -0.07），全球尺度编码器排序保持不变。

Conclusion: 研究明确了位置编码器架构重要性具有清晰的尺度依赖性：网格和郡县尺度下编码器差异小、归一化坐标即可满足需求；全球尺度下编码器差异显著（特别是涉及反子午线跨度的空间效应）。未训练编码器在多数情况下匹配或优于对比训练版本，表明对比目标与 SVC 恢复不对齐。编码器选择仅在嵌入独立承担位置表征时（无原始坐标辅助）才成为关键问题，且全球最优的编码器恰是网格最差的，反之亦然——存在明显的尺度权衡。实践建议：始终将原始坐标与嵌入并用，使恢复在嵌入不适配尺度时优雅降级；仅在原始坐标表现不足的场景下才使用专门编码器。本研究将 GeoShapley 扩展到学习型高维位置编码器（而非解析空间基），为空间公平性审计提供了可操作工具。局限性：合成过程平滑且连续；嵌入维度固定为 D=8；结果特定于 MLP 和解释器设置。未来工作应评估更高嵌入维度、与 SVC 恢复更好对齐的对比目标、不连续空间效应及部分已知空间过程的真实数据。

Abstract: Location encoders transform geographic coordinates into high dimensional embeddings for downstream machine learning, but it is unclear how well these representations capture interpretable spatial effects. We benchmark whether GeoShapley, a game-theoretic explainer that treats all location features as a single joint player, can recover spatially varying coefficients from models built on location-encoder embeddings. Eleven encoders from the TorchSpatial framework are evaluated against a synthetic process with known coefficients, across three scales (grid, county, global), with and without raw coordinates alongside the embedding, and under untrained and contrastively trained conditions. Measuring recovery as the correlation between estimated and true coefficients, we report how it varies with scale and encoder architecture and compare the embeddings against a raw-coordinate baseline. Recovery of the primary coefficient is consistently high across encoders, whereas recovery of a secondary coefficient is more scale-dependent, differing most at the global scale; the raw-coordinate baseline remains competitive throughout.

</details>


### [770] [TROPT: An Open Framework for Unifying and Advancing Discrete Text Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23496)
*Matan Ben-Tov,Mahmood Sharif*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TROPT是首个面向离散文本触发器优化的开源统一框架，将模型、损失函数和优化器解耦为可互换的模块化组件，内置30+优化配方、15+优化器（涵盖白盒到黑盒）和15+损失函数，显著降低了离散文本优化器的采用和开发门槛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前离散文本触发器优化器面临两大障碍：1）开源实现分散在不同研究代码库中，耦合于特定模型/目标/领域，工程开销巨大；2）优化器变体激增却难以公平对比，导致进展难以追踪。LLM越狱、语料投毒、模型审计等安全研究因此受阻，可能造成"虚假安全感"。

Method: 核心设计：四个模块化组件（model、loss、optimizer、inputs/targets）通过统一接口组合成可执行的"配方（recipe）"。关键原则是模块化和后端-前端分离——模型相关基础设施逻辑（模板、批处理、梯度/损失计算）封装在model后端中，使loss和optimizer前端保持轻量、专注算法本身。新优化器或损失只需实现标准化API即可与所有现有配方组合。提供Recipe Hub预配置38+即用配方。

Result: 1）优化器基准测试（§4.1）：在4个开源LLM上对比14个优化器，发现PAL和MAC显著优于标准GCG基线，RAL（PAL的无梯度版本）作为黑盒优化器可与白盒GCG媲美；2）越狱增强对比（§4.2）：目标字符串选择是关键瓶颈，使用"越狱后模型"的真实响应作为目标可将通用性提高约2倍；3）跨域泛化（§4.3）：成功将LLM越狱优化器移植到语料投毒（攻击OpenAI专有嵌入模型）、提示注入分类器规避和文生图模型提示恢复。GCG实现与NanoGCG最终损失相当但速度快2.5倍。

Conclusion: TROPT作为首个统一的离散文本优化框架，通过模块化设计有效解决了优化器碎片化和难以比较的问题，显著降低了采用和推进离散优化研究的门槛。未来工作方向包括：跨领域标准化基准测试、利用TROPT基础设施支持自动优化器发现代理、以及将其应用于更广泛的安全审计和防御研究。

Abstract: Discrete text-trigger optimization -- searching for text sequences that, when ingested by a model, steer it toward a specified objective -- underpins model red-teaming (e.g., LLM jailbreaks), as well as auditing and interpretability. However, the current state of discrete optimizers hinders their adoption and progress. First, existing optimizers, when open-sourced at all, are scattered across research codebases tied to specific models, objectives, and problem domains. Second, optimizer variants proliferate, each requiring engineering overhead to use or extend, and remaining hard to compare head-to-head. Together, these raise the bar for adopting optimizers in existing or new domains, and for advancing them via new strategies. We address these gaps with TROPT, the first open-source framework that unifies discrete optimizers' execution and standardizes their development under a single interface. TROPT makes it easy to customize end-to-end optimization recipes by swapping any component -- models, objectives, and optimizers -- extending its reach across domains and new applications. TROPT currently ships with 30+ optimization recipes -- covering applications such as jailbreaking and probing model internals -- built from 15+ optimizers (spanning white-box to black-box access) and 15+ losses, from foundational to state-of-the-art methods. Demonstrating its utility, we leverage TROPT in several studies: (i) controlled, large-scale experiments comparing and enhancing optimization strategies for LLM jailbreaks, revealing potent-yet-underadopted techniques; and (ii) porting optimizers from one domain (e.g., LLM jailbreak) to new domains (e.g., corpus-poisoning embedding model). In all, TROPT significantly lowers the barrier to adopting and advancing discrete text optimization.

</details>


### [771] [Collapsed Effective Operators for Higher-order Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23517)
*Maximilian Krahn,Lennart Bastian,Vikas Garg,Björn Schuller,Tolga Birdal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"折叠有效算子"（Collapsed Effective Operators），通过分级Laplacian的Schur补，将高阶拓扑自由度压缩为单一顶点级算子，从根本上解决高阶谱信息融合到顶点级任务的难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高阶谱算子（如Hodge Laplacian）按秩（rank）分解拓扑结构，导致"融合问题"（fusion problem）：如何将不同秩的表示融合为顶点级信号缺乏统一原则，往往依赖手工聚合方案或领域特定启发式方法。多数实际任务（节点分类、谱聚类、分子属性预测）需要在顶点层面进行预测，而高阶拓扑信息无法直接迁移至顶点。

Method: 1. 在分级上链空间C•(X)上定义Graded Laplacian L*，对角块为加权秩局部Laplacian，非对角块通过边界/关联矩阵耦合相邻秩。 2. 证明L* ⪰ 0的充分条件：γ_k ≤ β_{k+1}·σ⁺_min(B_{k+1})。 3. 通过Schur补将L*分块为(A, X; X⊤, C)，定义折叠有效算子S := A - XC⁻¹X⊤，将高阶结构"边际化"到顶点空间。 4. 采用Tikhonov正则化S_ε := A - X(C+εI)⁻¹X⊤处理C的奇异性，给出正则化误差界‖S_ε - S†‖₂ ≤ ε‖X‖²₂/(λ₊(λ₊+ε))。 5. 通过稀疏块结构和共轭梯度法实现隐式矩阵-向量乘法，避免显式求逆和稠密化。 6. 推广至组合复形（Combinatorial Complexes），通过"秩填充"（rank filling）处理跨秩关联。

Result: 1. **流形去噪**：在随机添加200条捷径边的情况下，重建MSE仅从0.066微增至0.073（标准图Laplacian恶化为0.099），证明对拓扑噪声的鲁棒性。 2. **蛋白质二级结构聚类**（Topotein基准）：准确率达70.9%，显著优于图Laplacian的46.9%，成功恢复交错的空间相邻但拓扑不同的二级结构。 3. **谱聚类**：在SBM基准上Dense-Cliques +3%、Unequal-Sizes +6%；真实网络Football +3%、Les Misérables +2%。 4. **Mantra Betti数分类**：β₁上达到0.95（vs 图Laplacian 0.92），远优于GAT/GCN的0.31-0.33。 5. **节点分类**（蛋白质）：SchurPE位置编码在Contact和ResType任务上均优于LaplacePE（GT+SchurPE: 0.573 vs 0.551 Contact；0.789 vs 0.762 ResType）。 6. **计算效率**：V=2000时稀疏CG方法（75.51s）比直接分解（323.14s）快4倍以上；V=3000时直接求解器OOM，CG成功处理。

Conclusion: 折叠有效算子为高阶结构提供了原则性的顶点级算子，将高阶拓扑的影响编码为长程、非局部的顶点间耦合。理论分析证明了正半定性和谱上界（λ_k(S) ≤ λ_k(A)），赋予其"降低系统有效电导"的物理解释。实证表明该算子在谱聚类、信号平滑、蛋白质分析和神经网络位置编码等任务中均有效。局限性在于：折叠不保留完整分级谱（秩局部不变量可能部分丢失），且算子通常稠密，依赖隐式应用；未来方向包括时变拓扑、度量感知权重和可学习的有效算子。

Abstract: Higher-order structures are powerful relational modeling tools, yet existing spectral operators decompose the topology into separate ranks, leaving practitioners to fuse the information back to vertices through ad hoc choices. We introduce Collapsed Effective Operators, which condense higher-order degrees of freedom into a single vertex-level operator via Schur complementation of a graded Laplacian. This yields a (generally dense) operator that encodes long-range interactions mediated by topology and is applicable to arbitrary higher-order constructs. We show it preserves positive semi-definiteness with a spectral upper bound relative to the rank-0 Hodge Laplacian, effectively lowering system energy under higher-order connectivity. Empirically, our operator improves spectral clustering, signal smoothing, and enables the inclusion of topological features in neural network architectures via positional encoding. The project page can be found this http URL

</details>


### [772] [Simulation-Free Estimation of Traffic Flows from Sparse Count Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23536)
*Davide Guastella,Gianluca Bontempi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种无需仿真的层次化方法，通过区域级加权最小二乘优化和链路级候选路径评分，从稀疏传感器计数数据中重建时变交通流模式，并在布鲁塞尔道路网络上以约180倍的速度优势超越基于仿真的基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有交通流估计方法面临两大核心矛盾：(1) 基于仿真的校准方法精度高但计算成本巨大，每次迭代需运行完整交通仿真，难以扩展至城市级网络或在线应用；(2) 离线无仿真方法虽快，但通常依赖先验OD矩阵、GPS轨迹或密集传感器覆盖，且缺乏对边缘级的精细控制。此外，反问题本质欠定，区域级聚合计数与边缘级流量之间存在多解性。本文旨在解决关键挑战：能否仅从稀疏传感器计数出发，无需仿真反馈和先验OD矩阵，以可扩展至城市级网络的计算成本，准确估计时变交通流模式。

Method: 方法采用两阶段层次化分解策略。**区域级分配**：将研究区域划分为3000 m²方形空间区域，构建可行区域间路径集合Φ，定义加权贡献矩阵C(φ,ρ)（按传感器覆盖率加权），将预测区域计数表示为ŷᵗ = Cᵀxᵗ，通过加权最小二乘优化求解车辆分配向量xᵗ。目标函数L由两部分组成：(1) 加权区域损失L_reg（逆观测计数加权，抑制高流量区域主导梯度）；(2) 聚合损失L_aggr（惩罚预测与观测总量的相对偏差）。使用Adam梯度优化器，结合梯度裁剪（δ=10）和Softplus变换保证非负约束。**链路级分配**：对每条区域路径，通过均匀采样选择代表性"经过边"，依次计算最短路径拼接为候选边缘路径集合Π(φ)，利用体积覆盖度（coverage）和时序形状相似度（shape）双重评分，softmax转化为概率分布并采样得到具体车辆轨迹。贡献矩阵通过传感器覆盖率加权，引导优化朝向可直接观测的流配置。

Result: 在布鲁塞尔道路网络（OpenStreetMap提取，369个传感器，2024年3月1日数据，下采样因子3）上：MAE=44.16，RMSE=51.80，NRMSE=0.004，显著优于基于仿真的基线（MAE=67.02）和RouteSampler（MAE=192.45）。区域级分配仅需约23秒（单次边缘级分配0.2秒），比仿真基线（约69分钟）快约180倍，比RouteSampler（3小时）更快。成功再现日交通双峰特征。合成场景验证（80,000车辆，区域路径长度2/4/6）表明估计的转移矩阵Q保留了地面真实的全局路由结构，残差集中在少量OD对（≤±0.20概率）；Shannon熵沿对角线强对齐；轨迹对数似然分布峰值位于[-5, 0]区间。中央城区因高密度和饱和度出现局部最大MAE（4.241）。存在过拟合传感器位置的趋势，需控制优化迭代次数并引入时序正则化（用t时刻解初始化t+1）。

Conclusion: 该方法通过层次化分解在区域级强制保证区域一致性，这是全局校准方法不具备的结构性优势，具有仿真无关、可微分、可扩展（问题维度取决于区域路径数而非网络边数）的特性。主要局限：(1) 反问题欠定，无观测区域存在多解性，仅恢复"合理且区域一致"的模型而非真实模型；(2) 边缘级采用最短路径启发式，无法捕捉拥塞下的真实路径选择；(3) 对优化迭代次数敏感，过多迭代会导致流量集中于有传感器路径，损害无观测走廊的精度。改进方向包括：融合探测车/浮动车数据/移动网络指标等多源数据约束问题、以学习型路径选择模型替代最短路径启发式、采用元学习进行超参数自动调优。

Abstract: We propose a method for estimating time-varying traffic flow patterns from sparse aggregated vehicle counts. The method partitions the study area into spatial regions, constructs a set of feasible region-to-region routes, and solves a weighted least-squares optimization problem to determine the number of vehicles to allocate on each route. A weighted contribution matrix encodes sensor coverage, steering the optimizer toward flow configurations that are directly observable by sensors. Edge-level trajectories are then derived by scoring candidate routes against the temporal and volumetric profiles of aggregated regional sensor counts. The method is evaluated on the Brussels road network using real and synthetic traffic data. Results show that the proposed approach reproduces the daily traffic profile in the input data and outperforms the baseline methods at a fraction of the computational cost.

</details>


### [773] [SVD-Surgeon: Optimal Singular-Value Surgery for Large Language Model Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23568)
*Mahmoud Safari,Frank Hutter*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SVD-Surgeon，一种基于最优脑外科（OBS）框架的无训练LLM压缩方法，通过在奇异值空间中构建Fisher信息矩阵，推导出保留奇异值的闭式二阶更新，补偿被截断奇异值造成的损失，显著改善了SVD-LLM在OPT和LLaMA-2-7B上的困惑度-压缩率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型部署受限于巨大的内存和计算需求。现有SVD压缩方法关注如何分解和保留哪些奇异值，但忽略了对保留奇异值进行二阶损失补偿。此外，基于幅度的剪枝准则并非损失最优，缺乏原则性指导。

Method: 1. 将权重矩阵分解为θ=UΣV⊤（不要求U、V正交），在奇异值空间中构建二阶损失模型；2. 利用经验Fisher信息（梯度外积）估计ℓ×ℓ的投影Hessian矩阵H̄；3. 推导保留奇异值的闭式最优更新δσ_S* = H̄_SS⁻¹H̄_SC σ_C；4. 推导出单奇异值的OBS显著性σ_i²/2[H̄⁻¹]_ii；5. 提出两种变体：U（继承宿主剪枝集+补偿）和S（基于显著性重选+补偿）。

Result: 在OPT-1.3B/2.7B/6.7B和LLaMA-2-7B上的实验显示，SVD-Surgeon在所有压缩率下均优于SVD-LLM基线，在高压缩率下提升尤为显著。例如OPT-6.7B在ρ=0.7时WikiText-2困惑度从944.57降至46.36（U变体）和46.36（S变体）；LLaMA-2-7B在ρ=0.8时从570.44降至531.62（S变体）。整个过程无需重训练。

Conclusion: SVD-Surgeon将OBS框架成功迁移至奇异值空间，以训练免费、闭式的方式补偿截断损失，可作为通用模块层叠在现有SVD压缩器之上。方法在高压缩率下效果最佳，但目前仅更新奇异值不更新方向U、V，且需手工调参，未来工作包括联合更新U、V、Σ以及跨层秩分配等。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks, but their deployment is constrained by substantial memory and compute requirements. Low-rank compression via singular value decomposition (SVD) is an effective remedy, but existing methods focus on how to factorize and which components to keep. We introduce SVD-Surgeon, a training-free method that brings the Optimal Brain Surgeon (OBS) framework to the singular-value basis. Treating each singular value as a parameter, it computes a closed-form update of the retained singular values that compensates, to second order in the model loss, for those removed by truncation. The same analysis yields a saliency for choosing which values to prune. As it operates directly on the singular-value factorization, SVD-Surgeon can be layered on top of existing SVD compressors. Applied to SVD-LLM, a leading SVD-based method, it improves the perplexity-compression trade-off on the OPT family and LLaMA 2-7B without any retraining.

</details>


### [774] [Patient-Aware Contrastive Learning Preserves Per-Patient Structure in RR-Interval Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23570)
*Yasantha Niroshana,Weijith Wimalasiri,Chathuranga Hettiarachchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种面向阵发性房颤（PAF）检测的患者感知对比学习目标，仅将"同患者、同类别"的RR间期片段作为正样本对，从而在保持类间可分性的同时保留每位患者自身的窦性心律（SR）基线结构。在IRIDIA-AF数据集上取得患者独立AUROC 0.989±0.003，且种子方差比SupCon低2.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准对比表示学习假设同类样本均可作正样本，但在生理信号中每位患者都有独特的基线模式。监督对比学习（SupCon）会把所有患者的个体生理差异折叠进一个共享的类簇；BCE虽能产生最清晰的全局类间分离，却使每位患者内部的SR结构变得无序。两者都会导致在已见患者上训练的线性探针无法泛化到未见患者。作者认为：决定跨患者泛化能力的关键不是全局类可分性，而是每位患者内部表示的"几何一致性"。

Method: 在通用InfoNCE框架下重新定义正负样本集：对于锚点i，其正样本集𝒫(i)={j≠i | p_j=p_i 且 y_j=y_i}，负样本集𝒩(i)={j≠i | y_j≠y_i}。关键区别于SupCon之处在于：来自不同患者但同类的片段被排除在正样本之外，从而防止编码器将不同患者的SR基线坍缩到同一类原型。数据采用IRIDIA-AF单导联长程心电记录，按患者划分（119/24/24），用每名患者前1小时SR做RobustScaler拟合，后续小时切窗（W=200拍，步长50拍）生成不重叠的分类窗口。编码器为多分支1D-CNN（核大小3/5/7）+时序注意力池化+两层MLP投影至ℝ¹²⁸。训练采用患者感知mini-batch采样（P=8患者，每患者每类n=16窗口），AdamW+余弦退火，Optuna-TPE调参。通过冻结编码器+线性探针评估下游PAF检测性能，并直接在嵌入空间度量每患者类内凝聚度、全局类间距离/相似度/紧致比等几何指标。

Result: 在嵌入空间几何分析中，所提方法取得最高的每患者SR凝聚度0.850±0.044（SupCon 0.800±0.029，BCE 0.772±0.049），AF凝聚度保持均衡（0.846 vs. SupCon 0.921、BCE 0.955）。BCE呈现"悖论"：全局质心距离最大（1.603）、质心余弦相似度最低（−0.717）、全局紧致比最高（2.427），但下游泛化最差。下游PAF检测中，所提方法AUROC 0.989±0.003，比SupCon（0.983±0.009）高+0.006、比BCE（0.980±0.012）高+0.009，且种子方差比SupCon降低2.6倍、比BCE降低3.4倍。AF召回率0.974±0.008。患者独立测试中灵敏度97.40±0.80%，比Andersen等人（2019）的跨患者保持集灵敏度（86.04%）提升超11个百分点。

Conclusion: 核心结论是：跨患者泛化的关键不是全局类可分性，而是"每患者内部几何一致性"。BCE悖论（类间分离最好却泛化最差）正是这一论断的直接证据。通过将正样本构造限制为同患者同类别，既避免了SupCon把不同患者坍缩到同一类原型的缺陷，也避免了BCE在患者间位置漂移的问题。该正样本构造策略不依赖具体编码器，仅需训练时具有类别标签和受试者ID，可推广至其他按受试者组织、且受试者内变异具有信息量的生理信号（如EEG、EMG、PPG）。未来方向包括：形式化分解每患者的对齐与均匀性、利用保留的SR结构做少样本个性化适应、以及多中心前瞻验证。

Abstract: Contrastive representation learning struggles on physiological signals when each subject contributes a distinct baseline pattern. If class differences overlap with subject differences,class-level objectives such as supervised contrastive learning tend to merge per-subject structure into a single per-class cluster,removing the individual variation that a model needs to generalize to unseen patients. We study this problem in the setting of Paroxysmal Atrial Fibrillation(PAF) detection from RR-interval(RRI) sequences and propose a patient-aware contrastive objective that forms positive pairs only from same-patient, same-class segments, preserving each patient's own sinus rhythm(SR) baseline while still pushing the two classes apart. Examining the learned embeddings directly, our objective achieves the most consistent per-patient SR structure (cohesion $0.850$ vs. $0.800$ for supervised contrastive loss (SupCon) and $0.772$ for binary cross-entropy (BCE)). We also identify that BCE produces the cleanest global class separation yet the most disordered per-patient structure. This is precisely why a linear probe trained on its features breaks down on unseen patients. On the IRIDIA-AF dataset, the resulting representation reaches a patient-independent Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUROC) of $0.989 \pm 0.003$ with $2.6\times$ lower seed variance than supervised contrastive this http URL results highlight that per-subject geometric consistency, rather than global class separability, is key to robust cross-patient generalization.

</details>


### [775] [A Spectral Theory of Normalized Corrected GNN Propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23572)
*Qihan Chen,Wei Li,Meng Qin,Jianfeng Hou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对GCN风格模型中的对称归一化邻接矩阵，提出了一种"归一化修正传播"的谱理论。通过减去度平稳（degree-stationary）秩一分量构造修正算子 $\widehat{A}$，证明了在二元CSBM中 $k=O(\log n)$ 层传播后的精确恢复定理，以及在多类CSBM中的部分恢复定理，其核心技术工具是逐项残差幂的界与装饰游走计数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度GNN的过度平滑（oversmoothing）问题：反复应用归一化传播算子 $D^{-1/2}AD^{-1/2}$ 会放大度平稳方向、衰减类判别信号。核心问题是：能否在算子层面修正归一化传播，使其在对数深度下仍可证明地保持类别信息？现有工作（如Wang et al. 2024）仅分析非归一化情形，而GCN实际使用归一化版本，其中度归一化引入非线性分母和随机平稳向量，需要全新的分析工具。

Method: 1. **算子构造**：定义 $\widehat{A}=D^{-1/2}AD^{-1/2}-\frac{1}{\mathbf{1}^\top D\mathbf{1}}D^{1/2}\mathbf{1}\mathbf{1}^\top D^{1/2}$，减去度加权平稳秩一分量。2. **模型设定**：在上下文随机块模型（CSBM）下分析，将 $m$ 维特征通过投影约简为一维信号+高斯噪声（引理B.2）。3. **信号-残差分解**：$\widehat{A}=\eta ss^\top + R'$，其中 $\|R'\|\lesssim\sqrt{\log n/(np)}$。4. **关键技术——逐项Krylov界**（引理B.9）：通过原子展开（atom expansion，引理B.5）将归一化残差展开为不同层级的原子，再用装饰游走计数（decorated-walk counting，引理B.6）控制高阶矩，最终得到 $|e_u^\top R'^a s|\leq \theta^a/\sqrt{n}$ 对所有节点一致成立。5. **信号恢复**（引理B.10）：结合谱范数界、逐项Krylov界与高斯集中，证明 $\eta^{-k}\widehat{A}^k(s+g)$ 与 $s$ 的 $\ell_\infty$ 距离为 $o(1/\sqrt{n})$，保证符号分类器正确分类。

Result: **主要结果**：
- **二元精确恢复定理**（定理4.3）：在 $p\geq C_d\log^B n/n$（$B>4$）、$1\leq k\leq O(\log n)$、$\gamma\geq C_\gamma k\sqrt{\log n/(np)}$ 及显式SNR条件下，$\widehat{A}^k X$ 的行以概率 $1-n^{-\Omega(1)}$ 线性可分。
- **多类部分恢复定理**（定理4.7）：在 $\bar{d}\geq C\log n$、$|\lambda|\geq C_0 k(\delta+\epsilon)$ 条件下，至少 $n-n_e$ 个节点传播后靠近真实类中心，异常节点数 $n_e$ 显式上界分为结构/归一化误差与特征噪声误差两部分。
- **实验验证**：在Cora、CiteSeer、PubMed、Reddit、ogbn-arxiv、ogbn-products上的实验显示修正传播在深层下精度下降更小，与理论预测一致。

Conclusion: 本文建立了归一化修正GNN传播的谱理论，证明在CSBM框架下减去度平稳分量后，类判别信号可在 $O(\log n)$ 层传播中保持。技术核心是逐项残差幂控制（而非仅谱范数），通过原子展开与装饰游走计数处理归一化引入的非线性度因子。**主要局限**：（1）密度阈值 $np\geq C\log^B n$（$B>4$）比尖锐目标 $\log^3 n$ 略强；（2）仅分析线性传播骨干，未涵盖非线性激活、注意力与学习变换；（3）CSBM无法捕捉异质性与度异配性。未来工作包括锐化密度阈值、推广到异配模型、整合训练层及开发平稳修正的可扩展近似。

Abstract: We develop a spectral theory for \emph{normalized corrected GNN propagation}. The object of study is the symmetric normalized adjacency with its degree-stationary component removed, matching the normalization used by standard GCN-style models while isolating the stationary direction most directly tied to oversmoothing. The central theoretical question is whether this corrected normalized operator preserves class-discriminative signal after many propagation layers. Our main result is a high-probability exact-recovery theorem for the binary Contextual Stochastic Block Model after \(k=O(\log n)\) propagation steps in the dense polylogarithmic regime \(p\ge C\log^B n/n\), for any fixed \(B>4\), under explicit graph-signal and feature-SNR conditions. We also establish a multi-class partial recovery theorem showing contraction toward class centers for most nodes. Synthetic and real node-classification experiments are included as empirical checks of the theory's predicted dependence on depth, graph signal, and feature noise.

</details>


### [776] [It's Much Easier for Neural Networks to learn Game of Life Dynamics with the Right Activation Function: Polynomial Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23587)
*Tashin Ahmed,Q. Tyrell Davis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现，使用合适的激活函数（如二次多项式或PReLU）而非默认的ReLU，能让极简神经网络可靠地学习康威生命游戏的单步演化规则，并提出了一种结合Kolmogorov-Arnold表示定理与多项式激活的PolyKAN架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究（Springer & Kenyon 2021; Gilpin 2019）发现，卷积神经网络虽然架构与生命游戏CA高度匹配、且理论上具备近似能力，但使用默认ReLU激活时需要远超最小规模的过参数化网络才能可靠学习Life规则。这暴露出"深度学习即搜索"（彩票假设）视角下对规模的依赖。研究者推测根源在于ReLU的分段线性/弱单调性偏置与Life规则基于区间的非单调逻辑之间存在不匹配，因此转向探索匹配任务归纳偏置的激活函数。

Method: 作者将Kolmogorov-Arnold表示定理（KART）的思想与多项式神经网络结合，提出PolyKAN：用可学习系数的二次多项式 $\phi(x)=\sum_{d=0}^{2} w_d x^d$ 替代卷积+1×1更新架构中的标准激活。模型架构为浅层 $\mathcal{L}(1,m)$：一个3×3卷积提取Moore邻域、1×1卷积学习更新规则、最后接sigmoid，32×32周期性边界。训练采用Adam(lr=1e-3)、batch size=8、连续随机生成CA状态。系统比较了10种激活函数（PolyKAN、PReLU、SiLU、Square、RootSquare、LeakyReLU、CELU、Sigmoid、Tanh、ReLU），并在初始细胞密度、参数扰动、突触权重/激活函数学习消融等条件下评估128次训练运行的成败率，同时通过参数空间PCA轨迹可视化损失景观。

Result: 在最小$\mathcal{L}(1,1)$网络中，PolyKAN以34/29个可训练参数（取决于是否学习突触权重）达到128/128的100%成功率，PReLU达到124/128（97%），Square和SiLU各94%，而Sigmoid、Tanh、ReLU均为0%（前两者因饱和，后者在最小网络中完全失败）。PolyKAN对初始细胞密度的鲁棒性显著优于ReLU（仅在极端密度0.95处全部失败）。参数扰动实验中所有模型均出现退化，但PolyKAN表现相对稳健。主成分分析显示ReLU/Sigmoid解空间狭窄且呈"脊"状或"十字"形瓶颈，而PolyKAN的解在参数空间呈平滑展开的扇形分布，表明存在更多样化的成功解。

Conclusion: 研究表明，学习Life动力学的主要障碍不在于网络的表示能力，而在于激活函数与任务之间的归纳偏置不匹配。匹配任务特性的激活函数（特别是二次多项式PolyKAN和PReLU）能让极简网络在无需过参数化的情况下可靠学习CA规则。这挑战了"用规模解决一切"的默认选择，支持将学习视为带合适偏置的拟合问题而非纯搜索问题。作者倡导将CA作为"袖珍宇宙"测试平台，为科学机器学习、基于物理的深度学习和可解释ML开发策略提供参考。

Abstract: Previous work has found a gap between the scale of neural networks that reliably learn Conway's Game of Life, and minimal networks capable of representing the classic cellular automaton with hard-coded parameter values. Viewing neural network learning as a search process suggests a dependence on networks large enough to contain sub-networks with lucky initializations (sometimes known as 'winning tickets') that actually learn the task. In this work, we reorient our perspective from discovering Life rules as a search problem back to a learning problem, and reason that with fitting inductive biases, the problem should be much more amenable to minimal networks. We find that network variants with several alternative activation functions meaningfully outperform the default choice of Rectified Linear Units, and in particular, that a 2nd degree polynomial activation function consistently learns Life dynamics with or without the benefit of learning neural weights. Our results provide an informative demonstration of the benefits of matching learning to the task at hand and challenge the easy default choice of scale for all problems. In particular, we advocate for the use of cellular automata as simple test domains for developing strategies that can benefit machine learning for science, physics-based deep learning, and interpretable machine learning.

</details>


### [777] [Quantifying the Agreement Between Data-Influence and Data-Similarity to Understand LLM Behavior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23591)
*Christopher J. Anders,Henrique Da Silva Gameiro,Nico Daheim,Mohammad Emtiyaz Khan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统性地量化了用于LLM输出追踪的两种方法——数据相似性（Data-Similarity，BM25）与数据影响力（Data-Influence，影响函数）——之间的共识与差异，发现两者排名存在显著共识但具有不对称性：影响力对相似性的预测能力优于反向操作，据此提出先用廉价相似性预筛选、再用昂贵影响力精炼的高性价比混合方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解LLM行为是应对幻觉、偏见、隐私和版权问题的关键。现有研究将LLM视为信息检索系统，通过追踪输出回溯到训练数据。数据相似性方法（如BM25、InfiniGram）已被OLMo-Trace等系统证明有效且可扩展，但计算成本低；数据影响力方法（如影响函数）被认为更准确但代价高昂。此前两类方法的对比仅限于有绝对真值的ground-truth任务，而输出追踪场景（如搜索引擎式检索）缺乏绝对真值，两者关系尚不明确，亟需系统性量化以指导混合方案设计。

Method: 1）使用100个多样化提示（由Gemini生成并人工核验），拼接LLM补全的响应构成查询；2）数据相似性采用Lucene版BM25，数据影响力采用基于Hessian的EK-FAC估计器（另对比对角近似DIAG与纯梯度GRAD）；3）从DCLM数据集中随机抽取100,000篇训练文档（在OLMo2-1B、Qwen3-1.7B、LlaMa3.2-1B、Gemma3-1B、GPT2-small/medium上实验）；4）对每个查询分别按两种度量排序训练文档，使用agreement at depth、asymmetric agreement、rank-biased overlap、Wilcoxon符号秩检验等排名度量量化重叠度与不对称性；5）通过ROC-AUC评估"用Sim预筛+Inf精炼"与反向方案的成本-精度权衡。

Result: 1）共识性：两种排名的top-100文档约11%相同，前若干排名出现陡峭重合；2）不对称性：Sim的top-100中约34%落在Inf的top-1000内，而反向仅28%，Wilcoxon检验在绝大多数深度上p<0.05，证实Inf→Sim显著优于Sim→Inf；3）一致性：估计器质量越高，Sim与Inf的共识越强（GRAD的1%共识在加入Hessian后提升至11%），且不对称性在EK-FAC、DIAG、GRAD三种估计器中均成立；4）混合方案：Sim→Inf的ROC-AUC为0.63，而Inf→Sim的ROC-AUC达0.83，证明先用BM25预筛、再用影响力精炼可在大幅降低计算成本的同时获得高精度。

Conclusion: 数据相似性与数据影响力在LLM输出追踪中既存在显著共识又具有稳健的不对称性，影响力对相似性排名的预测力更强；该结论在六种LLM与三种影响力估计器上均成立。基于此，"廉价相似性预筛选 + 昂贵影响力精炼"是一种成本-精度友好的混合范式，可为OLMo-Trace等系统引入影响力机制提供路径。局限在于查询与训练文档规模受算力约束，且提示未按主题严格平衡，未来工作应扩展到更大规模数据集与生产级模型（≥30B参数），并探索InfiniGram、语义嵌入等其他相似性度量与影响力的关系。

Abstract: One way to understand LLM behavior is to trace its output back to the training data. Two types of measures are commonly used for output tracing: data-similarity and data-influence. The former is cheaper while the latter is believed to be more accurate. Even though many works have compared them for ground-truth tasks, no such comparisons exist for output tracing. Here, we fill this gap and precisely quantify the commonalities and differences between the two measures. We do this by first ranking the training documents according to each measure and then computing the overlap between the two rankings. Our main finding is that the two rankings agree significantly, but there is an asymmetry between them: The top documents of data-similarity are assigned more consistent ranks by data-influence than the other way around. This result is valid across a range of experiments involving OLMo2-1B, Qwen3-1.7B, LlaMa3.2-1B, Gemma3-1B, and GPT2. We exploit the asymmetry to obtain a favorable cost-accuracy trade-off by using the costly data-influence to refine the results of data-similarity.

</details>


### [778] [MORL-A2C: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Reranker for Optimizing Healthiness in MOPI-HFRS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23603)
*Aarya Vasantlal,Joshua Zolla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MORL-A2C，一种多目标强化学习重排序器，将 MOPI-HFRS 框架中静态的 MGDA Pareto 优化扩展为基于 Advantage Actor-Critic (A2C) 的序列决策过程，以在保持相关性的同时显著提升个性化健康对齐效果。同时修正了原 MOPI-HFRS 评估管线中一个会低估基线表现的非平凡 Bug。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有食物推荐系统主要优化用户偏好（参与度），忽视了营养健康这一长期目标。MOPI-HFRS 通过 Pareto 多目标优化联合考虑偏好、健康和多样性，但其静态、逐步骤的优化范式存在两个根本缺陷：(1) 无法建模推荐列表内条目的序列依赖（位置 t 的推荐价值依赖于前 t-1 个已选条目）；(2) 优化的代理损失（BPR、Jaccard 加权 BPR）与最终不可微的评估指标（Recall、NDCG、H-Score）之间存在 gap。此外，作者在复现过程中发现原 MOPI-HFRS 评估管线存在一个系统性低估基线性能的 Bug。

Method: 方法核心是将 Top-K 推荐构造重新形式化为 K 步 MDP：(1) 状态 s_t 由冻结的用户 GNN 嵌入 h_u、已选条目嵌入的运行均值 \bar{e}_t、累积健康标签覆盖向量 c_t 和归一化时间步 t/K 拼接构成；(2) 动作空间为当前候选食物集（已选条目被移除）；(3) 奖励为二值相关性奖励 r_t^rel 与二值健康标签匹配奖励 r_t^health 的标量化加权和 r_t = r_t^rel + β·r_t^health（β=0.5）。学习算法采用 Advantage Actor-Critic (A2C)，策略网络通过对状态编码和候选编码的内积产生 softmax 分布；为缓解大动作空间下的探索崩溃，采用行为克隆 (BC) 预训练——以冻结 GNN 嵌入的内积排序器作为教师，通过负对数似然将排序信号蒸馏到策略网络中。GNN 编码器（~3.9M 参数）在训练时保持冻结，仅训练 Actor-Critic MLPs（~271k 参数，<7%）。

Result: 在 macro-nutrient 基准上：Recall@20 从 25.64% 略降至 23.61%（约 2 点），NDCG@20 从 23.52% 降至 20.64%（约 3 点），但 H-Score@20 从 46.05% 大幅提升至 69.57%（+23.5 点）。在 full-nutrient 基准上趋势一致：Recall@20 从 25.34% 降至 21.53%，NDCG@20 从 22.40% 降至 20.40%，H-Score@20 从 64.85% 提升至 90.48%（+25.6 点）。在 β∈{0.1,0.3,0.5,1,3,5,10,20} 的扫描中，β=0.5 在 Recall 与 H-Score 之间取得最佳平衡。同时发现并修正了原 MOPI-HFRS 评估管线中的两个 Bug（评估矩阵按边索引而非用户索引、掩码错误使用负采样索引），修正后基线 Recall@20 几乎翻倍（12.73%→25.64%），表明此前报告的基线-方法差距部分源于评估基础设施问题。

Conclusion: 论文验证了策略驱动的序列优化能够有效导航食物推荐中的健康-偏好权衡：通过从一次性静态排序转向序列决策，系统获得了直接表达和优化集合级健康目标（如累积标签覆盖）的词汇表。本工作的核心贡献是序列化形式本身而非具体算法选择，主要局限包括：奖励中缺乏显式多样性信号、依赖离线模拟奖励（无真实序贯用户反馈）、β 为全局固定值（缺乏状态相关动态标量化）、以及部分多样性指标在原论文中无法复现。明确的未来工作包括引入多样性奖励分量、状态条件 β(s_t) 学习、以及在线/混合反馈环境扩展。

Abstract: Unhealthy dietary behavior continues to be a persistent public health issue in the United States, exacerbated by recommendation systems that prioritize user preference without considering nutritional health. The Multi-Objective Personalized Interpretable Health-aware Food Recommendation System (MOPI-HFRS), from which this work extends, addresses this by jointly optimizing preference, health, and diversity through Pareto-based optimization. However, this approach relies on static, per-step tradeoff solutions that fail to capture the sequential nature of dietary decision-making. We introduce MORL-A2C, a sequential decision-making extension to MOPI-HFRS targeting the health-preference axis. Leveraging frozen GNN embeddings, MORL-A2C formulates recommendation as a K-step reranking problem using an Advantage Actor-Critic algorithm with a scalarized relevance/health reward. The policy is warm-started via behavior cloning against a dot-product ranker derived from frozen embeddings. We also identify and correct a non-trivial bug in the MOPI-HFRS evaluation pipeline that understated baseline performance; all results are reported against the corrected baseline. On the macro-nutrient benchmark, MORL-A2C achieves a modest reduction in ranking quality (Recall@20: 25.64% to 23.61%, NDCG@20: 23.52% to 20.64%) in exchange for a substantial improvement in health alignment (H-Score@20: 46.05% to 69.57%), with consistent trends on the full-nutrient benchmark. These findings validate that policy-driven sequential optimization can effectively navigate the health-preference trade-off in multi-objective food recommendation.

</details>


### [779] [Muown Implicitly Performs Angular Step-size Decay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23637)
*Florian Hübler,Kai Lion,Antonio Orvieto,Niao He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了Muown优化器隐式地在行斜流形上执行黎曼优化，其方向更新的角度步长由存储的行范数增长隐式衰减。基于此观察提出了AngularMuown，将角度步长显式化为可独立调度的乘子κ_t，从而解耦径向与角度动力学。算法在nanoGPT speedrun、Qwen2-0.5B及1.1B MoE模型上一致优于AdamW、NorMuon和Muown，并附带非凸收敛性保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon优化器虽通过谱范数最速下降实现稳定特征学习，但仅控制每步谱范数变化而不控制权重谱范数的增长。Muown通过将权重分解为行幅度与未归一化方向两部分来缓解此问题，并对大步长表现出显著鲁棒性，但该鲁棒性的来源缺乏理论解释。本文旨在从几何角度揭示Muown鲁棒性的本质，并探索显式控制角度步长的可能性。

Method: 1. 将Muown的参数化形式 W = Diag(g/‖R‖_row)·R 等价改写为 W = Diag(g)·U，其中U ∈ M_ob（行斜流形，行范数均为1）。2. 推导Muown方向更新的黎曼梯度 grad_U L = Diag(g)(G - Diag(diag(GU^T))U)，证明其隐式执行oblique manifold上的黎曼最速下降步。3. 证明Muown的方向更新等价于Retr_{U_t}(ξ) 其中 ξ = -(η_t s_{m,n}/r_{t,i})·O_{t,i}，即行范数r_{t,i}在分母上隐式衰减角度步长 tan θ_{t,i} ≈ a_{t,i}/r_{t,i}。4. 提出AngularMuown：直接优化单位行方向U，配合显式角度乘子κ_t（默认逆多项式衰减 κ_t = (1+c(t-t_w)_+)^{-p}），径向g由Adam独立更新。5. 引入谱条件形状缩放 s_{m,n} = √max(1, m/n) 使角度更新维度无关。6. 在Algorithm 2的理想化版本上给出非凸收敛保证：O(min{m,n} Δ₁ L σ² ε^{-4})次梯度评估达到ε-驻点。

Result: 1. 124M Transformer在FineWeb-Edu上：AngularMuown相比AdamW实现约2×加速，相比NorMuon/Muown约1.5×加速，在所有token预算（2.5B-10B）和所有分叉点上均降低验证损失。2. 角度位移分析：µ=1时角度更新保持平坦，使用多项式衰减时与所有其他衰减方法一样平滑收敛至零，证实角度机制的可视化。3. 学习率迁移性：在模型宽度512/768/1280上最优学习率完美迁移，验证形状缩放的有效性。4. Qwen2-0.5B：多项式调度在所有η≥2×10⁻²下均优于NorMuon，常数κ_t则在较大η下急剧退化。5. 1.1B-A370M MoE模型：AngularMuown (s_{m,n}=√max(1,m/n)) 在多个学习率下达到最低验证损失2.4807，优于Muon的2.4914。6. 在modded nanoGPT speedrun中，AngularMuown的初步版本以Muown-RowNormControl为名领跑按优化器分组赛道。

Conclusion: Muown存储的行范数会因Muon方向更新而增长，从而在分母上隐式退火角度步长 tan θ ∝ 1/r，这解释了Muown对大步长的稳定性。AngularMuown通过显式保持行方向为单位范数并引入独立可调度的角度乘子κ_t，将这一隐式机制变为显式设计选择，使径向和角度动力学解耦，从而在dense和MoE Transformer预训练中一致优于AdamW、NorMuon和Muown。主要局限在于评估集中于中等规模语言模型预训练，未扩展至100B+参数或非语言架构。

Abstract: Matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon and Muown have recently shown strong empirical performance for pre-training Transformers. In particular, Muown separates each weight matrix into row magnitudes and an un-normalized direction variable, updating the former with Adam and the latter with Muon. We show that the directional update of Muown is equivalent to a Riemannian step on the normalized directions, while the magnitude of the un-normalized parameterization only modulates the angular step size. This explains the step-size stability of Muown and suggests making the angular step size explicit. The resulting method, AngularMuown, optimizes directly over the normalized directions and uses a schedulable angular multiplier decoupled from the radial magnitude update. AngularMuown improves over Muown and, at the time of writing, a preliminary version is leading the per-optimizer category of the modded nanoGPT speedrunning competition. Further experiments on Qwen2-0.5B, and 1.1B parameter mixture-of-experts models confirm the algorithm scales beyond small models. An implementation of the algorithm is available at this https URL

</details>


### [780] [Dynamic estimation of slowly varying sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23655)
*Prashant Gokhale,Mikhail Khodak,Sandeep Silwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对缓慢变化序列的函数动态估计问题，提出了一个通用、自适应的元算法框架，将动态隐式迹估计从特定设置推广到多种线性和非线性函数，并通过局部缩放查询预算获得了更优的路径长度式（path-length-style）变化界 O(∑αᵢ)，改进此前 O(m·max αᵢ) 的界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在许多理论与应用场景中（如演化概率分布、社交网络指标跟踪、数据流统计、神经网络训练中 Hessian 曲率跟踪等），常需对缓慢变化的系统逐时刻估计其属性。现有动态隐式迹估计方法 [Dharangutte & Musco, 2021] 仅适用于迹估计，且复杂度依赖最坏情形步长 m·max αᵢ，对稳定但偶有突变的序列效率低下；同时要求事先已知步长上限 αᵢ，限制实用性。

Method: 1) 定义"良集中静态估计器"（Well-Concentrated Estimator）概念，描述具有次指数浓度且浓度参数随样本预算 k 缩放的随机估计器。2) 提出自适应元算法（Algorithm 1），利用阻尼因子 γₜ = min(1, αₜ) 和残差状态 uₜ = vₜ - (1-γₜ)vₜ₋₁，递归更新运行估计；样本预算 kₜ 与局部步长 αₜ 成正比缩放。3) 引入"范数估计预言机"，通过两阶段方案在线估计未知步长（对迹估计仅需 O(log(m/δ)) 额外开销）。4) 证明主定理：已知步长下复杂度 O((c₁²/ε² + c₂/ε)log(m/δ)(1+∑αₜ) + c₃m log(m/δ)/ε)，未知步长下附加 Σk_norm 开销。5) 将框架应用于：迹估计、矩阵幂的迹、谱密度估计、动态蒙特卡洛积分、动态 Dirichlet 边值问题。

Result: 理论结果：1) 迹估计（Thm 3）总 MVPs 复杂度 O(m log(m/δ) + log(m/δ)(1+∑αᵢ)/ε²)，改进此前 (1+m·α_max) 界。2) 矩阵幂的迹（Cor 4）复杂度 O(log(m/δ)/ε² ·(k + k²∑αₜ))。3) 谱密度估计（Thm 5）复杂度 e^O(1/ε) log(m/δ)(1 + (1/ε)∑αₜ)。4) 蒙特卡洛积分（Thm 6）函数求值次数 O(log(m/δ)(1+∑αₜ)/ε² + m log(m/δ)/ε)。5) Dirichlet 问题（Cor 7）作为 MC 积分的推论成立。实验结果：在合成矩阵序列（含突发扰动）和神经网络 SGDR 训练轨迹的 Hessian 迹估计中，自适应方法在相同精度下显著减少 MVP 开销，在成本-误差 Pareto 前沿上严格优于基线 DeltaShift 方法。

Conclusion: 该工作将动态序列估计从迹估计推广为通用、目标无关的框架：涵盖线性与非线性映射、不同向量空间（Frobenius 范数与 L∞ 范数）、静态与自适应步长两种场景。核心创新在于将样本预算和阻尼因子同时按局部步长 αₜ 缩放，实现路径长度式复杂度 O(∑αᵢ)；并通过 Hutchinson 估计器自身在线估计步长，仅付 O(m log(m/δ)) 极低额外代价。框架在动态迹估计上突破了现有最优保证，为演化系统的高效跟踪提供了通用工具。

Abstract: We consider the problem of sequentially approximating functions of each element in a slowly-varying sequence, i.e. one where the magnitude $\alpha_i$ of the difference between the elements at positions $i$ and $i-1$ is small. Recent work on implicit trace estimation shows that when $\alpha_t$ is small, reusing queries to past sequence elements can reduce the overall cost [Dharangutte \& Musco, NeurIPS~2021; Woodruff et al., NeurIPS~2022]. We introduce a framework generalizing this to a variety of linear and nonlinear functions on diverse vector spaces, obtaining novel sequential estimation results for matrix powers, spectral densities, Monte Carlo integration, and a boundary value problem from partial differential equations~(PDEs). Furthermore, we develop a novel algorithm for use with this framework that locally scales the estimation budget with $\alpha_t$, obtaining sharper path-length-style variation bounds of form $\mathcal O(\sum_{i=1}^m\alpha_i)$ on the cost of estimating a sequence of length $m$. This improves upon the previous implicit trace estimation bound of $\mathcal O(m\cdot\max_i\alpha_i)$ [Dharangutte \& Musco, NeurIPS~2021], which is achieved by fixing the query budget using the worst-case $\alpha_i$ and is thus inefficient for stable sequences with rare bursts. Lastly, while all past work assumes a known bound on $\alpha_i$, we show in certain cases how the changes can be estimated on-the-fly with (nearly) no added cost. In summary, our framework makes the sequential approximation toolkit general-purpose and adaptive while improving upon state-of-the-art-guarantees for dynamic trace estimation.

</details>


### [781] [MAS-PromptBench: When Does Prompt Optimization Improve Multi-Agent LLM Systems?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23664)
*Juyang Bai,Laixi Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了 MAS-PromptBench，一个用于评估多智能体系统（MAS）中系统提示优化的基准测试，系统研究了提示优化在不同 MAS 配置下的效果，揭示其既能带来显著增益（最高 24 个百分点），也可能造成严重性能下降（最高 16 个百分点）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然提示优化在单智能体场景中已被证明有效，但其在多智能体系统中的适用性尚不明确。多智能体场景中存在智能体间提示依赖和组合爆炸的搜索空间，使得直接迁移单智能体方法面临挑战。当前的多智能体框架（如 AutoGen、CrewAI、MetaGPT 等）仍依赖手工设计的系统提示，且现有研究在任务、配置和基线上缺乏统一标准，难以横向比较。因此亟需回答一个基础问题：在固定 MAS 配置下，提示优化究竟能带来多少性能提升，其效果如何随配置变化？

Method: 1. 提出 MAS-PromptBench 基准，覆盖四个维度：任务分布（推理/编码/工具调用，共 9 个数据集）、工作流拓扑（单智能体、独立、顺序、集中式、去中心化，共 5 种）、通信协议（自由/半结构化/结构化）、团队规模（2/4/8/10）；2. 将两种 SOTA 单智能体提示优化方法（GEPA 和 MIPRO）自然扩展为多智能体版本（MAS-GEPA、MAS-MIPRO）；3. 在固定 MAS 配置下，量化提示优化增益 Δ = E[μ(M(x;π*)) - μ(M(x;π⁰))]，系统比较优化前后的性能差异。

Result: 1. 提示优化在 MAS 中具有显著潜力，最高可带来 24.0 个百分点的性能提升；2. 但效果高度不稳定，某些配置下性能下降最高达 16.0 个百分点；3. 提示优化在以下条件下效果更好：任务具有明确、可控、可验证的智能体局部行为；通信协议施加显式共享结构使智能体交互更易控制和迁移；4. 需要工作流拓扑感知；5. 团队规模越大，提示优化越困难，验证了规模化 MAS 提示优化的挑战性。

Conclusion: MAS-PromptBench 为评估多智能体系统中的提示优化提供了首个综合性基准，揭示了提示优化在 MAS 中的双刃剑效应：既能释放显著性能增益，也存在严重失败的风险。研究表明，未来的 MAS 提示优化算法需要针对多智能体设置进行专门设计，具备拓扑感知能力，并应对团队规模扩展带来的挑战。该基准为算法设计和 MAS 设计提供了经验路线图。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) offer a scalable path forward for agentic AI, comprising multiple LLM-based agents, each assigned a system prompt and a position within a workflow that governs inter-agent coordination and output aggregation. System prompts thus form a critical and accessible optimization surface: they specify agents' roles and behaviors, enabling system-level improvements without model finetuning. Although prompt optimization has shown substantial potential for single LLMs, extending it to MAS poses distinct challenges, notably an exponentially growing search space. It remains unclear whether, when, and by how much prompt optimization improves MAS performance, and how sensitive such gains are to system configuration. In this work, we systematically study system-prompt optimization across a broad range of MAS setups varying in task, workflow, communication protocol, and team size, benchmarking two prompt optimizers that naturally extend state-of-the-art single-agent methods. The results reveal its potential to unlock significant gains while exposing open challenges, characterizing when and how much prompt optimization helps across diverse MAS settings.

</details>


### [782] [On the Limits of Prompt-Conditioned Language Models as General-Purpose Learners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.23668)
*David Mguni,Julian Ma,Jun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从信息论与PAC-Bayes元学习视角,理论证明了提示驱动的LLM作为通用求解器存在不可消除的内在限制:语言作为容量有限的通信信道,会因"表达性下限"和"目标错位下限"导致某些任务族即使在无限数据下也无法被正确求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM被广泛视为可解决任意任务的通用求解器,但本文指出这一观点忽视了一个根本约束:自然语言是一种压缩且容量有限的接口,无法无损传递所有任务信息。同时,用户意图与系统对齐目标之间可能存在本质分歧。需要一个统一框架来严格刻画这些局限性。

Method: 1) 将用户-系统交互建模为双层廉价交谈(cheap-talk)博弈;2) 概念上将LLM分解为"提示解释器"(Prompt Interpreter)与"基础求解器"(Base Solver);3) 区分用户理想分布P_θ^{usr}、任务生成分布P_task与系统诱导分布P_{G,φ}三类概率律;4) 推导PAC-Bayes元学习泛化界,分离有限样本估计误差与结构性下限;5) 利用Fano不等式、数据处理不等式分析信息瓶颈。

Result: 两个核心负面结果:① 表达性下限(定理1):若有效任务信息I(Θ;Z|Θ∈Θ₀)≤B且B < logK - log2,则User风险渐近下限为αδ[1-(B+log2)/logK]₊ > 0,任务混淆不可避免;② 目标错位下限(定理2):若用户理想分布不在系统可接受集P_safe内,则KL距离下限Y_obj ≥ βε > 0;③ 定理6综合表明,即使M,N→∞,经验风险仍以高概率不低于Y = max{Y_expr, Y_obj} > 0。示例验证:临床疼痛报告(10级量表)与多模态嵌入压缩均产生不可消除的误差地板。

Conclusion: 提示驱动的LLM在信息受限通信与目标受限对齐的双重约束下,不是通用问题求解器:存在任务族使其正确行为在无限数据渐近下仍不可达。这一负向结果与No Free Lunch定理一致。实践启示在于:扩展模型规模无法突破该结构限制,真正的改进必须来自扩展任务接口(多模态、迭代协议、外部记忆)以增加系统可获取的任务相关信息。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are frequently portrayed as general-purpose solvers capable of solving arbitrary tasks. We argue that this view overlooks a fundamental constraint: language is a compressed and capacity-limited interface for conveying task information. Modelling User--System interaction as a bilevel \emph{cheap-talk} game, we analyse how latent tasks are encoded into prompts and reinterpreted under alignment and safety constraints. We introduce a conceptual decomposition separating task inference from execution and derive PAC-Bayes bounds that distinguish finite-sample estimation error from irreducible structural limitations. Our first main result establishes an \emph{expressivity floor}: language acts as a capacity-limited communication channel, and whenever the informational complexity of a task family exceeds the capacity of that channel, distinct tasks become unavoidably indistinguishable to the Solver, inducing a strictly positive error floor that cannot be eliminated by additional data, optimisation, or model scaling alone. We then establish an \emph{objective-misalignment floor}: when alignment constraints restrict the admissible output set, the User-ideal distribution may lie outside the feasible class, inducing an irreducible distortion. Together, these results yield a formal negative conclusion: prompt-conditioned LLMs are not universal problem solvers through prompting alone, as there exist task families for which correct behaviour is provably unattainable even in the infinite-data regime. More broadly, our analysis shows the limits of prompt-based generalisation arise from information-constrained communication and alignment-constrained objectives. This suggests that interfaces beyond natural language, including multimodal observations and, external memory, may reduce the inherent LLM limitations by increasing the task-relevant information available to the System.

</details>
